part.def_en: A piece or segment of something larger.

examples.sentence: Everyone is a part of the team in this project.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人都是这个项目团队的一部分。

examples.sentence: That is only part of the problem we face today.
examples.translation_zh: 那只是我们今天面临问题的一部分。

examples.sentence: A noun is a part of speech in English grammar.
examples.translation_zh: 名词是英语语法中的一种词性。

examples.sentence: We might go to the park after lunch.
examples.translation_zh: 午餐后我们可能会去公园。

examples.sentence: This report might help us understand the problem better.
examples.translation_zh: 这份报告可能会帮助我们更好地理解问题。

examples.sentence: Students might be interested in learning new languages.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们可能会对学习新语言感兴趣。

system.def_en: A set of connected things or parts that work together.

examples.sentence: Many companies use a computer system for organization.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司使用计算机系统来组织。

examples.sentence: The education system in this country needs improvement.
examples.translation_zh: 这个国家的教育系统需要改进。

examples.sentence: There are many issues in the health care system today.
examples.translation_zh: 今天的医疗系统存在许多问题。

against.def_en: In opposition to; in contrast with.

examples.sentence: Employees must not act against the rules at work.
examples.translation_zh: 员工在工作中不得违反规定。

examples.sentence: Driving without a license is against the law.
examples.translation_zh: 无证驾驶是违法的。

examples.sentence: The team fought against the odds to win the match.
examples.translation_zh: 这个团队克服困难赢得了比赛。

point.def_en: A specific location, position, or detail.

examples.sentence: She always points out the best places to eat.
examples.translation_zh: 她总是指出最好的餐馆。

examples.sentence: The meeting point is near the main entrance of the building.
examples.translation_zh: 集合地点在建筑物的主入口附近。

examples.sentence: This event was a turning point in the country's history.
examples.translation_zh: 这一事件是该国历史上的一个转折点。

program.def_en: A planned series of events or activities.

examples.sentence: Many students learn to write a computer program.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生学习编写计算机程序。

examples.sentence: She joined a new training program to improve her skills.
examples.translation_zh: 她参加了一个新的培训计划，以提高技能。

examples.sentence: They enjoyed watching a popular television program last night.
examples.translation_zh: 他们昨晚观看了一个受欢迎的电视节目。

government.def_en: The governing body of a nation or community.

examples.sentence: Many citizens support the new government policy on education.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公民支持新的关于教育的政府政策。

examples.sentence: Our local government organizes community events every month.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的地方政府每个月都会组织社区活动。

examples.sentence: A government official will visit our office next week.
examples.translation_zh: 一位政府官员下星期将访问我们的办公室。

area.def_en: A space or region defined by specific limits or qualities.

examples.sentence: Students must choose a study area for their project.
examples.translation_zh: 学生必须为他们的项目选择一个研究区域。

examples.sentence: Many people live in urban areas near the city.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人住在城市附近的城市区域。

examples.sentence: This is a safe area for children to play outside.
examples.translation_zh: 这是一个儿童可以在外面玩耍的安全区域。

national.def_en: Relating to a nation or country as a whole.

examples.sentence: Our national team won the championship last year.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的国家队去年赢得了冠军。

examples.sentence: I love celebrating national holidays with my family.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢和家人一起庆祝国家节日。

examples.sentence: Students learn the national anthem in music class.
examples.translation_zh: 学生在音乐课上学习国歌。

fact.def_en: A thing that is known or proven to be true.

examples.sentence: Many people agree with the fact that climate change is real.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人同意气候变化是事实。

examples.sentence: It is a fact of life that we all face challenges.
examples.translation_zh: 面对挑战是生活中的事实。

examples.sentence: In fact, many artists struggle to make a living.
examples.translation_zh: 实际上，许多艺术家都难以谋生。

happen.def_en: To take place or occur; to come about.

examples.sentence: Many things happen in life that we cannot control.
examples.translation_zh: 生活中发生许多事情是我们无法控制的。

examples.sentence: Problems may happen at work without any warning.
examples.translation_zh: 问题可能在工作中毫无预警地发生。

examples.sentence: Surprises can happen during the event, keep watching.
examples.translation_zh: 活动中可能会发生惊喜，继续关注吧。

provide.def_en: To supply or make available something needed or wanted.

examples.sentence: Managers provide support to their team members daily.
examples.translation_zh: 经理每天为他们的团队成员提供支持。

examples.sentence: Teachers provide information to help students learn effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 老师提供信息来帮助学生有效学习。

examples.sentence: New technology can provide access to faster internet connections.
examples.translation_zh: 新技术可以提供更快的互联网连接。

line.def_en: A long, narrow mark or band; a queue of people.

examples.sentence: Many people waited in line to buy tickets.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人排队买票。

examples.sentence: A line graph shows changes over a period of time.
examples.translation_zh: 折线图显示了一段时间内的变化。

examples.sentence: Please draw a line under your name on the form.
examples.translation_zh: 请在表格上您的名字下画一条线。

power.def_en: The ability to do something or act in a particular way.

examples.sentence: Many countries are building new power plants today.
examples.translation_zh: 许多国家现在正在建设新的发电厂。

examples.sentence: The power struggle between leaders continues to affect the country.
examples.translation_zh: 领导者之间的权力斗争继续影响着这个国家。

examples.sentence: A reliable power supply is essential for this experiment.
examples.translation_zh: 可靠的电源对这个实验至关重要。

issue.def_en: A point or matter of discussion or dispute.

examples.sentence: Many people ignore health issues until it's too late.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人忽视健康问题，直到为时已晚。

examples.sentence: Have you read the current issue of the magazine?
examples.translation_zh: 你看过这期杂志吗？

examples.sentence: She wants to talk about a serious issue affecting everyone.
examples.translation_zh: 她想谈谈影响每个人的严重问题。

lose.def_en: To no longer have something; to misplace or fail to win.

examples.sentence: Many people want to lose weight for summer.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人想在夏天减肥。

examples.sentence: He might lose a job if he is late again.
examples.translation_zh: 如果他再迟到，他可能会失去工作。

examples.sentence: They hope not to lose a game this weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 他们希望这个周末不输掉比赛。

however.def_en: In spite of that; used to introduce a contrast.

examples.sentence: Learning a new language is challenging; however, practice helps.
examples.translation_zh: 学习一门新语言很有挑战性，然而，练习会有所帮助。

examples.sentence: I enjoy dessert; however much I eat, I never feel full.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢甜点，然而无论我吃多少，都从未感到满足。

examples.sentence: The project needs improvement; however you look at it, it's not perfect.
examples.translation_zh: 这个项目需要改进，然而无论你怎么看，它都不完美。

law.def_en: System of rules that society follows to maintain order.

examples.sentence: Everyone must respect the law in our community.
examples.translation_zh: 我们社区的每个人都必须遵守法律。

examples.sentence: Law enforcement agencies are increasing patrols in the area.
examples.translation_zh: 执法机构正在加强该地区的巡逻。

examples.sentence: Common law is based on court decisions and customs.
examples.translation_zh: 普通法是基于法庭判决和习惯的。

political.def_en: Relating to the government, politics, or public affairs.

examples.sentence: Many political parties are competing in the election.
examples.translation_zh: 许多政党在选举中竞争。

examples.sentence: The political leader spoke about important issues yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 这位政治领导者昨天谈到了重要问题。

examples.sentence: Students are preparing for the political debate next week.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们正在为下周的政治辩论做准备。

include.def_en: To contain as part of a whole or group.

examples.sentence: Teachers include information from various sources in their lessons.
examples.translation_zh: 老师在课堂上包括来自不同来源的信息。

examples.sentence: Friends often include people in their plans for the weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 朋友们通常把人们包括在他们的周末计划中。

examples.sentence: This report must include options for improving efficiency.
examples.translation_zh: 这份报告必须包括提高效率的选项。

later.def_en: At a time in the future, not now.

examples.sentence: I will call you later today about our plans.
examples.translation_zh: 我今天稍后会打电话给你，讨论我们的计划。

examples.sentence: We will have a meeting later this week to discuss changes.
examples.translation_zh: 我们本周稍后将召开会议讨论变更。

examples.sentence: You will learn more about this topic later on in class.
examples.translation_zh: 你将在课堂上稍后深入了解这个主题。

community.def_en: A group of people living in the same area.

examples.sentence: Many people in our local community help each other.
examples.translation_zh: 我们当地社区的许多人互相帮助。

examples.sentence: An online community can connect people from different countries.
examples.translation_zh: 在线社区可以连接来自不同国家的人。

examples.sentence: The scientific community often shares important research findings.
examples.translation_zh: 科学界经常分享重要的研究成果。

least.def_en: Smallest in amount, degree, or importance.

examples.sentence: You need to drink at least eight glasses of water daily.
examples.translation_zh: 你每天需要至少喝八杯水。

examples.sentence: He is the least interested student in the class.
examples.translation_zh: 他是班上最不感兴趣的学生。

examples.sentence: They are the least likely to finish the project on time.
examples.translation_zh: 他们最不可能按时完成这个项目。

continue.def_en: To keep doing something without stopping.

examples.sentence: I will continue working on the project tomorrow.
examples.translation_zh: 我明天将继续进行这个项目。

examples.sentence: Students should continue learning new skills every day.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们每天都应该继续学习新技能。

examples.sentence: The trees continue to grow despite the harsh weather.
examples.translation_zh: 尽管天气恶劣，树木依然持续生长。

president.def_en: The highest-ranking official in a country or organization.

examples.collocation: the president of the United States
examples.sentence: Many people follow the news about the president of the United States.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人关注美国总统的新闻。

examples.sentence: She was promoted to president of a company last year.
examples.translation_zh: 她去年晋升为一家公司的总裁。

examples.sentence: We listened to the president's speech at the event.
examples.translation_zh: 我们在活动中听了总统的演讲。

examples.sentence: We need to solve the real problems in our project.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要解决项目中的真实问题。

examples.sentence: Investing in real estate can be very profitable.
examples.translation_zh: 投资房地产可能非常有利可图。

examples.sentence: She made a real difference in her students' lives.
examples.translation_zh: 她在学生的生活中产生了真实的影响。

kid.def_en: A young human being, typically under the age of 13.

examples.sentence: This kid's play makes everyone laugh and smile.
examples.translation_zh: 这个小孩的玩耍让大家欢笑。

examples.sentence: Many restaurants are not kid-friendly and have few options.
examples.translation_zh: 许多餐馆不适合小孩，选择很少。

examples.sentence: Investing in kid's education is important for their future.
examples.translation_zh: 投资于小孩的教育对他们的未来很重要。

lead.def_en: To guide or direct a person or group.

examples.sentence: Managers lead a team to achieve project goals.
examples.translation_zh: 经理带领团队实现项目目标。

examples.sentence: She will lead the way to the restaurant tonight.
examples.translation_zh: 她今晚将带路去餐馆。

examples.sentence: Teachers lead discussions to engage students in learning.
examples.translation_zh: 教师引导讨论以吸引学生参与学习。

follow.def_en: To move or travel behind someone or something.

examples.sentence: Employees must always follow the rules at work.
examples.translation_zh: 员工必须始终遵守工作中的规则。

examples.sentence: Students should carefully follow the instructions for the assignment.
examples.translation_zh: 学生应仔细遵循作业的说明。

examples.sentence: We decided to follow a path through the forest.
examples.translation_zh: 我们决定沿着一条小路穿过森林。

team.def_en: A group of individuals working together towards a common goal.

examples.sentence: Employees need to work as a team to succeed.
examples.translation_zh: 员工们需要齐心协力才能成功。

examples.sentence: Many students want to join a team for sports.
examples.translation_zh: 很多学生想加入一个运动队。

examples.sentence: The professor will lead the team in the research project.
examples.translation_zh: 教授将领导这个团队进行研究项目。

create.def_en: To bring something into existence or cause it to happen.

examples.sentence: They create a plan to improve the project.
examples.translation_zh: 他们制定一个计划来改进项目。

examples.sentence: The new factory will create jobs for many people.
examples.translation_zh: 新工厂将为许多人创造就业机会。

examples.sentence: You can create a website for your online business.
examples.translation_zh: 你可以为你的在线业务创建一个网站。

social.def_en: Relating to society or its organization.

examples.sentence: Everyone uses social media to connect with friends.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人都使用社交媒体与朋友联系。

examples.sentence: Many organizations address social issues in their communities.
examples.translation_zh: 许多组织关注社区中的社会问题。

examples.sentence: Students need social interaction to develop communication skills.
examples.translation_zh: 学生需要社交互动来发展沟通能力。

centre.def_en: A point that is equally distant from all edges.

examples.sentence: People often visit the community centre for activities.
examples.translation_zh: 人们通常会去社区中心参加活动。

examples.sentence: My friends and I go to the sports centre every Saturday.
examples.translation_zh: 我和我的朋友每个星期六去体育中心。

examples.sentence: They opened a new shopping centre in our town last month.
examples.translation_zh: 他们上个月在我们镇上开了一家新的购物中心。

level.def_en: A position or rank in a scale or hierarchy.

examples.sentence: Managers often meet to discuss high level strategies.
examples.translation_zh: 经理们经常会面讨论高级策略。

examples.sentence: Students must reach a basic level of understanding.
examples.translation_zh: 学生必须达到基本的理解水平。

examples.sentence: Her skill level has improved significantly over time.
examples.translation_zh: 她的技能水平随着时间显著提高。

public.def_en: Relating to or concerning the community or people at large.

examples.sentence: The government promotes public health through various campaigns.
examples.translation_zh: 政府通过各种活动促进公众健康。

examples.sentence: Many leaders consider public opinion before making decisions.
examples.translation_zh: 许多领导人在做决定前都会考虑公众意见。

examples.sentence: Using public transport helps reduce traffic congestion in cities.
examples.translation_zh: 使用公共交通有助于减少城市交通拥堵。

allow.def_en: To give permission for something to happen.

examples.sentence: Teachers allow students to attend extra classes if needed.
examples.translation_zh: 老师允许学生在需要时参加额外的课程。

examples.sentence: The app allows users to access their documents from anywhere.
examples.translation_zh: 这个应用程序允许用户从任何地方访问他们的文件。

examples.sentence: Managers should allow time for employee feedback sessions.
examples.translation_zh: 经理们应该留出时间给员工反馈会议。

add.def_en: To join or combine something to increase its amount.

examples.sentence: You should add more details to your report.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该在报告中增加更多细节。

examples.sentence: Please add sugar to my coffee for sweetness.
examples.translation_zh: 请给我的咖啡加糖，增加甜味。

examples.sentence: We will add a new feature to the software next week.
examples.translation_zh: 我们下周将为软件增加一个新功能。

art.def_en: A form of creative expression, such as painting or music.

examples.sentence: Artists create stunning visual art that inspires many people.
examples.translation_zh: 艺术家创作令人惊叹的视觉艺术，激励了许多人。

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy attending shows of performing art regularly.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人定期享受观看表演艺术的演出。

examples.sentence: We visited an art gallery to see the latest exhibitions.
examples.translation_zh: 我们参观了一个艺术画廊，欣赏最新的展览。

result.def_en: Outcome or consequence of an action or situation.

examples.sentence: The results show that students improved their grades.
examples.translation_zh: 结果显示，学生的成绩有所提高。

examples.sentence: She studied hard, and as a result, she passed the exam.
examples.translation_zh: 她努力学习，因此通过了考试。

examples.sentence: This project results in a better workflow for the team.
examples.translation_zh: 这个项目使团队的工作流程更好。

war.def_en: A conflict between groups or countries involving armed forces.

examples.sentence: The civil war caused many people to lose their homes.
examples.translation_zh: 内战导致很多人失去了家园。

examples.sentence: Many leaders were tried for war crimes after the conflict.
examples.translation_zh: 冲突后，许多领导人因战争罪被审判。

examples.sentence: People supported the war efforts through their donations.
examples.translation_zh: 人们通过捐款支持战争努力。

history.def_en: The study of past events, particularly human affairs.

examples.sentence: Students learn about world history in school every year.
examples.translation_zh: 学生每年在学校学习世界历史。

examples.sentence: I enjoy reading history books during my free time.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢在空闲时间阅读历史书籍。

examples.sentence: Our teacher gives an interesting history lesson every Friday.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的老师每周五上有趣的历史课。

win.def_en: To achieve victory in a contest or competition.

examples.sentence: Children love to win a game during playtime.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们喜欢在玩耍时赢得比赛。

examples.sentence: This artist won a prize for her amazing sculpture.
examples.translation_zh: 这位艺术家因她出色的雕塑赢得了奖项。

examples.sentence: They hope to win the election next month.
examples.translation_zh: 他们希望下个月赢得选举。

within.def_en: In or into the interior part; inside something.

examples.sentence: You will get a reply within a few days.
examples.translation_zh: 你会在几天内收到回复。

examples.sentence: The experiment must be conducted within the limits set.
examples.translation_zh: 实验必须在设定的范围内进行。

examples.sentence: They work together within the community to help others.
examples.translation_zh: 他们在社区内共同合作，帮助他人。

guy.def_en: A man or a person in informal contexts.

examples.sentence: Many people think he is a nice guy.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人认为他是个好家伙。

examples.sentence: That guy won the award for best actor.
examples.translation_zh: 那个家伙获得了最佳男演员奖。

examples.sentence: The other guy completed the project on time.
examples.translation_zh: 另一个家伙按时完成了这个项目。

force.def_en: Strength or power used to make something happen.

examples.sentence: Many companies force people to leave their jobs.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司强迫员工离开岗位。

examples.sentence: They will force the decision to be made quickly.
examples.translation_zh: 他们将强迫迅速做出决定。

examples.sentence: Teachers often force students into action during classes.
examples.translation_zh: 老师常常在课堂上强迫学生采取行动。

offer.def_en: To present something for acceptance or consideration.

examples.sentence: Many people want to offer help to others in need.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人想要提供帮助给有需要的人。

examples.sentence: The manager will offer support to the new employees.
examples.translation_zh: 经理会给新员工提供支持。

examples.sentence: Teachers often offer advice to their students for success.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们经常给学生提供成功的建议。

education.def_en: The process of receiving or giving systematic instruction.

examples.sentence: Many students seek higher education after high school.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生在高中后寻求高等教育。

examples.sentence: Parents often look for special education programs for their children.
examples.translation_zh: 父母通常为孩子寻找特殊教育项目。

examples.sentence: Adult education helps people improve their job skills.
examples.translation_zh: 成人教育帮助人们提高工作技能。

although.def_en: In spite of the fact that; even though.

examples.sentence: I went for a walk although it was raining.
examples.translation_zh: 尽管下雨，我还是去散步了。

examples.sentence: He failed the exam although he studied hard.
examples.translation_zh: 尽管他努力学习，他还是没通过考试。

examples.sentence: The team finished the project although they disagreed.
examples.translation_zh: 尽管他们有分歧，团队还是完成了项目。

toward.def_en: In the direction of something or someone.

examples.sentence: Children often move toward their parents for help.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们通常向父母寻求帮助。

examples.sentence: Experts look toward new solutions to climate change.
examples.translation_zh: 专家们期待气候变化的新解决方案。

examples.sentence: Students work hard toward a goal of graduation.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们努力朝着毕业的目标前进。

process.def_en: A series of actions or steps to achieve something.

examples.sentence: Many companies improve the decision-making process every year.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司每年都会改善决策过程。

examples.sentence: Students often find the learning process challenging but rewarding.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们常常发现学习过程既有挑战性又有收获。

examples.sentence: The production process requires careful planning and execution.
examples.translation_zh: 生产过程需要仔细的规划和执行。

consider.def_en: Think about something carefully, especially before making a decision.

examples.sentence: You should consider the options before choosing a solution.
examples.translation_zh: 在选择解决方案之前，你应该考虑这些选项。

examples.sentence: Many people consider the impact of pollution on health.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人考虑污染对健康的影响。

examples.sentence: She will consider a proposal to go on vacation.
examples.translation_zh: 她会考虑一个去度假的提议。

research.def_en: A systematic investigation to establish facts and reach new conclusions.

examples.sentence: Many students conduct academic research for their theses.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生为他们的论文进行学术研究。

examples.sentence: Companies often perform market research to understand customers better.
examples.translation_zh: 公司经常进行市场研究，以更好地了解客户。

examples.sentence: Scientists publish their findings from scientific research regularly.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家定期发表他们的科学研究成果。

policy.def_en: A course of action adopted or pursued by an organization.

examples.sentence: The government policy aims to reduce pollution levels.
examples.translation_zh: 政府政策旨在降低污染水平。

examples.sentence: Experts discuss the new foreign policy strategies for diplomacy.
examples.translation_zh: 专家们讨论新的外交政策战略。

examples.sentence: Employees must understand the company policy on harassment.
examples.translation_zh: 员工必须了解公司对骚扰的政策。

appear.def_en: To come into sight or become visible.

examples.sentence: New studies appear in the news every week.
examples.translation_zh: 新研究每周出现在新闻中。

examples.sentence: Many experts will appear at the meeting next Monday.
examples.translation_zh: 许多专家将在下周一的会议上出现。

examples.sentence: Cars can appear suddenly on the road when driving.
examples.translation_zh: 开车时，汽车可能会突然出现在路上。

actually.def_en: In fact; used to emphasize the truth of a statement.

examples.sentence: This method actually works better than the previous one.
examples.translation_zh: 这种方法实际上比之前的方法更有效。

examples.sentence: Do you actually think this is a good idea?
examples.translation_zh: 你实际上认为这是一个好主意吗？

examples.sentence: The word actually means something different in this context.
examples.translation_zh: 在这个语境中，这个词实际上意味着不同的东西。

sense.def_en: A physical perception or feeling from stimuli.

examples.sentence: Many people appreciate a good sense of humor.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人欣赏良好的幽默感。

examples.sentence: Students should develop common sense in practical situations.
examples.translation_zh: 学生应该在实际情况下培养常识。

examples.sentence: He showed a sense of urgency during the project.
examples.translation_zh: 在项目中，他表现出紧迫感。

probably.def_en: Used to indicate that something is likely to happen.

examples.sentence: This theory is probably true based on the evidence.
examples.translation_zh: 根据证据，这个理论大概是正确的。

examples.sentence: You will probably see her at the party tonight.
examples.translation_zh: 你今晚很可能会在聚会上见到她。

examples.sentence: They probably won't approve the new law this week.
examples.translation_zh: 他们这周很可能不会批准新法律。

nation.def_en: A large group of people united by common characteristics.

examples.sentence: The nation faces many challenges in the coming years.
examples.translation_zh: 国家在未来几年面临许多挑战。

examples.sentence: Nations around the world celebrate their unique traditions.
examples.translation_zh: 世界各国庆祝他们独特的传统。

examples.sentence: A strong nation needs an educated and healthy population.
examples.translation_zh: 一个强大的国家需要受过教育和健康的人民。

interest.def_en: A feeling of wanting to know or learn about something.

examples.sentence: Many children show interest in animals and nature.
examples.translation_zh: 许多孩子对动物和自然表现出兴趣。

examples.sentence: Students should take an interest in their studies and homework.
examples.translation_zh: 学生应该对自己的学习和作业感兴趣。

examples.sentence: She expressed interest in joining the new project team.
examples.translation_zh: 她对加入新的项目团队表示了兴趣。

human.def_en: Relating to people or mankind; a person.

examples.sentence: Many countries protect the rights of human beings.
examples.translation_zh: 许多国家保护人类的权利。

examples.sentence: Researchers study human behavior to understand social interactions.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员研究人类行为以了解社会互动。

examples.sentence: Our company is expanding its human resources department this year.
examples.translation_zh: 我们公司今年正在扩展人力资源部。

death.def_en: The end of life; the permanent cessation of all biological functions.

examples.sentence: Heart disease is a leading cause of death worldwide.
examples.translation_zh: 心脏病是全球主要的死亡原因。

examples.sentence: Some people report a near death experience during surgeries.
examples.translation_zh: 一些人在手术中报告了濒死体验。

examples.sentence: The death rate in the country has significantly increased this year.
examples.translation_zh: 今年该国的死亡率显著上升。

course.def_en: A series of classes or lectures on a particular subject.

examples.sentence: I want to take a course in computer programming this year.
examples.translation_zh: 我想今年上计算机编程课程。

examples.sentence: Students must fulfill all course requirements to graduate.
examples.translation_zh: 学生必须完成所有课程要求才能毕业。

examples.sentence: Of course, I will help you with your homework.
examples.translation_zh: 当然，我会帮你做作业。

local.def_en: Relating to a particular area or neighborhood.

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy working with local community groups.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人喜欢与当地社区团体合作。

examples.sentence: The local economy is improving thanks to new businesses.
examples.translation_zh: 由于新企业的出现，当地经济正在改善。

examples.sentence: She loves trying different types of local food when traveling.
examples.translation_zh: 她喜欢在旅行中尝试不同种类的当地食物。

reach.def_en: To arrive at or attain a destination or goal.

examples.sentence: After long discussions, both sides reached an agreement.
examples.translation_zh: 经过长时间的讨论，双方达成了协议。

examples.sentence: Researchers reached a conclusion based on their findings.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员根据他们的发现得出了结论。

examples.sentence: When feeling lost, many people reach for help from friends.
examples.translation_zh: 当感到迷茫时，许多人向朋友寻求帮助。

remain.def_en: To continue to exist or stay in the same place.

examples.sentence: You should remain calm during a stressful situation.
examples.translation_zh: 在压力大的情况下，你应该保持冷静。

examples.sentence: Students must remain interested in their studies to succeed.
examples.translation_zh: 学生必须对学习保持兴趣，才能成功。

examples.sentence: Employees should remain aware of company policies at all times.
examples.translation_zh: 员工应该始终对公司政策保持了解。

experience.def_en: Knowledge or skill gained through involvement or exposure.

examples.sentence: Many people have an experience that changes their life.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人有过改变他们生活的经历。

examples.sentence: Students can gain experience through internships and part-time jobs.
examples.translation_zh: 学生可以通过实习和兼职工作获得经验。

examples.sentence: We often share an experience during our family gatherings.
examples.translation_zh: 我们在家庭聚会上经常分享经历。

kill.def_en: To cause the death of someone or something.

examples.sentence: I often kill time by reading a book in the park.
examples.translation_zh: 我常常通过在公园里读书来打发时间。

examples.sentence: Overwatering can easily kill a plant if not careful.
examples.translation_zh: 如果不小心，浇水过多会很容易杀死植物。

examples.sentence: Many people would kill for a chance to work in that company.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人为了有机会在那家公司工作愿意不惜一切。

control.def_en: To exercise power or influence over something.

examples.sentence: To manage stress, we must control the situation carefully.
examples.translation_zh: 为了管理压力，我们必须小心控制局势。

examples.sentence: Employees should learn to control their emotions effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 员工应该学会有效地控制情绪。

examples.sentence: Scientists can control the environment in their experiments.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家可以在实验中控制环境。

effect.def_en: A change that is a result or consequence of an action.

examples.sentence: Smoking can have a negative effect on your health.
examples.translation_zh: 吸烟会对你的健康产生负面影响。

examples.sentence: Understanding cause and effect helps students learn better.
examples.translation_zh: 理解因果关系有助于学生更好地学习。

examples.sentence: Some medications may cause side effects that are unpleasant.
examples.translation_zh: 一些药物可能会引起不良的副作用。

major.def_en: Of great importance or significance; very large in size.

examples.sentence: They have to make a major decision this week.
examples.translation_zh: 他们这周必须做出一个重要的决定。

examples.sentence: The party was a major event in our town.
examples.translation_zh: 这个聚会是我们镇上的一个重要活动。

examples.sentence: A major change is coming to the school system.
examples.translation_zh: 学校系统将迎来一个重大变化。

require.def_en: To have a necessity for something or someone.

examples.sentence: You require help to finish this project successfully.
examples.translation_zh: 你需要帮助来顺利完成这个项目。

examples.sentence: She requires permission to access the confidential files.
examples.translation_zh: 她需要许可才能访问机密文件。

examples.sentence: Many schools require funding for new educational programs.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学校需要资金来支持新的教育项目。

role.def_en: A function or part played by someone or something.

examples.sentence: Many people play a role in their community.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在他们的社区中扮演角色。

examples.sentence: Parents can be important role models for their children.
examples.translation_zh: 父母可以是孩子们的重要榜样。

examples.sentence: She has taken on a leadership role in the project.
examples.translation_zh: 她在这个项目中担任了领导角色。

effort.def_en: A determined attempt to accomplish something difficult.

examples.sentence: Students should make an effort to study every day.
examples.translation_zh: 学生应该努力每天学习。

examples.sentence: She puts a lot of effort into her projects at work.
examples.translation_zh: 她在工作项目上投入了很多努力。

examples.sentence: An effort was made to improve the school's facilities.
examples.translation_zh: 为了改善学校设施，付出了努力。

economic.def_en: Relating to the production, distribution, and use of goods and services.

examples.sentence: The country is experiencing strong economic growth this year.
examples.translation_zh: 这个国家今年经历了强劲的经济增长。

examples.sentence: Many families are affected by the recent economic crisis.
examples.translation_zh: 许多家庭受到近期经济危机的影响。

examples.sentence: Understanding economic benefits is important for future decisions.
examples.translation_zh: 理解经济利益对未来的决策很重要。

perhaps.def_en: Used to express uncertainty or possibility.

examples.sentence: We could go to the park; perhaps it will be fun.
examples.translation_zh: 我们可以去公园，或许会很有趣。

examples.collocation: it might be perhaps too late
examples.sentence: It is getting dark; perhaps it is too late to go out.
examples.translation_zh: 天黑了，或许已经太晚了。

examples.sentence: You are unsure; perhaps you should ask for help.
examples.translation_zh: 你不确定，或许你应该请求帮助。

drug.def_en: A substance used to treat or prevent illness.

examples.sentence: Authorities are cracking down on illegal drugs in the city.
examples.translation_zh: 当局正在打击城市里的非法药物。

examples.sentence: Many people struggle with drug addiction every day.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人每天与药物成瘾作斗争。

examples.sentence: You can only buy prescription drugs at the pharmacy.
examples.translation_zh: 你只能在药店购买处方药。

rate.def_en: A measure or evaluation of something's quality or value.

examples.sentence: Many people worry about the current interest rate.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人担心当前的利率。

examples.sentence: The exchange rate between currencies can change quickly.
examples.translation_zh: 货币之间的汇率可以迅速变化。

examples.sentence: Students want to know the success rate of this program.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们想知道这个项目的成功率。

voice.def_en: Sound produced by human or animal vocal cords.

examples.sentence: Many citizens raised their voice of the people.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公民表达了人民的声音。

examples.sentence: Students should learn to find their voice in class.
examples.translation_zh: 学生应在课堂上学会找到自己的声音。

examples.sentence: She has a strong voice that everyone can hear.
examples.translation_zh: 她的声音很大，大家都能听到。

whole.def_en: Entire; complete without any part missing.

examples.sentence: Everyone wants to see the whole world someday.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人都想在某天看到整个世界。

examples.sentence: She explained the whole thing to me clearly.
examples.translation_zh: 她清楚地向我解释了整个事情。

examples.sentence: The whole class enjoyed the science experiment together.
examples.translation_zh: 全班同学一起享受了这个科学实验。

police.def_en: A public officer responsible for maintaining law and order.

examples.sentence: The police arrested a suspect in the robbery.
examples.translation_zh: 警察逮捕了一名抢劫嫌疑犯。

examples.sentence: If you see something suspicious, call the police immediately.
examples.translation_zh: 如果你看到可疑的事情，立刻拨打警察电话。

examples.sentence: A police officer helped the lost child find their parents.
examples.translation_zh: 一名警察帮助这个迷路的孩子找到父母。

finally.def_en: After a long time or delay; at last.

examples.sentence: She finally finished her project after many late nights.
examples.translation_zh: 经过很多个熬夜，她终于完成了项目。

examples.sentence: They finally arrived at the hotel after a long journey.
examples.translation_zh: 经过漫长的旅程，他们终于到达了酒店。

examples.sentence: He finally decided to take the job after thinking it over.
examples.translation_zh: 经过思考，他终于决定接受这份工作。

leader.def_en: A person who leads or guides others.

examples.sentence: A team leader helps group members to achieve goals.
examples.translation_zh: 团队领导帮助组员实现目标。

examples.sentence: Many business leaders attended the annual conference this year.
examples.translation_zh: 许多商业领袖参加了今年的年度会议。

examples.sentence: Parents often respect their community leader for his work.
examples.translation_zh: 家长们常常尊重他们社区的领导者。

less.def_en: Smaller in amount or degree than something else.

examples.sentence: I need less time to finish my homework.
examples.translation_zh: 我需要更少的时间来完成作业。

examples.sentence: They earn less money than their colleagues do.
examples.translation_zh: 他们的收入比同事少。

examples.sentence: You can achieve more with less effort if you focus.
examples.translation_zh: 如果你专注，能以更少的努力取得更多成果。

explain.def_en: Make something clear or easy to understand.

examples.sentence: Teachers explain the process of photosynthesis in class.
examples.translation_zh: 老师在课堂上解释光合作用的过程。

examples.sentence: Managers should explain the rules to new employees clearly.
examples.translation_zh: 经理应该清楚地向新员工解释规则。

examples.sentence: Can you explain it to me in simple words?
examples.translation_zh: 你能用简单的话给我解释一下吗？

decision.def_en: A choice made after thinking about something.

examples.sentence: You need to make an important decision today.
examples.translation_zh: 你今天需要做一个重要的决定。

examples.sentence: Our team reached a final decision after much discussion.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的团队经过讨论达成了最终决定。

examples.sentence: Choosing a major can be a difficult decision for students.
examples.translation_zh: 选择专业对学生来说可能是一个困难的决定。

view.def_en: The ability to see or perceive something.

examples.sentence: I love the view of the city from this hill.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢从这座山上看到的城市景观。

examples.sentence: Many experts have a different view on the issue.
examples.translation_zh: 许多专家对这个问题有不同的看法。

examples.sentence: She enjoys the beautiful view from her window.
examples.translation_zh: 她喜欢窗外美丽的风景。

military.def_en: Relating to armed forces or soldiers.

examples.sentence: Many countries are increasing their military forces for defense.
examples.translation_zh: 许多国家正在增加他们的军事力量以进行防御。

examples.sentence: They provide military training to new recruits every year.
examples.translation_zh: 他们每年为新兵提供军事训练。

examples.sentence: The company develops advanced military equipment for various uses.
examples.translation_zh: 该公司开发用于多种用途的先进军事装备。

difference.def_en: A way in which two or more things are not the same.

examples.sentence: Scientists found a significant difference in the results.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家发现结果有显著差异。

examples.sentence: We learned about cultural difference during our travels.
examples.translation_zh: 我们在旅行中了解了文化差异。

examples.sentence: You will notice a difference after exercising regularly.
examples.translation_zh: 你在定期锻炼后会注意到差异。

federal.def_en: Relating to a central government that shares power with states.

examples.sentence: The federal government announced new policies for education.
examples.translation_zh: 联邦政府宣布了新的教育政策。

examples.sentence: Employees must comply with federal law regarding safety regulations.
examples.translation_zh: 员工必须遵守有关安全法规的联邦法律。

examples.sentence: Many schools rely on federal funding for their programs.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学校依靠联邦资金来支持他们的项目。

value.def_en: The importance or worth of something.

examples.sentence: Many companies assess the monetary value of their assets.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司评估其资产的货币价值。

examples.sentence: She believes cultural value is important for society.
examples.translation_zh: 她认为文化价值对社会很重要。

examples.sentence: A strong value system can guide students' decisions.
examples.translation_zh: 一个强大的价值体系可以指导学生的决策。

relationship.def_en: The way in which two or more people or groups connect.

examples.sentence: She values her personal relationships with friends and family.
examples.translation_zh: 她重视与朋友和家人的个人关系。

examples.sentence: They have a close relationship that helps their teamwork.
examples.translation_zh: 他们的密切关系帮助了他们的团队合作。

examples.sentence: Understanding a business relationship is important for success.
examples.translation_zh: 理解商业关系对成功很重要。

action.def_en: A thing done or performed; a deed.

examples.sentence: People need to take action against climate change.
examples.translation_zh: 人们需要采取行动应对气候变化。

examples.sentence: The report issued a call to action for better policies.
examples.translation_zh: 报告发出了呼吁，要求改善政策。

examples.sentence: We need to discuss the best course of action now.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要现在讨论最佳行动方案。

international.def_en: Relating to or involving multiple countries or nations.

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy international travel for new experiences.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人喜欢国际旅行以获得新体验。

examples.sentence: Improving international relations is essential for global peace.
examples.translation_zh: 改善国际关系对全球和平至关重要。

examples.sentence: International students often face unique challenges in schools.
examples.translation_zh: 国际学生在学校中常常面临独特的挑战。

tax.def_en: A financial charge imposed by a government on income or goods.

examples.sentence: Businesses must pay income tax on their earnings.
examples.translation_zh: 公司必须对其收入缴纳所得税。

examples.sentence: Many products have a sales tax added at checkout.
examples.translation_zh: 许多产品在结账时会增加销售税。

examples.sentence: Residents are concerned about rising property tax rates.
examples.translation_zh: 居民们对不断上涨的房产税率感到担忧。

model.def_en: A representation or example of something.

examples.sentence: She wants to become a famous fashion model one day.
examples.translation_zh: 她希望有一天成为一个著名的时尚模特。

examples.sentence: Teachers encourage students to show model behavior in class.
examples.translation_zh: 老师鼓励学生在课堂上表现出模范行为。

examples.sentence: Researchers developed a model system for studying cell growth.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员开发了一个用于研究细胞生长的模型系统。

director.def_en: A person who oversees and directs a film or play.

examples.sentence: Many famous actors work with a skilled film director.
examples.translation_zh: 许多著名演员与一位技艺高超的电影导演合作。

examples.sentence: The executive director manages the entire organization effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 执行董事有效地管理整个组织。

examples.sentence: A music director leads the school choir during practice.
examples.translation_zh: 音乐主任在排练时带领学校合唱团。

position.def_en: A place or role occupied by someone or something.

examples.sentence: Many companies require a job position to be filled quickly.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司需要尽快填补职位。

examples.sentence: The geographical position of the city affects its climate.
examples.translation_zh: 这座城市的地理位置影响它的气候。

examples.sentence: He commented on his current position regarding the issue.
examples.translation_zh: 他对这个问题的当前立场进行了评论。

player.def_en: A person who participates in a game or activity.

examples.sentence: Being a team player is important in our office.
examples.translation_zh: 在我们办公室，成为团队合作的参与者很重要。

examples.sentence: Many video game players compete in international tournaments.
examples.translation_zh: 许多电子游戏参与者在国际比赛中竞争。

examples.sentence: A professional player can earn a lot of money.
examples.translation_zh: 职业参与者可以赚很多钱。

special.def_en: Different from the usual or ordinary in some way.

examples.sentence: We are planning a special event for our anniversary.
examples.translation_zh: 我们正在为我们的周年纪念筹划一个特别的活动。

examples.sentence: The store has a special offer for new customers this week.
examples.translation_zh: 本周商店为新客户提供特别优惠。

examples.sentence: Patients with allergies need special care during treatment.
examples.translation_zh: 对过敏患者在治疗期间需要特别照顾。

especially.def_en: Used to indicate something is more significant or noteworthy.

examples.sentence: Teachers focus on helping students, especially in education.
examples.translation_zh: 教师特别关注帮助学生，尤其是在教育方面。

examples.sentence: I enjoy hot drinks, especially during winter evenings.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢热饮，尤其是在冬天的晚上。

examples.sentence: This movie is fun, especially for kids and families.
examples.translation_zh: 这部电影很有趣，尤其是对儿童和家庭来说。

space.def_en: A continuous area or expanse that is free, available, or unoccupied.

examples.sentence: Astronauts travel to outer space for research missions.
examples.translation_zh: 宇航员前往外太空进行研究任务。

examples.sentence: She needs more living space for her family.
examples.translation_zh: 她需要更多的居住空间来容纳家人。

examples.sentence: Everyone deserves their own personal space at work.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人在工作中都应有自己的个人空间。

record.def_en: A written account of something, or an audio document.

examples.sentence: She enjoys listening to music on her record player.
examples.translation_zh: 她喜欢在唱片机上听音乐。

examples.sentence: He broke the world record in the 100-meter race.
examples.translation_zh: 他在100米比赛中打破了世界纪录。

examples.sentence: The band signed with a major record company last year.
examples.translation_zh: 这支乐队去年与一家大型唱片公司签约。

event.def_en: An occurrence, especially one of significance or interest.

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy visiting cultural events during summer.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人喜欢在夏天参加文化活动。

examples.sentence: We are excited to watch the sports events this weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 我们很期待本周末观看体育赛事。

examples.sentence: A major event will take place in the city next month.
examples.translation_zh: 下个月城市将举行一项重大活动。

support.def_en: To give assistance or help to someone or something.

examples.sentence: Many families need financial support during tough times.
examples.translation_zh: 许多家庭在艰难时期需要经济支持。

examples.sentence: Employees are encouraged to support the team during projects.
examples.translation_zh: 员工被鼓励在项目期间支持团队。

examples.sentence: There is a strong support for education in our community.
examples.translation_zh: 我们社区对教育有很强的支持。

couple.def_en: Two people in a romantic relationship or partnership.

examples.sentence: I will finish the project in a couple of days.
examples.translation_zh: 我会在几天内完成这个项目。

examples.sentence: She invited a couple of friends to the party.
examples.translation_zh: 她邀请了几位朋友参加聚会。

examples.sentence: The report will take a couple of weeks to complete.
examples.translation_zh: 这份报告需要几周才能完成。

project.def_en: A planned piece of work with specific goals.

examples.sentence: Many students are working on their research projects this semester.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生正在进行他们的研究项目。

examples.sentence: Our team started a community project to help the homeless.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的团队启动了一个帮助无家可归者的社区项目。

examples.sentence: She completed her art project for the school exhibition.
examples.translation_zh: 她为学校展览完成了她的艺术项目。

examples.sentence: We will hit the road early in the morning.
examples.translation_zh: 我们将在早上出发。

examples.sentence: She managed to hit her sales target this month.
examples.translation_zh: 她这个月成功达成了销售目标。

examples.sentence: The story hit the headlines across the country yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 这个故事昨天登上了全国的头条。

activity.def_en: A thing that a person or group does.

examples.sentence: Engaging in regular physical activity is very important for health.
examples.translation_zh: 定期参加身体活动对健康非常重要。

examples.sentence: Students enjoyed various class activities during the school year.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在学年中享受了各种课堂活动。

examples.sentence: Families like to plan outdoor activities during the summer.
examples.translation_zh: 家庭喜欢在夏季计划户外活动。

base.def_en: Foundation or starting point of something, often a place.

examples.sentence: They live near a military base in the city.
examples.translation_zh: 他们住在城市一个军事基地附近。

examples.sentence: Our team will use the new office as our base of operations.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的团队将新办公室作为我们的工作基地。

examples.sentence: The base layer of the software ensures stability and performance.
examples.translation_zh: 软件的基础层确保了稳定性和性能。

oil.def_en: A viscous liquid used for fuel or cooking.

examples.sentence: She bought a bottle of cooking oil yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 她昨天买了一瓶食用油。

examples.sentence: Crude oil prices have increased significantly this month.
examples.translation_zh: 原油价格本月已大幅上涨。

examples.sentence: Mechanics change motor oil to keep engines running smoothly.
examples.translation_zh: 修理工更换机油以保持发动机平稳运转。

produce.def_en: To create or bring forth something, especially in agriculture.

examples.sentence: Farmers produce food for local markets every season.
examples.translation_zh: 农民每个季节为当地市场生产食物。

examples.sentence: Our team aims to produce results that benefit everyone involved.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的团队旨在产生有利于所有人的结果。

examples.sentence: Scientists need to produce data to support their theories.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家需要生成数据来支持他们的理论。

figure.def_en: A numeric symbol or a shape representing something.

examples.sentence: I need to figure out how to fix this.
examples.translation_zh: 我需要想办法修好这个。

examples.sentence: She is a talented figure skater in our town.
examples.translation_zh: 她是我们镇上才华横溢的花样滑冰选手。

examples.sentence: A metaphor is a common figure of speech used in writing.
examples.translation_zh: 隐喻是写作中常用的修辞手法。

situation.def_en: A set of circumstances or conditions surrounding someone or something.

examples.sentence: They faced a difficult situation during the storm.
examples.translation_zh: 他们在暴风雨中面临困难的情况。

examples.sentence: I need to understand the current situation at home.
examples.translation_zh: 我需要了解家里的现状。

examples.sentence: The team handled the emergency situation very well.
examples.translation_zh: 团队处理紧急情况非常好。

phone.def_en: A device used for voice communication over distances.

examples.sentence: I need to make a phone call to my friend.
examples.translation_zh: 我需要给我的朋友打个电话。

examples.sentence: Can you answer the phone while I am busy?
examples.translation_zh: 你能在我忙的时候接电话吗？

examples.sentence: Please write down your phone number on the form.
examples.translation_zh: 请在表格上写下你的电话号码。

industry.def_en: Economic activity concerned with the production of goods.

examples.sentence: Many people work in the manufacturing industry today.
examples.translation_zh: 今天，很多人都在制造业工作。

examples.sentence: The service industry provides many jobs in our city.
examples.translation_zh: 服务行业在我们城市提供了很多就业机会。

examples.sentence: Creative industries are growing rapidly in the modern economy.
examples.translation_zh: 创意产业在现代经济中迅速发展。

image.def_en: A representation of the external form of something.

examples.sentence: Photographers often use software to edit digital images.
examples.translation_zh: 摄影师通常使用软件编辑数字图像。

examples.sentence: This museum displays a famous image of historical significance.
examples.translation_zh: 这座博物馆展示了一幅具有历史意义的著名图像。

examples.sentence: Students need a clear image of the topic to understand it well.
examples.translation_zh: 学生需要对这个主题有清晰的图像才能很好地理解。

data.def_en: Facts or information collected for analysis or reference.

examples.sentence: She completed the data analysis for the project this week.
examples.translation_zh: 她本周完成了这个项目的数据分析。

examples.sentence: The new law focuses on data protection for online users.
examples.translation_zh: 新法律关注在线用户的数据保护。

examples.sentence: Researchers started the data collection process last month.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员上个月开始了数据收集过程。

recent.def_en: Having happened or been made not long ago.

examples.sentence: Researchers published recent studies on climate change effects.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员发表了关于气候变化影响的最近研究。

examples.sentence: The recent news about the economy worried many citizens.
examples.translation_zh: 关于经济的最近消息使许多市民感到担忧。

examples.sentence: They discussed recent events during the family dinner.
examples.translation_zh: 他们在家庭晚餐时讨论了最近的事件。

describe.def_en: To give details about someone or something.

examples.sentence: Scientists describe the results of their experiments in detail.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家详细描述了他们实验的结果。

examples.sentence: Managers need to describe the problem clearly to the team.
examples.translation_zh: 经理需要清楚地向团队描述问题。

examples.sentence: She can describe the scene of the park very well.
examples.translation_zh: 她能很好地描述公园的场景。

product.def_en: An item produced for sale or use.

examples.sentence: Many people buy a new consumer product each year.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人每年购买一种新的消费品。

examples.sentence: Our team is excited about the new product launch next month.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的团队对下个月的新产品发布感到兴奋。

examples.sentence: Developers create a software product to solve specific problems.
examples.translation_zh: 开发人员创建软件产品以解决特定问题。

test.def_en: An assessment to measure knowledge or skills.

examples.sentence: Students will take a test on Friday to assess their progress.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们将在星期五进行一次测试，以评估他们的进展。

examples.sentence: Doctors are waiting for the test results to confirm the diagnosis.
examples.translation_zh: 医生在等待检测结果以确认诊断。

examples.sentence: The team plans to test new products before the launch next month.
examples.translation_zh: 团队计划在下个月发布之前测试新产品。

patient.def_en: A person receiving medical treatment or a quality of being calm.

examples.sentence: Doctors provide excellent patient care at this hospital.
examples.translation_zh: 医生们在这家医院提供优质的病人护理。

examples.sentence: You will need to be patient while waiting for your turn.
examples.translation_zh: 你在等待的时候需要耐心。

examples.sentence: A patient attitude helps in resolving workplace conflicts.
examples.translation_zh: 耐心的态度有助于解决工作场所冲突。

movie.def_en: A series of moving images that tell a story.

examples.sentence: Friends often watch a movie together on weekends.
examples.translation_zh: 朋友们常常在周末一起看电影。

examples.sentence: I heard the new movie is very exciting and funny.
examples.translation_zh: 我听说这部新电影非常刺激且搞笑。

examples.sentence: She bought a movie ticket for the latest film release.
examples.translation_zh: 她买了一张最新电影的票。

technology.def_en: The application of scientific knowledge for practical purposes.

examples.sentence: New technology is changing how we communicate every day.
examples.translation_zh: 新科技正在改变我们每天沟通的方式。

examples.sentence: Many people rely on modern technology for their daily tasks.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人依赖现代科技来完成日常工作。

examples.sentence: Assistive technology helps students with disabilities learn better.
examples.translation_zh: 辅助科技帮助残疾学生更好地学习。

step.def_en: A movement made by lifting the foot and putting it down.

examples.sentence: You should take a step back to think clearly.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该退一步，冷静思考。

examples.sentence: He decided to step forward and lead the project.
examples.translation_zh: 他决定站出来，领导这个项目。

examples.sentence: The next step is to complete your homework on time.
examples.translation_zh: 下一步是按时完成你的作业。

type.def_en: A category of things sharing common characteristics.

examples.sentence: I enjoy every type of music, especially pop.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢各种类型的音乐，尤其是流行音乐。

examples.sentence: This type of study helps students learn effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 这种学习类型帮助学生有效地学习。

examples.sentence: Many people prefer this type of food for dinner.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人喜欢这种类型的食物作为晚餐。

personal.def_en: Relating to an individual person rather than a group.

examples.sentence: People often share personal information on social media.
examples.translation_zh: 人们常在社交媒体上分享个人信息。

examples.sentence: Students learn from their personal experiences in school.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在学校里从个人经验中学习。

examples.sentence: Remember to pack your personal belongings before leaving.
examples.translation_zh: 离开之前记得打包好你的个人物品。

source.def_en: A place, person, or thing from which something originates.

examples.sentence: Researchers often seek a reliable source of information.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员常常寻找可靠的信息来源。

examples.sentence: Solar panels provide a clean energy source for homes.
examples.translation_zh: 太阳能板为家庭提供清洁的能源来源。

examples.sentence: The company needs to identify a source of funds.
examples.translation_zh: 公司需要确定一个资金来源。

republican.def_en: A person supporting a government by elected representatives.

examples.sentence: Many people support the republican party in elections.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在选举中支持共和党。

examples.sentence: She believes in republican values and individual freedoms.
examples.translation_zh: 她相信共和价值观和个人自由。

examples.sentence: He is a republican candidate for the local council.
examples.translation_zh: 他是地方议会的共和党候选人。

attention.def_en: The act of focusing the mind on something.

examples.sentence: Students need to pay attention during the lecture.
examples.translation_zh: 学生在讲座期间需要注意听。

examples.sentence: The new policy will draw attention from many experts.
examples.translation_zh: 新政策将引起许多专家的关注。

examples.sentence: Parents should give attention to their children's needs.
examples.translation_zh: 父母应该关注孩子的需求。

organization.def_en: A group of people working together for a common purpose.

examples.sentence: Many people volunteer for a nonprofit organization in the city.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在城市的非营利组织做志愿者。

examples.sentence: She works for an international organization that helps refugees.
examples.translation_zh: 她在一个帮助难民的国际组织工作。

examples.sentence: Joining a professional organization can help your career growth.
examples.translation_zh: 加入专业组织可以帮助你的职业发展。

choose.def_en: To pick something from a range of options.

examples.sentence: Students must choose the best option for their project.
examples.translation_zh: 学生必须为他们的项目选择最佳选项。

examples.sentence: We usually choose a restaurant for dinner together.
examples.translation_zh: 我们通常一起选择一家餐厅吃晚餐。

examples.sentence: You should choose your words carefully in this meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 在这次会议上，你应该仔细选择你的用词。

evidence.def_en: Facts or information indicating whether a belief or proposition is true.

examples.sentence: Scientists need scientific evidence to support their claims.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家需要科学证据来支持他们的说法。

examples.sentence: They found clear evidence of the project's success.
examples.translation_zh: 他们发现了项目成功的明确证据。

examples.sentence: Historical evidence helps us understand past events better.
examples.translation_zh: 历史证据帮助我们更好地理解过去的事件。

century.def_en: A period of one hundred years.

examples.sentence: Many people believe the twenty-first century will be challenging.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人认为二十一世纪将会充满挑战。

examples.sentence: The nineteenth century saw many changes in technology and society.
examples.translation_zh: 十九世纪见证了科技和社会的许多变化。

examples.sentence: A century ago, life was very different from today.
examples.translation_zh: 一个世纪前，生活与今天大相径庭。

billion.def_en: A number equal to one thousand million.

examples.sentence: The company earned over a billion dollars last year.
examples.translation_zh: 该公司去年赚取了超过十亿美元。

examples.sentence: About two billion people use social media worldwide.
examples.translation_zh: 全球约有二十亿人使用社交媒体。

examples.sentence: This technology is used billions of times each day.
examples.translation_zh: 这种技术每天使用数十亿次。

cause.def_zh: 原因；引起某事的事物或行为
cause.def_en: A reason for an action or situation.

examples.sentence: They cause problems when they don't follow the rules.
examples.translation_zh: 当他们不遵守规则时，会造成问题。

examples.sentence: High pollution levels cause concern among local residents.
examples.translation_zh: 高污染水平引起了当地居民的担忧。

examples.sentence: This decision may cause a change in local wildlife.
examples.translation_zh: 这个决定可能会导致当地野生动物的变化。

chance.def_en: A possibility of something happening or being done.

examples.sentence: You should take a chance and try something new.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该抓住机会，尝试一些新事物。

examples.sentence: Everyone has a chance to win the competition this year.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人今年都有机会赢得比赛。

examples.sentence: This is your last chance to see the show tonight.
examples.translation_zh: 这是你今晚观看演出的最后机会。

energy.def_en: The capacity to do work or cause change.

examples.sentence: Renewable energy is important for a sustainable future.
examples.translation_zh: 可再生能源对可持续未来很重要。

examples.sentence: She exercises to increase her physical energy every day.
examples.translation_zh: 她每天锻炼以提高自己的体力。

examples.sentence: He feels tired, so his energy levels are low today.
examples.translation_zh: 他感到疲倦，所以今天精力水平很低。

realize.def_en: To become aware of something or understand it clearly.

examples.sentence: Students need to realize the importance of studying hard.
examples.translation_zh: 学生需要意识到努力学习的重要性。

examples.sentence: She began to realize that she needed more time to relax.
examples.translation_zh: 她开始意识到自己需要更多的放松时间。

examples.sentence: They will realize a goal by working together effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 他们将通过有效合作实现目标。

opportunity.def_en: A chance to do something or achieve a goal.

examples.sentence: Many job opportunities are available in the city.
examples.translation_zh: 这个城市有很多工作机会。

examples.sentence: Students should seek learning opportunities outside the classroom.
examples.translation_zh: 学生应该在课堂外寻找学习机会。

examples.sentence: This is a great opportunity to meet new friends.
examples.translation_zh: 这是结识新朋友的好机会。

available.def_en: Able to be used or obtained; accessible.

examples.sentence: Many available resources can help students learn better.
examples.translation_zh: 许多可用的资源可以帮助学生更好地学习。

examples.sentence: Journalists need accurate and available information for their stories.
examples.translation_zh: 记者需要准确且可获得的信息来撰写报道。

examples.sentence: There are several available options for lunch today.
examples.translation_zh: 今天有几种可用的午餐选择。

likely.def_en: Probable or expected to happen; having a good chance.

examples.sentence: She is likely to succeed in her new job.
examples.translation_zh: 她在新工作中很可能会成功。

examples.sentence: It is likely to be a busy day for the team.
examples.translation_zh: 对于团队来说，这一天可能会很忙。

examples.sentence: The likely outcome of the experiment is still unknown.
examples.translation_zh: 这个实验的可能结果仍然未知。

condition.def_en: A state or situation that must be met.

examples.sentence: Many workers are unhappy with their working conditions.
examples.translation_zh: 许多工人对他们的工作条件不满意。

examples.sentence: She has a serious health condition that requires treatment.
examples.translation_zh: 她有一种严重的健康状况，需要治疗。

examples.sentence: The condition of the environment is getting worse every year.
examples.translation_zh: 环境的状况每年都在恶化。

term.def_en: A word or phrase used in a specific context.

examples.sentence: Students must study hard during the academic term.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在学期期间必须努力学习。

examples.sentence: He agreed to the contract term for his new job.
examples.translation_zh: 他同意了新工作的合同条款。

examples.sentence: Many people use the same search term online.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在线使用相同的搜索词。

period.def_en: A length of time during which something happens.

examples.sentence: Classes will start after the long school period ends.
examples.translation_zh: 上课将在漫长的上课时间结束后开始。

examples.sentence: She experiences cramps during her menstrual period each month.
examples.translation_zh: 她每个月的月经期间都会感到腹痛。

examples.sentence: Many people travel during the holiday time period of summer.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在暑假的假期期间出行。

choice.def_en: An act of selecting or making a decision.

examples.sentence: Making a choice can be very difficult sometimes.
examples.translation_zh: 做选择有时会很困难。

examples.sentence: Students have a choice between many interesting courses.
examples.translation_zh: 学生可以选择许多有趣的课程。

examples.sentence: A wrong choice can lead to serious problems at work.
examples.translation_zh: 错误的选择可能会导致工作中的严重问题。

rule.def_en: A statement that guides actions or decisions.

examples.sentence: Children should always follow the rules at school.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们在学校应该始终遵守规则。

examples.sentence: Managers often set rules to improve team performance.
examples.translation_zh: 经理们通常制定规则以提高团队表现。

examples.sentence: Students can be punished if they break the rules.
examples.translation_zh: 如果学生违反规则，他们可能会受到惩罚。

administration.def_en: The process or activity of organizing and overseeing.

examples.sentence: Government administration often faces many challenges every day.
examples.translation_zh: 政府管理每天常常面临许多挑战。

examples.sentence: School administration helps to maintain order and discipline at schools.
examples.translation_zh: 学校管理有助于维持学校的秩序和纪律。

examples.sentence: Many students choose business administration as their major in college.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生在大学选择商业管理作为他们的专业。

congress.def_en: A formal meeting of representatives to discuss issues.

examples.sentence: Many senators attended the congress meets this week.
examples.translation_zh: 许多参议员本周参加了国会会议。

examples.sentence: Members of congress often debate important laws together.
examples.translation_zh: 国会成员经常一起讨论重要法律。

examples.sentence: Our professor explained the congress session's impact on policies.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的教授解释了国会会议对政策的影响。

campaign.def_en: A coordinated series of activities aimed at achieving a goal.

examples.sentence: Our team is launching a new advertising campaign this month.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的团队这个月将推出一个新的广告活动。

examples.sentence: The political campaign has attracted a lot of attention this year.
examples.translation_zh: 今年的政治活动引起了很多关注。

examples.sentence: They organized a health campaign to promote healthy living.
examples.translation_zh: 他们组织了一场健康活动，以促进健康生活。

population.def_en: The number of people living in a specific area.

examples.sentence: World population continues to grow rapidly each year.
examples.translation_zh: 全球人口每年都在快速增长。

examples.sentence: The urban population is increasing in many cities worldwide.
examples.translation_zh: 许多城市的城市人口正在增加。

examples.sentence: An aging population may lead to increased healthcare needs.
examples.translation_zh: 老龄化人口可能导致医疗需求增加。

economy.def_en: The system of production, distribution, and consumption of goods.

examples.sentence: Many countries depend on the global economy for trade.
examples.translation_zh: 许多国家依赖全球经济进行贸易。

examples.sentence: Small businesses are important for the local economy.
examples.translation_zh: 小企业对地方经济很重要。

examples.sentence: A free market economy allows supply and demand to determine prices.
examples.translation_zh: 自由市场经济允许供需决定价格。

material.def_en: Substance used to make something, or the physical matter.

examples.sentence: Factories need raw materials to create the finished products.
examples.translation_zh: 工厂需要原材料来制造成品。

examples.sentence: Researchers found material evidence to support their theory.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员找到实质证据来支持他们的理论。

examples.sentence: Many people value material possessions more than experiences.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人更重视物质财富而非经历。

medical.def_en: Related to the science of diagnosing and treating illness.

examples.sentence: Researchers are conducting medical research for new treatments.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员正在进行医学研究，以寻找新疗法。

examples.sentence: Many people need access to quality medical care.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人需要获得优质的医疗服务。

examples.sentence: Medical professionals work long hours to help patients.
examples.translation_zh: 医疗专业人员为了帮助患者而工作很长时间。

risk.def_en: Possibility of loss or injury due to exposure.

examples.sentence: You should take a risk and try new things.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该冒险尝试新事物。

examples.sentence: High blood pressure is one of the risk factors for heart disease.
examples.translation_zh: 高血压是心脏病的风险因素之一。

examples.sentence: The team performed a risk assessment before starting the project.
examples.translation_zh: 团队在开始项目之前进行了风险评估。

involve.def_en: To include someone or something as a necessary part.

examples.sentence: Many projects involve a lot of people working together.
examples.translation_zh: 许多项目都涉及很多人一起工作。

examples.sentence: These treatments can involve serious risks for patients.
examples.translation_zh: 这些治疗可能涉及患者的严重风险。

examples.sentence: Jobs in this field often involve long hours and hard work.
examples.translation_zh: 这个领域的工作通常涉及长时间的工作和辛苦的劳动。

current.def_en: Relating to the present time; happening now.

examples.sentence: Many people discuss current events on social media.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人在社交媒体上讨论时事。

examples.sentence: She explained the current situation to her friends.
examples.translation_zh: 她向朋友们解释了当前的情况。

examples.sentence: Current research shows the importance of clean energy.
examples.translation_zh: 当前的研究表明清洁能源的重要性。

behavior.def_en: The way someone acts or conducts themselves.

examples.sentence: Children learn social behavior from their parents and peers.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们从父母和同龄人那里学习社交行为。

examples.sentence: Scientists study human behavior to understand mental processes.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家研究人类行为以理解心理过程。

examples.sentence: Aggressive behavior can lead to conflicts in society.
examples.translation_zh: 攻击性行为可能导致社会冲突。

increase.def_en: To become or make something larger or greater.

examples.sentence: Schools aim to increase the number of participants in clubs.
examples.translation_zh: 学校旨在增加社团的参与人数。

examples.sentence: Doctors work hard to increase awareness of health issues.
examples.translation_zh: 医生努力提高人们对健康问题的意识。

examples.sentence: The factory plans to increase production rates next quarter.
examples.translation_zh: 工厂计划在下个季度提高生产率。

anyone.def_en: Any person; used for questioning or referring.

examples.sentence: Anyone can help with the project if they want.
examples.translation_zh: 任何人都可以参与这个项目，如果他们愿意。

examples.sentence: You can ask anyone for their opinion on this issue.
examples.translation_zh: 你可以问任何人对这个问题的看法。

examples.sentence: The list of participants doesn't include anyone from our class.
examples.translation_zh: 参与者名单上不包括我们班的任何人。

security.def_en: The state of being free from danger or threat.

examples.sentence: Many people worry about their personal security at home.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人担心他们在家里的个人安全。

examples.sentence: The government is focused on protecting national security.
examples.translation_zh: 政府专注于保护国家安全。

examples.sentence: Companies must ensure data security for their customers.
examples.translation_zh: 公司必须确保客户的数据安全。

board.def_en: A flat, thin, rectangular piece of material.

examples.sentence: Teachers write lessons on the class board for students.
examples.translation_zh: 老师在教室黑板上写下课文供学生学习。

examples.sentence: The board meeting will start at three o'clock this afternoon.
examples.translation_zh: 董事会会议今天下午三点开始。

examples.sentence: Please check the notice board for important announcements.
examples.translation_zh: 请查看公告栏以获取重要通知。

private.def_en: Something kept away from the view or knowledge of others.

examples.sentence: Everyone deserves to have a private life outside work.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人都应该拥有工作之外的私人生活。

examples.sentence: He shared private information with the press by mistake.
examples.translation_zh: 他不小心与媒体分享了私人信息。

examples.sentence: Many parents choose to send their children to private schools.
examples.translation_zh: 许多父母选择将孩子送到私立学校。

deal.def_en: An agreement or arrangement, especially for business.

examples.sentence: Companies often make a deal to share resources.
examples.translation_zh: 公司经常达成协议以共享资源。

examples.sentence: The two countries struck a deal to improve trade relations.
examples.translation_zh: 两国达成协议以改善贸易关系。

examples.sentence: We need to deal with problems in our community effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要有效地解决社区中的问题。

performance.def_en: The act of doing something to entertain or show skills.

examples.sentence: Students must improve their academic performance this year.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们必须提高他们今年的学业表现。

examples.sentence: Many companies evaluate work performance every six months.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司每六个月评估一次工作表现。

examples.sentence: The artistic performance drew a large crowd at the festival.
examples.translation_zh: 艺术表演在节日吸引了大量观众。

top.def_en: The highest point or place of something.

examples.sentence: She achieved the top score in the exam.
examples.translation_zh: 她在考试中获得了最高分。

examples.sentence: Making safety a top priority is essential for success.
examples.translation_zh: 将安全作为首要任务对成功至关重要。

examples.sentence: He was listed among the top ten artists of the year.
examples.translation_zh: 他被列为年度十大艺术家之一。

goal.def_en: The object of a person's ambition or effort.

examples.sentence: Many employees set a goal to improve their skills.
examples.translation_zh: 许多员工设定目标以提升自己的技能。

examples.sentence: Students often work hard to reach a goal in their studies.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们常常努力学习以达成他们的学习目标。

examples.sentence: You can achieve a goal if you stay focused and determined.
examples.translation_zh: 如果你保持专注和决心，就能实现目标。

author.def_en: A person who writes books, articles, or other texts.

examples.sentence: Students must read the author's biography for class.
examples.translation_zh: 学生必须为课堂阅读这位作者的传记。

examples.sentence: Many people admire a famous author for their storytelling skills.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人欣赏这位著名作者的讲故事技巧。

examples.sentence: I forgot the author's name of that novel we discussed.
examples.translation_zh: 我忘记了我们讨论的那本小说的作者名字。

focus.def_en: The center of interest or attention.

examples.sentence: Teachers focus on education to help students succeed.
examples.translation_zh: 教师专注于教育，以帮助学生成功。

examples.sentence: Marketing teams conduct focus groups for better feedback.
examples.translation_zh: 市场团队进行焦点小组，以获得更好的反馈。

examples.sentence: You should focus your thoughts before making a decision.
examples.translation_zh: 在做决定之前，你应该集中思考。

represent.def_en: To show or depict something in a particular way.

examples.sentence: Athletes represent their country in the Olympic Games.
examples.translation_zh: 运动员在奥林匹克运动会上代表他们的国家。

examples.sentence: Data analysts represent the results in visual charts and graphs.
examples.translation_zh: 数据分析师在可视化图表中表示结果。

examples.sentence: Many celebrities represent a brand as their spokespersons.
examples.translation_zh: 许多名人作为代言人代表一个品牌。

drop.def_en: To let something fall or to fall down.

examples.sentence: Many students drop out of school every year.
examples.translation_zh: 每年都有很多学生辍学。

examples.sentence: I will drop by your house later today.
examples.translation_zh: 我今天稍后会顺道去你家。

examples.sentence: You can drop in anytime during business hours.
examples.translation_zh: 你可以在办公时间随时来访。

blood.def_en: Red liquid that circulates in the body.

examples.sentence: Doctors check your blood pressure during regular visits.
examples.translation_zh: 医生在定期检查中会测量你的血压。

examples.sentence: Each person has a specific blood type that is important.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人都有特定的血型，这一点很重要。

examples.sentence: Many people participate in blood donation events each year.
examples.translation_zh: 每年有很多人参加献血活动。

agency.def_en: The ability to make choices and act independently.

examples.sentence: Many citizens trust their government agency for support.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公民信任他们的政府机构以获得支持。

examples.sentence: She booked a trip through a travel agency last week.
examples.translation_zh: 她上周通过旅行社预定了一次旅行。

examples.sentence: He works at an advertising agency that creates unique campaigns.
examples.translation_zh: 他在一家创作独特广告活动的广告公司工作。

recently.def_en: At a time not long ago.

examples.sentence: Researchers have recently published new findings in this area.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员最近在该领域发表了新发现。

examples.sentence: The government has recently changed its policy on education.
examples.translation_zh: 政府最近改变了教育政策。

examples.sentence: I have recently moved to a new apartment in the city.
examples.translation_zh: 我最近搬到了城市里的新公寓。

nature.def_en: The physical world and everything in it.

examples.sentence: People love to explore wild nature during vacations.
examples.translation_zh: 人们喜欢在假期探索野生自然。

examples.sentence: Understanding human nature helps us connect with others.
examples.translation_zh: 理解人性帮助我们与他人建立联系。

examples.sentence: Many organizations focus on nature conservation and protection.
examples.translation_zh: 许多组织专注于自然保护和保护工作。

color.def_en: The quality of an object with respect to light.

examples.sentence: She wore a bright color to the party.
examples.translation_zh: 她穿了一件鲜艳的衣服去派对。

examples.sentence: Many artists prefer to use dark color in their paintings.
examples.translation_zh: 许多艺术家喜欢在他们的画作中使用深色。

examples.sentence: The graphic designer chose a new color scheme for the project.
examples.translation_zh: 平面设计师为这个项目选择了新的配色方案。

upon.def_en: On the surface of something; at a specific time.

examples.sentence: We will meet you upon arrival at the airport.
examples.translation_zh: 我们将在你到达机场时见面。

examples.sentence: You can access the report upon request from the manager.
examples.translation_zh: 你可以在经理的要求下获取报告。

examples.sentence: He changed his mind upon reflection about the decision.
examples.translation_zh: 经过反思，他改变了对这个决定的看法。

reduce.def_en: Make something smaller or less in amount, size, or degree.

examples.sentence: Companies need to reduce costs to increase profits.
examples.translation_zh: 公司需要减少成本以增加利润。

examples.sentence: We must reduce pollution to protect our planet.
examples.translation_zh: 我们必须减少污染以保护我们的星球。

examples.sentence: Yoga can help reduce stress and improve well-being.
examples.translation_zh: 瑜伽可以帮助减少压力，改善健康。

enter.def_en: To go or come into a place or situation.

examples.sentence: Students will enter the room quietly before class starts.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们会在上课前安静地进入教室。

examples.sentence: Employees must enter the data into the computer system correctly.
examples.translation_zh: 员工必须正确地将数据输入计算机系统。

examples.sentence: Many artists want to enter a contest to showcase their work.
examples.translation_zh: 许多艺术家想参加一个比赛来展示他们的作品。

movement.def_en: A change in position or location.

examples.sentence: Body movement is essential for staying healthy and fit.
examples.translation_zh: 身体的运动对于保持健康和适合至关重要。

examples.sentence: Many people join a social movement to create positive change.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人加入社会运动以创造积极的变化。

examples.sentence: Scientists study animal movement patterns to understand their behavior.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家研究动物的运动模式以理解它们的行为。

natural.def_en: Existing in nature; not made or caused by humankind.

examples.sentence: Many countries depend on natural resources for their economy.
examples.translation_zh: 许多国家依赖自然资源来发展经济。

examples.sentence: We visited a place known for its natural beauty.
examples.translation_zh: 我们参观了一个以自然美闻名的地方。

examples.sentence: Some animals lose their natural habitat due to pollution.
examples.translation_zh: 一些动物因污染而失去其自然栖息地。

common.def_en: Occurring often; not rare or special.

examples.sentence: Everyone should know this common knowledge about history.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人都应该知道这个关于历史的常识。

examples.sentence: It is common practice to arrive early for meetings.
examples.translation_zh: 提前到达会议是一个常见的做法。

examples.sentence: Flu can cause common symptoms like fever and cough.
examples.translation_zh: 流感会导致常见症状，如发烧和咳嗽。

race.def_en: A competition of speed or a group of people.

examples.sentence: Children love to join the running race every year.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们每年都喜欢参加跑步比赛。

examples.sentence: We should protect our planet for the human race.
examples.translation_zh: 我们应该保护我们的星球，为人类而努力。

examples.sentence: The car race attracted many fans this weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 这场汽车比赛吸引了许多粉丝，周末热闹非凡。

concern.def_en: A feeling of worry or interest about something.

examples.sentence: Many people have expressed public concern about the pollution.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人对污染表示了公众关切。

examples.sentence: Environmental concern grows as natural disasters increase each year.
examples.translation_zh: 随着自然灾害每年增加，环境问题越来越受到关注。

examples.sentence: She showed personal concern for his health and well-being.
examples.translation_zh: 她对他的健康和福祉表示了个人关心。

significant.def_en: Having meaning or importance; notable in effect or degree.

examples.sentence: Climate change has a significant impact on weather patterns.
examples.translation_zh: 气候变化对天气模式有重要影响。

examples.sentence: We need a significant amount of data to proceed.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要大量数据才能继续。

examples.sentence: There is a significant difference in test scores this year.
examples.translation_zh: 今年考试分数有显著差异。

series.def_en: A number of related items or events occurring in sequence.

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy watching popular TV series each week.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人每周都喜欢看流行的电视剧。

examples.sentence: She is reading a fascinating book series about history.
examples.translation_zh: 她正在阅读一本关于历史的迷人书籍系列。

examples.sentence: We offer a training series to improve employee skills.
examples.translation_zh: 我们提供一个培训系列以提高员工技能。

share.def_en: To allow others to use or have something.

examples.sentence: We need to share information with the team regularly.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要定期与团队分享信息。

examples.sentence: Students should share ideas to improve their projects.
examples.translation_zh: 学生应该分享想法，以改进他们的项目。

examples.sentence: Families often share a meal during holidays together.
examples.translation_zh: 家人通常在节假日一起分享一顿饭。

response.def_en: A reaction or reply to something said or done.

examples.sentence: Managers expect a prompt response to their emails.
examples.translation_zh: 经理们希望能及时回复他们的电子邮件。

examples.sentence: The public response to the policy was mostly positive.
examples.translation_zh: 公众对该政策的反应总体积极。

examples.sentence: An immediate response is crucial in medical emergencies.
examples.translation_zh: 在医疗紧急情况下，及时反应至关重要。

examples.sentence: Many changes have occurred in the last decade.
examples.translation_zh: 在过去的十年里，发生了许多变化。

examples.sentence: Expect significant advancements in technology in the next decade.
examples.translation_zh: 在下一个十年里，预计技术将有显著进步。

examples.sentence: People have become more eco-friendly over the decade.
examples.translation_zh: 在过去的十年里，人们变得更加环保。

factor.def_en: An element or component that contributes to a result or situation.

examples.sentence: Smoking is a major risk factor for lung disease.
examples.translation_zh: 吸烟是导致肺病的重要风险因素。

examples.sentence: Temperature is a contributing factor to plant growth.
examples.translation_zh: 温度是植物生长的一个影响因素。

examples.sentence: Time management is often the deciding factor in success.
examples.translation_zh: 时间管理往往是成功的决定性因素。

article.def_en: A piece of writing included in a publication.

examples.sentence: Our newspaper published an article about the new law.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的报纸发表了一篇关于新法律的文章。

examples.sentence: She wrote an article for an academic journal last month.
examples.translation_zh: 她上个月为一本学术期刊写了一篇文章。

examples.sentence: The researchers published a new article in the science magazine.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员在科学杂志上发表了一篇新文章。

shoot.def_en: To send something quickly through the air.

examples.sentence: He learned how to shoot a gun safely.
examples.translation_zh: 他学会了如何安全地射击枪械。
