examples.translation_zh: 公民将在即将到来的选举中投票。

examples.sentence: I will vote for my favorite candidate today.
examples.translation_zh: 我今天将投票支持我最喜欢的候选人。

examples.sentence: The committee decided to vote against the proposed changes.
examples.translation_zh: 委员会决定反对提议的变更。

debate.def_en: A discussion on a particular topic with opposing viewpoints.

examples.sentence: Students often engage in academic debates during class discussions.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在课堂讨论中经常进行学术辩论。

examples.sentence: The candidates participated in a public debate before the election.
examples.translation_zh: 候选人在选举前参加了公众辩论。

examples.sentence: They had a heated debate about the best movie of the year.
examples.translation_zh: 他们就今年最佳电影展开了激烈的辩论。

relate.def_en: To show or establish a connection or relationship.

examples.sentence: I can relate to your feelings about this situation.
examples.translation_zh: 我能理解你对这种情况的感受。

examples.sentence: Students often relate to topics discussed in class.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们通常能与课堂讨论的话题相关联。

examples.sentence: This story relates back to the recent events in politics.
examples.translation_zh: 这个故事与近期的政治事件有关。

audience.def_en: A group of people watching a performance or event.

examples.sentence: Many famous actors perform for a live audience each night.
examples.translation_zh: 许多著名演员每晚为现场观众表演。

examples.sentence: The company studied its target audience to improve marketing.
examples.translation_zh: 公司研究了目标观众以改善市场营销。

examples.sentence: Teachers focus on audience engagement during their lessons.
examples.translation_zh: 教师在课堂上注重观众的参与。

born.def_en: Having been brought into life; not created.

examples.sentence: She was born into a wealthy family in New York.
examples.translation_zh: 她出生在纽约的一个富裕家庭。

examples.sentence: He was born with a talent for music and art.
examples.translation_zh: 他天生就有音乐和艺术的才能。

examples.sentence: Some people are born to lead and inspire others.
examples.translation_zh: 一些人天生就适合领导和激励他人。

citizen.def_en: A person recognized as a member of a state or country.

examples.sentence: They protested for better citizen rights in the city.
examples.translation_zh: 他们在城市中抗议要求更好的公民权利。

examples.sentence: Many citizens participate in local cultural events every year.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公民每年参加当地的文化活动。

examples.sentence: Understanding citizen duties is important for all students.
examples.translation_zh: 了解公民责任对所有学生都很重要。

majority.def_en: More than half of a group or population.

examples.sentence: Most people believe the majority is usually correct.
examples.translation_zh: 大多数人认为大多数通常是正确的。

examples.sentence: Experts say the majority opinion supports the new law.
examples.translation_zh: 专家表示，大多数意见支持这项新法律。

examples.sentence: In the survey, a small majority chose option A over B.
examples.translation_zh: 在调查中，小部分多数选择了选项A而非B。

prevent.def_en: To stop something from happening or being done.

examples.sentence: Workers must prevent accidents in the factory every day.
examples.translation_zh: 工人们必须每天防止工厂发生事故。

examples.sentence: Doctors recommend ways to prevent illness and stay healthy.
examples.translation_zh: 医生建议一些方法来防止疾病，保持健康。

examples.sentence: Communities work together to prevent pollution in their rivers.
examples.translation_zh: 社区共同努力防止河流污染。

admit.def_en: To acknowledge the truth or existence of something.

examples.sentence: Everyone should admit their mistakes and learn from them.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人都应该承认自己的错误并从中学习。

examples.sentence: Sometimes, people find it hard to admit failures in life.
examples.translation_zh: 有时，人们很难承认生活中的失败。

examples.sentence: Schools will admit students based on their test scores.
examples.translation_zh: 学校将根据学生的考试成绩录取学生。

senior.def_en: Older or having a higher rank or status.

examples.sentence: Many senior citizens enjoy discounts at local shops.
examples.translation_zh: 许多年长的公民在当地商店享受折扣。

examples.sentence: The senior management team will meet this Friday.
examples.translation_zh: 高级管理团队将于本周五召开会议。

examples.sentence: She is studying at a senior level in university.
examples.translation_zh: 她在大学学习高级课程。

professional.def_en: Relating to a job requiring special education or training.

examples.sentence: Teachers often need professional development workshops for better skills.
examples.translation_zh: 教师常常需要职业发展研讨会以提高技能。

examples.sentence: She has many professional skills in project management.
examples.translation_zh: 她在项目管理方面有很多专业技能。

examples.sentence: Becoming a professional athlete requires hard work and dedication.
examples.translation_zh: 成为职业运动员需要努力和奉献精神。

alone.def_en: Without others; by oneself; not accompanied.

examples.sentence: She likes to read all alone in the park.
examples.translation_zh: 她喜欢在公园里单独阅读。

examples.sentence: Many students feel alone when studying for exams.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生在复习考试时会感到孤单。

examples.sentence: He prefers to be alone while completing his tasks.
examples.translation_zh: 他更喜欢在完成任务时单独一人。

customer.def_en: A person who purchases goods or services.

examples.sentence: Customers are often satisfied when products meet their needs.
examples.translation_zh: 当产品满足需求时，顾客通常感到满意。

examples.sentence: Providing excellent customer service is essential for any business.
examples.translation_zh: 提供优质的顾客服务对任何企业都是至关重要的。

examples.sentence: Many companies reward loyal customers with special offers.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司用特别优惠奖励忠实顾客。

mission.def_en: A specific task or duty assigned to someone.

examples.sentence: Companies often have a clear mission statement to guide them.
examples.translation_zh: 公司通常有明确的使命声明以指导他们。

examples.sentence: The astronauts prepared for their upcoming space mission next month.
examples.translation_zh: 宇航员为下个月即将到来的太空任务做准备。

examples.sentence: Our community mission is to help those in need.
examples.translation_zh: 我们社区的使命是帮助那些需要帮助的人。

assume.def_en: To take for granted or without proof.

examples.sentence: Teachers often assume that students understand the material.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们常常假设学生理解这些内容。

examples.sentence: He will assume responsibility for the project's success.
examples.translation_zh: 他将承担项目成功的责任。

examples.sentence: Many people assume a role as caregivers in their families.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在家庭中承担照顾者的角色。

speech.def_en: A formal address or discourse delivered to an audience.

examples.sentence: Many people attended his public speech in the park.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人参加了他在公园的演讲。

examples.sentence: Students practice hard for the upcoming speech contest.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们为即将到来的演讲比赛努力练习。

examples.sentence: She was invited to give a speech at the conference.
examples.translation_zh: 她受邀在会议上演讲。

option.def_en: A thing that can be chosen.

examples.sentence: Many available options can help improve your performance.
examples.translation_zh: 许多可用的选择可以帮助改善你的表现。

examples.sentence: Students need to choose an option for their project.
examples.translation_zh: 学生需要选择一个项目选项。

examples.sentence: This restaurant is the best option for dinner tonight.
examples.translation_zh: 这家餐馆是今晚晚餐的最佳选择。

southern.def_en: Located in or characteristic of the south.

examples.sentence: The southern states have a unique culture and history.
examples.translation_zh: 南方各州有独特的文化和历史。

examples.sentence: Animals in the southern hemisphere adapt to different climates.
examples.translation_zh: 南半球的动物适应不同的气候。

examples.sentence: She speaks with a charming southern accent that I adore.
examples.translation_zh: 她说着我喜欢的迷人的南方口音。

successful.def_en: Achieving desired aims or attaining prosperity.

examples.sentence: Many successful businesses start with a great idea.
examples.translation_zh: 许多成功的企业始于一个好主意。

examples.sentence: She is a successful student in her class.
examples.translation_zh: 她是班上一个成功的学生。

examples.sentence: The research team completed a successful project this year.
examples.translation_zh: 研究小组今年完成了一个成功的项目。

fresh.def_en: Recently made or obtained; not stale or rotten.

examples.sentence: She bought some fresh fruit from the market.
examples.translation_zh: 她从市场买了一些新鲜的水果。

examples.sentence: We all need some fresh air to feel better.
examples.translation_zh: 我们都需要一些新鲜空气来感觉更好。

examples.sentence: The team is looking for fresh ideas to improve the project.
examples.translation_zh: 团队正在寻找新鲜的想法以改善项目。

university.def_en: An institution for higher education and research.

examples.sentence: Many students plan to attend university after high school.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生计划高中毕业后上大学。

examples.sentence: He is taking several university courses this semester.
examples.translation_zh: 他这个学期正在选修几门大学课程。

examples.sentence: The university campus is beautiful during the spring.
examples.translation_zh: 春天时，大学校园很美。

eventually.def_en: In the end; after a long time or a series of events.

examples.sentence: We will eventually agree on the project's direction.
examples.translation_zh: 我们最终会就项目的方向达成一致。

examples.sentence: With hard work, you will eventually succeed in your studies.
examples.translation_zh: 只要努力，你最终会在学习上取得成功。

examples.sentence: She will eventually find out the truth about him.
examples.translation_zh: 她最终会发现有关他的真相。

forest.def_en: A large area covered chiefly with trees and undergrowth.

examples.sentence: Tropical forests are home to diverse plant species.
examples.translation_zh: 热带森林是多种植物的栖息地。

examples.sentence: Forest fires can destroy many homes and habitats each year.
examples.translation_zh: 森林火灾每年会摧毁许多房屋和栖息地。

examples.sentence: Many people support forest conservation for future generations.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人支持森林保护，以惠及后代。

global.def_en: Relating to the whole world or all parts of it.

examples.sentence: Climate change causes global warming and affects all life.
examples.translation_zh: 气候变化导致全球变暖，影响所有生命。

examples.sentence: The global economy is facing many challenges right now.
examples.translation_zh: 目前，全球经济面临许多挑战。

examples.sentence: We must address global issues like poverty and health.
examples.translation_zh: 我们必须解决全球问题，比如贫困和健康。

reform.def_en: To make changes in order to improve something.

examples.sentence: Many countries have implemented education reform to enhance learning.
examples.translation_zh: 许多国家实施了教育改革，以提高学习效果。

examples.sentence: The government plans to introduce major government reform this year.
examples.translation_zh: 政府计划在今年推出重大政府改革。

examples.sentence: Healthcare reform aims to make medical services more affordable for everyone.
examples.translation_zh: 医疗改革旨在使医疗服务对所有人更可负担。

senate.def_en: A legislative body in government, often part of a larger assembly.

examples.sentence: Members of the senate voted on the important bill.
examples.translation_zh: 参议院的成员对这项重要法案进行了投票。

examples.sentence: A committee in the senate is reviewing the proposed legislation.
examples.translation_zh: 参议院的一个委员会正在审查提议的立法。

examples.sentence: Senate hearings will address several key issues this month.
examples.translation_zh: 本月的参议院听证会将讨论几个关键问题。

video.def_en: A recording of moving visual images.

examples.sentence: Children love to watch videos on their tablets.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们喜欢在平板上看视频。

examples.sentence: Many teenagers enjoy playing video games with friends.
examples.translation_zh: 许多青少年喜欢和朋友一起玩视频游戏。

examples.sentence: Teachers use online video to help explain difficult topics.
examples.translation_zh: 老师使用在线视频来帮助解释难懂的主题。

judge.def_en: A person who makes decisions in a court or competition.

examples.sentence: Teachers often judge the results of student tests carefully.
examples.translation_zh: 老师经常仔细评判学生考试的结果。

examples.sentence: The manager will judge a competition next week for the team.
examples.translation_zh: 经理下周将为团队评判一个比赛。

examples.sentence: Friends sometimes judge the situation before giving advice.
examples.translation_zh: 朋友们有时在给建议前会评判局势。

access.def_en: The ability to approach or make use of something.

examples.sentence: Students need access to information for their studies.
examples.translation_zh: 学生需要访问信息以便学习。

examples.sentence: You must gain access to the system to start working.
examples.translation_zh: 你必须获得系统的访问权限才能开始工作。

examples.sentence: Can you access a website on your phone easily?
examples.translation_zh: 你能在手机上轻松访问网站吗？

relation.def_en: The way in which two or more people or things are connected.

examples.sentence: Family relations can be very complex and challenging.
examples.translation_zh: 家庭关系可能非常复杂且具有挑战性。

examples.sentence: Countries often discuss international relations in global meetings.
examples.translation_zh: 国家在全球会议上经常讨论国际关系。

examples.sentence: A close relation exists between diet and health outcomes.
examples.translation_zh: 饮食与健康结果之间存在密切关系。

opinion.def_en: A belief or judgment about something.

examples.sentence: Many people share their opinion in public forums.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在公共论坛上表达他们的意见。

examples.sentence: In my opinion, this movie is very interesting.
examples.translation_zh: 在我看来，这部电影非常有趣。

examples.sentence: We need an expert opinion on this project.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要对这个项目的专家意见。

publish.def_en: To make information available to the public.

examples.sentence: She wants to publish a book about her travels.
examples.translation_zh: 她想出版一本关于她旅行的书。

examples.sentence: Researchers will publish an article in the next journal issue.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员将在下一个期刊中发表一篇文章。

examples.sentence: The lab will publish results of the study next month.
examples.translation_zh: 实验室将在下个月发布研究结果。

release.def_en: To allow something to be free or available.

examples.sentence: Scientists will release a report on climate change tomorrow.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家们明天将发表一份关于气候变化的报告。

examples.sentence: The company plans to release new software next month.
examples.translation_zh: 公司计划下个月发布新软件。

examples.sentence: They will release the rescued animals into the wild soon.
examples.translation_zh: 他们将很快把救助过的动物放归野外。

version.def_en: A specific form or variant of something, usually software.

examples.sentence: We need to update to the latest version soon.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要尽快更新到最新版。

examples.sentence: The new version has improved features and performance.
examples.translation_zh: 新版本具有更好的功能和性能。

examples.sentence: Different versions of the story exist in many cultures.
examples.translation_zh: 许多文化中存在不同版本的故事。

stare.def_en: To look fixedly or vacantly at someone or something.

examples.sentence: Children often stare at the magician with excitement.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们常常兴奋地盯着魔术师。

examples.sentence: Many visitors will stare in amazement at the ancient ruins.
examples.translation_zh: 许多游客会惊讶地盯着古老的遗迹。

examples.sentence: He tends to stare blankly when he is confused.
examples.translation_zh: 当他感到困惑时，他往往茫然地盯着。

safety.def_en: The condition of being protected from danger.

examples.sentence: Employers must take necessary safety precautions for workers.
examples.translation_zh: 雇主必须为工作人员采取必要的安全预防措施。

examples.sentence: Students should follow the safety guidelines during experiments.
examples.translation_zh: 学生在实验中应遵循安全指南。

examples.sentence: He always wears safety equipment when riding his bike.
examples.translation_zh: 他骑自行车时总是穿戴安全装备。

critical.def_en: Of great importance or serious consequences.

examples.sentence: This is a critical moment for our team to succeed.
examples.translation_zh: 这是我们团队成功的关键时刻。

examples.sentence: Students need to develop critical thinking skills for better learning.
examples.translation_zh: 学生需要培养批判性思维能力以便更好地学习。

examples.sentence: The patient is in critical condition after the accident.
examples.translation_zh: 这名患者在事故后处于危急状态。

original.def_en: Existing from the beginning; not a copy or imitation.

examples.sentence: She presented an original idea during the meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 她在会议上提出了一个独创的想法。

examples.sentence: Many people prefer the original version of the movie.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人更喜欢这部电影的原版。

examples.sentence: I bought an original artwork from a local artist.
examples.translation_zh: 我从一位当地艺术家那里买了一幅原作。

neighborhood.def_en: A local area or community where people live.

examples.sentence: I enjoy walking my dog in my neighborhood.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢在我的社区遛狗。

examples.sentence: The neighborhood watch program helps keep our area safe.
examples.translation_zh: 社区警戒计划帮助保持我们地区的安全。

examples.sentence: Children play happily in the neighborhood park every day.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们每天在社区公园快乐地玩耍。

troop.def_en: A group of soldiers or a gathering of people.

examples.sentence: Military troops are being sent to the affected area.
examples.translation_zh: 部队正在被派往受影响地区。

examples.sentence: Troop movements can indicate changes in military strategy.
examples.translation_zh: 部队调动可能意味着军事策略的变化。

examples.sentence: My son joined a local scout troop last week.
examples.translation_zh: 我儿子上周加入了一个当地的童子军。

income.def_en: Money received for work or services, or from investments.

examples.sentence: Many workers hope to increase their annual income this year.
examples.translation_zh: 许多工人希望今年增加他们的年收入。

examples.sentence: The government is raising the income tax for higher earners.
examples.translation_zh: 政府正在提高高收入者的所得税。

examples.sentence: She carefully tracks her monthly income and expenses.
examples.translation_zh: 她仔细记录每月的收入和支出。

examples.sentence: You need to respond immediately to customer inquiries.
examples.translation_zh: 您需要立即回复客户询问。

examples.sentence: If you feel unwell, you should act immediately.
examples.translation_zh: 如果您感觉不适，您应该立即采取行动。

examples.sentence: Please notify the teacher immediately about any problems.
examples.translation_zh: 请立即通知老师任何问题。

species.def_en: A group of living organisms with similar characteristics.

examples.sentence: Many endangered species are at risk of extinction.
examples.translation_zh: 许多濒危物种面临灭绝的风险。

examples.sentence: Researchers study animal species to understand their behavior.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员研究动物物种以了解它们的行为。

examples.sentence: Local parks have many beautiful plant species to enjoy.
examples.translation_zh: 当地公园里有许多美丽的植物物种可以欣赏。

directly.def_en: In a straight line or manner; without anything added.

examples.sentence: The study shows that stress is directly related to health.
examples.translation_zh: 研究表明压力与健康直接相关。

examples.sentence: I prefer to talk directly to the manager about this issue.
examples.translation_zh: 我更喜欢直接和经理谈论这个问题。

examples.sentence: You need to report directly to your supervisor every week.
examples.translation_zh: 你每周需要直接向你的主管报告。

track.def_en: A path or course of movement or progress.

examples.sentence: Many companies check an applicant's track record before hiring.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司在招聘之前会查看申请人的履历。

examples.sentence: Teachers can track changes in student performance easily.
examples.translation_zh: 老师可以很容易地追踪学生的表现变化。

examples.sentence: I need to track down my lost wallet today.
examples.translation_zh: 我今天需要找到我丢失的钱包。

basic.def_en: Fundamental or essential; forming a base or starting point.

examples.sentence: Students need to learn basic skills for their future.
examples.translation_zh: 学生需要学习基础技能以便于他们的未来。

examples.sentence: Everyone has basic needs that must be met daily.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人都有日常必须满足的基本需求。

examples.sentence: Understanding basic principles is crucial in this job.
examples.translation_zh: 理解基本原则在这份工作中是至关重要的。

strike.def_en: To hit something forcefully or to stop working temporarily.

examples.sentence: Many companies strike a deal to reduce costs.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司达成协议以降低成本。

examples.sentence: The country decided to strike back after the attack.
examples.translation_zh: 该国决定在袭击后进行反击。

examples.sentence: She tried to strike out on her own in business.
examples.translation_zh: 她试图在商业上独立发展。

freedom.def_en: The state of being free; absence of constraints or restrictions.

examples.sentence: Everyone should have the freedom of speech in society.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人在社会中都应该拥有言论自由。

examples.sentence: Students need the freedom to choose their own subjects.
examples.translation_zh: 学生需要有选择自己科目的自由。

examples.sentence: Many freedom fighters risk their lives for justice.
examples.translation_zh: 许多自由斗士冒着生命危险追求正义。

hurt.def_en: To cause physical or emotional pain or damage.

examples.sentence: She didn't mean to hurt her friend's feelings.
examples.translation_zh: 她并不是故意伤害朋友的感情。

examples.sentence: He hurt badly during the football game yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 他在昨天的足球比赛中受了重伤。

examples.sentence: I accidentally hurt myself while using the machine.
examples.translation_zh: 我在使用机器时不小心伤到了自己。

object.def_en: A material thing that can be seen and touched.

examples.sentence: This is an important object lesson for all students.
examples.translation_zh: 这是给所有学生的重要教育示范。

examples.sentence: The object of study is essential for scientific research.
examples.translation_zh: 研究对象对科学研究至关重要。

examples.sentence: Many people object to the new rules at work.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人反对公司的新规定。

achieve.def_en: To successfully reach a desired goal or result.

examples.sentence: Many people want to achieve success in their careers.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人希望在职业生涯中取得成功。

examples.sentence: You can achieve your dreams with hard work and patience.
examples.translation_zh: 通过努力和耐心，你可以实现你的梦想。

examples.sentence: Students should aim to achieve their educational goals each year.
examples.translation_zh: 学生每年都应该努力实现他们的教育目标。

attitude.def_en: A settled way of thinking or feeling about something.

examples.sentence: She always brings a positive attitude to the workplace.
examples.translation_zh: 她总是给工作场所带来积极的态度。

examples.sentence: Students have different attitudes towards learning new subjects.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们对学习新科目有不同的态度。

examples.sentence: He needs an attitude adjustment after that argument.
examples.translation_zh: 在那次争吵后，他需要调整一下态度。

refer.def_en: To mention or allude to something or someone.

examples.sentence: Teachers often refer to textbooks during their lessons.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们常常在课堂上提到教科书。

examples.sentence: We should refer back to the previous report for details.
examples.translation_zh: 我们应该回顾之前的报告以获取细节。

examples.sentence: The doctor will refer you to a specialist for further tests.
examples.translation_zh: 医生会将你转诊给专家进行进一步检查。

concept.def_en: An idea or thought about something.

examples.sentence: Students often struggle with abstract concepts in math.
examples.translation_zh: 学生常常在数学中难以理解抽象概念。

examples.sentence: Teachers explain the important concepts of science clearly.
examples.translation_zh: 教师清晰地解释科学的重要概念。

examples.sentence: This movie introduces a new concept of friendship.
examples.translation_zh: 这部电影介绍了友谊的新概念。

powerful.def_en: Having great power or strength, very effective.

examples.sentence: These powerful tools can help you work faster.
examples.translation_zh: 这些强大的工具可以帮助你更快地工作。

examples.sentence: Many artists have a powerful influence on society.
examples.translation_zh: 许多艺术家对社会有着强大的影响。

examples.sentence: She felt a powerful emotion during the movie.
examples.translation_zh: 她在电影中感受到强烈的情感。

absolutely.def_en: Totally or completely; without any doubt.

examples.sentence: I am absolutely sure this is the right answer.
examples.translation_zh: 我完全确信这是正确答案。

examples.sentence: This information is absolutely essential for our project.
examples.translation_zh: 这些信息对我们的项目绝对必要。

examples.sentence: It is absolutely necessary to study for the exam.
examples.translation_zh: 复习考试是绝对必要的。

announce.def_en: To make something known publicly or officially.

examples.sentence: They announced the results of the election yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 他们昨天宣布了选举结果。

examples.sentence: Our company will announce a new product next week.
examples.translation_zh: 我们公司下周将宣布一款新产品。

examples.sentence: She will announce a meeting time later today.
examples.translation_zh: 她今天晚些时候将宣布会议时间。

examine.def_en: To look at something carefully to learn more about it.

examples.sentence: Police officers examine the evidence at the crime scene.
examples.translation_zh: 警察在犯罪现场检查证据。

examples.sentence: Scientists examine the results of their latest experiment.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家检查他们最新实验的结果。

examples.sentence: You should examine your options before making a decision.
examples.translation_zh: 在做决定之前，你应该检查你的选择。

touch.def_en: To make physical contact with something.

examples.sentence: Children often touch the screen to play games.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们常常触摸屏幕来玩游戏。

examples.sentence: The professor will touch on this topic during the lecture.
examples.translation_zh: 教授将在讲座中谈到这个话题。

examples.sentence: Her story really touched my heart and made me cry.
examples.translation_zh: 她的故事真的打动了我的心，让我哭了。

therefore.def_en: For that reason; as a result or consequence.

examples.sentence: We need to finish the project; therefore, we must act quickly.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要完成这个项目，因此，我们必须迅速行动。

examples.sentence: The results were significant; therefore, this study shows important findings.
examples.translation_zh: 结果显著，因此，这项研究显示了重要的发现。

examples.sentence: Regular exercise is beneficial; therefore, it is essential for a healthy lifestyle.
examples.translation_zh: 规律锻炼有益，因此，保持健康的生活方式是必不可少的。

attend.def_en: To be present at an event or activity.

examples.sentence: She will attend a meeting with the clients tomorrow.
examples.translation_zh: 她明天将参加与客户的会议。

examples.sentence: Children must attend school to learn important skills.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们必须上学以学习重要技能。

examples.sentence: He plans to attend a concert this weekend with friends.
examples.translation_zh: 他计划这个周末和朋友一起参加音乐会。

variety.def_en: A state of having different types or kinds.

examples.sentence: People have a variety of reasons for moving to new cities.
examples.translation_zh: 人们有多种理由搬到新城市。

examples.sentence: The project offers a variety of options for team collaboration.
examples.translation_zh: 这个项目提供多种团队合作的选项。

examples.sentence: Schools provide a variety of activities to engage students.
examples.translation_zh: 学校提供多样的活动来吸引学生。

completely.def_en: In every way; totally or fully without limitation.

examples.sentence: My new phone is completely different from my old one.
examples.translation_zh: 我的新手机与旧手机完全不同。

examples.sentence: They are completely finished with the project ahead of schedule.
examples.translation_zh: 他们提前完成了这个项目。

examples.sentence: The students were completely satisfied with their exam results.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们对自己的考试成绩感到完全满意。

investigation.def_en: A careful examination or inquiry into something.

examples.sentence: Police launched a detailed criminal investigation last week.
examples.translation_zh: 警方上周发起了详细的刑事调查。

examples.sentence: She conducted a scientific investigation to find new solutions.
examples.translation_zh: 她进行了一项科学调查，以寻找新解决方案。

examples.sentence: The company began an internal investigation into the issue.
examples.translation_zh: 公司开始对该问题进行内部调查。

researcher.def_en: A person who conducts systematic investigation or study.

examples.sentence: Many researchers study climate change and its effects.
examples.translation_zh: 许多研究人员研究气候变化及其影响。

examples.sentence: A famous researcher discovered a new treatment for the disease.
examples.translation_zh: 一位著名的研究人员发现了治疗这种疾病的新方法。

examples.sentence: The researcher in the field will present their findings tomorrow.
examples.translation_zh: 该领域的研究人员明天将展示他们的研究结果。

nuclear.def_en: Relating to the nucleus of an atom or energy from atoms.

examples.sentence: Nuclear power can provide a large amount of energy.
examples.translation_zh: 核能可以提供大量能量。

examples.sentence: Countries are discussing nuclear weapons control this week.
examples.translation_zh: 各国本周正在讨论核武器控制问题。

examples.sentence: A nuclear family consists of parents and their children.
examples.translation_zh: 核心家庭由父母和他们的孩子组成。

examples.sentence: We need a plan for conflict resolution in the office.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要一个解决办公室冲突的计划。

examples.sentence: There is often conflict between students and teachers.
examples.translation_zh: 学生和老师之间常常会有冲突。

examples.sentence: The two countries are in conflict with each other over borders.
examples.translation_zh: 这两个国家在边界问题上发生了冲突。

spirit.def_en: A non-physical part of a person; essential emotional quality.

examples.sentence: People need to have team spirit to succeed together.
examples.translation_zh: 人们需要有团队精神才能共同成功。

examples.sentence: Many students show their school spirit during events.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生在活动中展现他们的校 spirit。

examples.sentence: She is a free spirit who loves to travel alone.
examples.translation_zh: 她是个自由灵魂，喜欢独自旅行。

replace.def_en: To take the place of something or someone.

examples.sentence: Many companies replace old equipment with new ones.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司用新设备替换旧设备。

examples.sentence: Engineers replace missing parts to fix the device.
examples.translation_zh: 工程师替换缺失的部分以修理设备。

examples.sentence: They will replace a broken window this week.
examples.translation_zh: 他们这周将替换一扇破窗。

encourage.def_en: To give support, confidence, or hope to someone.

examples.sentence: Teachers encourage students to ask questions in class.
examples.translation_zh: 老师鼓励学生在课堂上提问。

examples.sentence: Friends encourage people to try new activities together.
examples.translation_zh: 朋友们鼓励大家一起尝试新活动。

examples.sentence: Managers encourage growth in their team's skills and knowledge.
examples.translation_zh: 经理鼓励团队技能和知识的成长。

argument.def_en: A discussion involving differing opinions or ideas.

examples.sentence: Students often make an argument for their projects.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们经常为他们的项目提出争论。

examples.sentence: She presented a strong argument during the meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 她在会议上提出了有力的争论。

examples.sentence: There was an argument about the new policy in the article.
examples.translation_zh: 文章里有关于新政策的争论。

camp.def_en: A place where people stay temporarily outdoors.

examples.sentence: Children enjoy summer camp activities like swimming and hiking.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们喜欢夏令营的活动，比如游泳和远足。

examples.sentence: They found a perfect camp site by the lake.
examples.translation_zh: 他们在湖边找到了一个完美的营地。

examples.sentence: We will camp out under the stars this weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 我们这个周末将在星空下露营。

brain.def_en: The organ in the head responsible for thought and memory.

examples.sentence: You should use your brain to solve this problem.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该动用大脑来解决这个问题。

examples.sentence: Scientists study brain activity to understand how we think.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家研究大脑活动以了解我们如何思考。

examples.sentence: Proper nutrition is essential for brain development in children.
examples.translation_zh: 适当的营养对儿童的大脑发育至关重要。

feature.def_en: A distinctive attribute or aspect of something.

examples.sentence: Many companies list key features of their products.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司列出了其产品的主要特征。

examples.sentence: This course's main features include online classes and workshops.
examples.translation_zh: 本课程的主要特征包括在线课程和研讨会。

examples.sentence: The unique features of this city attract many tourists.
examples.translation_zh: 这座城市的独特特征吸引了许多游客。

press.def_en: To apply force to something to shape or move it.

examples.sentence: The team held a press conference after the match.
examples.translation_zh: 赛后，团队召开了新闻发布会。

examples.sentence: She decided to press charges against the attacker.
examples.translation_zh: 她决定对攻击者提出指控。

examples.sentence: You need to press a button to start the machine.
examples.translation_zh: 你需要按一下按钮来启动机器。

possibility.def_en: A chance that something may happen or be true.

examples.sentence: Many people believe in the possibility of success.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人相信成功的可能性。

examples.sentence: Students have the possibility to change their majors.
examples.translation_zh: 学生有可能更改专业。

examples.sentence: There is a possibility for improvement in his condition.
examples.translation_zh: 他的情况有好转的可能性。

insurance.def_en: A contract providing financial protection against loss or damage.

examples.sentence: Most people have health insurance for medical expenses.
examples.translation_zh: 大多数人都有健康保险以支付医疗费用。

examples.sentence: Employees must provide proof of car insurance for their vehicles.
examples.translation_zh: 员工必须提供他们车辆的汽车保险证明。

examples.sentence: She bought travel insurance before her trip to Europe.
examples.translation_zh: 她在前往欧洲的旅行前购买了旅游保险。

department.def_en: A distinct part of an organization or institution.

examples.sentence: She works in the marketing department of the company.
examples.translation_zh: 她在公司的市场部门工作。

examples.sentence: The department of education oversees all schools in the state.
examples.translation_zh: 教育部门监管该州所有学校。

examples.sentence: We bought clothes at the department store downtown.
examples.translation_zh: 我们在市中心的百货商店买了衣服。

dozen.def_en: A group of twelve items or people.

examples.sentence: We bought a dozen eggs for the recipe.
examples.translation_zh: 我们为这个食谱买了一打鸡蛋。

examples.sentence: She received a dozen flowers on her birthday.
examples.translation_zh: 她在生日那天收到了十二朵花。

examples.sentence: A dozen students attended the workshop last week.
examples.translation_zh: 上周有十二名学生参加了这个研讨会。

beginning.def_en: The point in time or space at which something starts.

examples.sentence: Students often feel excited at the beginning of the year.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在年初常常感到兴奋。

examples.sentence: Many people believe in the idea of a new beginning.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人相信新开始的想法。

examples.sentence: At the beginning, we faced many challenges in this project.
examples.translation_zh: 在开始时，我们在这个项目中面临许多挑战。

crisis.def_en: A time of intense difficulty or danger.

examples.sentence: Many people lost their jobs during the economic crisis.
examples.translation_zh: 在经济危机期间，许多人失去了工作。

examples.sentence: The country faced a serious health crisis last year.
examples.translation_zh: 去年该国面临严重的健康危机。

examples.sentence: Scientists warned about the environmental crisis affecting wildlife.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家警告说，影响野生生物的环境危机正在加剧。

battle.def_en: A fight or struggle between opposing forces.

examples.sentence: The battle between rivals has intensified this year.
examples.translation_zh: 今年，竞争对手之间的战斗加剧了。

examples.sentence: Our team is in a battle for control of the project.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的团队正在争夺该项目的控制权。

examples.sentence: Many people are in a battle against disease every day.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人每天都在与疾病作斗争。

generally.def_en: In most cases; not always but frequently.

examples.sentence: Scientists generally accepted the new theory for its simplicity.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家们通常接受这个新理论，因为它简单。

examples.sentence: Generally speaking, people enjoy spending time with family.
examples.translation_zh: 一般来说，人们喜欢和家人共度时光。

examples.sentence: This issue is generally known to affect many communities.
examples.translation_zh: 这个问题通常被认为影响许多社区。

stick.def_en: A thin piece of wood or other material.

examples.sentence: Employees must stick to the rules at all times.
examples.translation_zh: 员工必须始终遵守规则。

examples.sentence: Friends should always stick together in difficult times.
examples.translation_zh: 朋友在困难时期应始终团结在一起。

examples.sentence: His bright shirt really sticks out in the crowd.
examples.translation_zh: 他那件鲜亮的衬衫在人群中非常显眼。

complete.def_en: Having all necessary parts or elements; not lacking anything.

examples.sentence: I have a complete set of dishes for dinner.
examples.translation_zh: 我有一整套晚餐的碗碟。

examples.sentence: She submitted a complete report to her manager yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 她昨天向经理提交了一份完整的报告。

examples.sentence: The project ended in complete failure due to poor planning.
examples.translation_zh: 由于规划不当，该项目完全失败。

define.def_en: To explain the meaning of a word or concept.

examples.sentence: You should define a term before using it in your paper.
examples.translation_zh: 在论文中使用术语之前，您应该先定义该术语。

examples.sentence: Our team will define the rules for the project soon.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的团队将很快定义项目的规则。

examples.sentence: It is important to define your goals for the year.
examples.translation_zh: 为这一年定义目标是重要的。

fan.def_en: A device for creating airflow or a supporter.

examples.sentence: Many fans of the show will attend the premiere.
examples.translation_zh: 许多该节目的迷将参加首映。

examples.sentence: You should not fan the flames of the argument.
examples.translation_zh: 你不应该煽动争论的火焰。

examples.sentence: She turned on the electric fan to cool the room.
examples.translation_zh: 她打开电风扇以降温房间。

hole.def_en: An opening or hollow space in a solid object.

examples.sentence: We found a big hole in the ground.
examples.translation_zh: 我们在地上发现了一个大洞。

examples.sentence: The drain hole needs to be cleaned regularly.
examples.translation_zh: 排水孔需要定期清理。

examples.sentence: Authorities discovered a bullet hole in the wall.
examples.translation_zh: 当局发现墙上有一个子弹孔。

element.def_en: A basic part or component of something.

examples.sentence: Chemical elements are necessary for all living organisms.
examples.translation_zh: 化学元素对所有生物体都是必需的。

examples.sentence: Teachers focus on key elements of effective learning.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们关注高效学习的关键要素。

examples.sentence: There was an element of surprise at the birthday party.
examples.translation_zh: 生日派对上有一个惊喜的元素。

vision.def_en: The ability to see or plan for the future.

examples.sentence: Leaders should share a clear business vision with employees.
examples.translation_zh: 领导者应该与员工分享清晰的业务愿景。

examples.sentence: Many students define their career vision before graduating.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生在毕业前明确他们的职业愿景。

examples.sentence: Researchers often have a scientific vision for their projects.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员通常对他们的项目有科学的远见。

easily.def_en: In a manner that is not difficult or requiring effort.

examples.sentence: Information should be easily accessible to all students.
examples.translation_zh: 信息应该对所有学生容易获取。

examples.sentence: This instruction manual is easily understood by everyone.
examples.translation_zh: 这本说明书每个人都能轻松理解。

examples.sentence: Many young people are easily influenced by social media.
examples.translation_zh: 许多年轻人容易受到社交媒体的影响。

status.def_en: A position or rank in relation to others.

examples.sentence: Many people care about their social status in society.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人关心自己在社会中的社会地位。

examples.sentence: She changed her job status to full-time after six months.
examples.translation_zh: 她在六个月后将工作状态改为全职。

examples.sentence: The report shows the current status of the project clearly.
examples.translation_zh: 报告清晰地显示了项目的当前状态。

stone.def_en: A hard, solid substance found in nature.

examples.sentence: We built a stone wall around the garden.
examples.translation_zh: 我们在花园周围建了一道石墙。

examples.sentence: Jewelry stores sell many precious stones for making rings.
examples.translation_zh: 珠宝店出售许多宝石用于制作戒指。

examples.sentence: The stone age was a significant period in human history.
examples.translation_zh: 石器时代是人类历史上的一个重要时期。

solution.def_en: A means of solving a problem or dealing with a difficult situation.

examples.sentence: Teachers often need a problem solution for their students.
examples.translation_zh: 教师们常常需要为他们的学生找到解决办法。

examples.sentence: Finding an effective solution can improve team performance.
examples.translation_zh: 找到有效的解决办法可以提高团队表现。

examples.sentence: Researchers are looking for a creative solution to this issue.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员正在寻找这个问题的创新解决办法。

scale.def_en: The size or extent of something, often measured.

examples.sentence: The company plans to expand its operations on a large scale.
examples.translation_zh: 该公司计划大规模扩展其运营。

examples.sentence: We need to scale up our production to meet demand.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要扩大生产以满足需求。

examples.sentence: They decided to scale back their expenses this month.
examples.translation_zh: 他们决定本月缩减开支。

normal.def_en: Usual, typical, or expected in behavior or appearance.

examples.sentence: Most people follow normal behavior in social settings.
examples.translation_zh: 大多数人在社交场合遵循正常的行为。

examples.sentence: The doctor said my normal temperature is 37 degrees.
examples.translation_zh: 医生说我的正常体温是三十七度。

examples.sentence: After the crisis, we try to return to normal life.
examples.translation_zh: 危机过后，我们努力回归正常生活。

attempt.def_en: An effort to accomplish something or try.

examples.sentence: Students attempt to solve a problem in class.
examples.translation_zh: 学生在课堂上尝试解决一个问题。

examples.sentence: The scientist attempted to explain the new findings.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家尝试解释新的发现。

examples.sentence: They are attempting to improve the project outcomes.
examples.translation_zh: 他们正在尝试改善项目结果。

spot.def_en: A small mark or stain on a surface.

examples.sentence: Can you spot the difference between these two pictures?
examples.translation_zh: 你能找到这两张图片之间的不同吗？

examples.sentence: Every driver should be aware of their blind spots when driving.
examples.translation_zh: 每位司机在开车时都应该意识到盲区。

examples.sentence: Scientists monitor hot spots for volcanic activity regularly.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家定期监测火山活动的热点。

introduce.def_en: To make someone known to another person or group.

examples.sentence: Please introduce yourself to everyone in the room.
examples.translation_zh: 请向房间里的每个人介绍自己。

examples.sentence: Our company will introduce a new product next month.
examples.translation_zh: 我们公司下个月将推出一款新产品。

examples.sentence: Teachers should introduce new ideas to inspire students.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们应该引入新想法来激励学生。

distance.def_en: The amount of space between two points or objects.

examples.sentence: Traveling great distances can be tiring for many people.
examples.translation_zh: 长途旅行对很多人来说是很累的。

examples.sentence: He lives a short distance from his workplace every day.
examples.translation_zh: 他每天住在离工作地点很近的地方。

examples.sentence: Distance learning allows students to study from anywhere in the world.
examples.translation_zh: 远程学习使学生可以在世界任何地方学习。

lack.def_en: Not having enough of something needed or desired.

examples.sentence: Many children suffer from a lack of access to education.
examples.translation_zh: 许多儿童缺乏接受教育的机会。

examples.sentence: She feels a lack of support from her friends.
examples.translation_zh: 她感到缺乏朋友的支持。

examples.sentence: The team faced a lack of resources for the project.
examples.translation_zh: 团队面临项目资源不足的问题。

survey.def_en: A method for collecting data about a group or area.

examples.sentence: Companies often conduct market surveys to understand customer needs.
examples.translation_zh: 公司通常进行市场调查，以了解客户需求。

examples.sentence: Opinion surveys show what people think about current issues.
examples.translation_zh: 民意调查显示人们对当前问题的看法。

examples.sentence: The national survey collects health data from various regions.
examples.translation_zh: 国家调查收集来自不同地区的健康数据。

truck.def_en: A large vehicle for transporting goods.

examples.sentence: A delivery truck arrived at my house this morning.
examples.translation_zh: 今天早上，一辆送货卡车到达了我家。

examples.sentence: He drives a pickup truck for his construction job.
examples.translation_zh: 他为了建筑工作开一辆皮卡卡车。

examples.sentence: Freight trucks are essential for moving goods across the country.
examples.translation_zh: 货运卡车对于在全国范围内运输货物至关重要。

tradition.def_en: A long-established custom or belief passed down through generations.

examples.sentence: Many cultural traditions are celebrated every year in my country.
examples.translation_zh: 在我的国家，每年都会庆祝许多文化传统。

examples.sentence: Our family traditions include special meals during holidays.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的家庭传统包括节日期间的特别餐点。

examples.sentence: Visitors should respect local traditions when traveling abroad.
examples.translation_zh: 游客在国外旅行时应尊重当地传统。

wood.def_en: Material made from trees, used for building and furniture.

examples.sentence: They bought new wood furniture for their living room.
examples.translation_zh: 他们为客厅购买了新的木质家具。

examples.sentence: Artists create beautiful wood carvings in the workshop.
examples.translation_zh: 艺术家们在工作室里制作精美的木雕。

examples.sentence: Many wood products come from sustainable sources nowadays.
examples.translation_zh: 现在许多木材产品来自可持续来源。

refuse.def_en: To indicate unwillingness to accept or do something.

examples.sentence: She refuses to accept any help from her friends.
examples.translation_zh: 她拒绝接受朋友们的任何帮助。

examples.sentence: He refuses to answer questions about the incident.
examples.translation_zh: 他拒绝回答有关事件的问题。

examples.sentence: The company refuses service to customers without identification.
examples.translation_zh: 公司拒绝为没有身份证明的客户提供服务。

handle.def_en: A part used to hold or control something.

examples.sentence: She can easily handle a problem like this.
examples.translation_zh: 她能轻松处理这样的难题。

examples.sentence: Many people struggle to handle stress in their lives.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在生活中难以应对压力。

examples.sentence: You need to handle the situation with care.
examples.translation_zh: 你需要小心应对这种情况。

roll.def_en: To move in a circular or curved path.

examples.sentence: Children love to roll the ball on the ground.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们喜欢在地上滚球。

examples.sentence: We need to roll out the carpet for the event.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要为活动铺开地毯。

examples.sentence: Many fans love to roll in the deep emotions of the song.
examples.translation_zh: 许多粉丝喜欢沉浸在这首歌的深情中。

gain.def_en: To obtain or increase something, usually positive.

examples.sentence: You can gain experience by working part-time jobs.
examples.translation_zh: 你可以通过做兼职工作获得经验。

examples.sentence: Many people try not to gain weight during the holidays.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人假期期间都尽量不增重。

examples.sentence: The story gained attention after it went viral online.
examples.translation_zh: 这个故事在网上走红后引起了关注。

screen.def_en: A flat surface to display visual information.

examples.sentence: Many children spend too much screen time every day.
examples.translation_zh: 许多孩子每天花太多时间在屏幕上。

examples.sentence: Doctors often screen for diseases during regular check-ups.
examples.translation_zh: 医生在常规检查中经常筛查疾病。

examples.sentence: We will screen a movie at the community center this weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 我们将在社区中心放一部电影。

gold.def_en: A yellow precious metal, often used for jewelry.

examples.sentence: I bought some beautiful gold jewelry for my mother.
examples.translation_zh: 我为妈妈买了一些漂亮的黄金首饰。

examples.sentence: She won a gold medal in the Olympic Games last year.
examples.translation_zh: 她去年在奥运会上获得了金牌。

examples.sentence: They discovered a gold mine in the mountains last summer.
examples.translation_zh: 他们去年夏天在山里发现了一座金矿。

resident.def_en: A person who lives in a particular place.

examples.sentence: Many local residents enjoy the park every weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 许多当地居民每个周末都喜欢这个公园。

examples.sentence: She is a permanent resident of this city now.
examples.translation_zh: 她现在是这座城市的永久居民。

examples.sentence: The resident doctor will see you in a few minutes.
examples.translation_zh: 住院医生几分钟后会来看你。

hide.def_en: To put or keep out of sight.

examples.sentence: People often hide the evidence of their mistakes.
examples.translation_zh: 人们常常隐藏自己错误的证据。

examples.sentence: She decided to hide behind a mask during the festival.
examples.translation_zh: 她决定在节日中戴上面具隐藏自己。

examples.sentence: Travelers should hide from the rain under the bridge.
examples.translation_zh: 旅客应在桥下躲避雨水。

presence.def_en: The state of being in a place or situation.

examples.sentence: Companies need a strong online presence to succeed.
examples.translation_zh: 公司需要强大的在线存在才能成功。

examples.sentence: Her physical presence made the party more enjoyable.
examples.translation_zh: 她的出席让聚会更加愉快。

examples.sentence: He showed great presence of mind during the emergency.
examples.translation_zh: 他在紧急情况下表现出极大的镇定。

potential.def_en: Having the capacity to develop into something in the future.

examples.sentence: Many potential risks exist in this medical procedure.
examples.translation_zh: 这个医疗程序存在许多潜在风险。

examples.sentence: We are looking for potential customers to increase sales.
examples.translation_zh: 我们正在寻找潜在客户以增加销售。

examples.sentence: Finding potential solutions is important for improving education.
examples.translation_zh: 寻找潜在解决方案对改善教育很重要。

club.def_en: A place for socializing or entertainment activities.

examples.sentence: They danced all night at the local night club.
examples.translation_zh: 他们在当地的夜总会整晚跳舞。

examples.sentence: She enjoys discussing novels with her book club.
examples.translation_zh: 她喜欢和书友会讨论小说。

examples.sentence: He joined a sports club to improve his fitness.
examples.translation_zh: 他加入了一个体育俱乐部以提高身体素质。

district.def_en: An area or region defined for a specific purpose.

examples.sentence: Many students live in the same school district.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生住在同一个学区。

examples.sentence: The business district is always busy during the day.
examples.translation_zh: 商业区在白天总是很繁忙。

examples.sentence: Each voting district has its own election rules.
examples.translation_zh: 每个投票区都有自己的选举规则。

independent.def_en: Not relying on others for help or support.

examples.sentence: Students often prefer independent study to group work.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们通常喜欢独立学习而不是小组合作。

examples.sentence: Every independent country has its own government and laws.
examples.translation_zh: 每个独立国家都有自己的政府和法律。

examples.sentence: Many seniors enjoy independent living in their own homes.
examples.translation_zh: 许多老年人喜欢在自己的家中独立生活。

shape.def_en: The external form or appearance of something.

examples.sentence: Teachers help shape the future of their students.
examples.translation_zh: 老师帮助塑造学生的未来。

examples.sentence: She exercises regularly to stay in good shape.
examples.translation_zh: 她定期锻炼以保持良好的状态。

examples.sentence: Experts discuss the shape of things to come in technology.
examples.translation_zh: 专家讨论未来科技的发展趋势。

contract.def_en: A written agreement between two or more parties.

examples.sentence: Every employee must sign a contract before starting work.
examples.translation_zh: 每位员工在入职前必须签署合同。

examples.sentence: A breach of contract can lead to legal issues.
examples.translation_zh: 违反合同可能会导致法律问题。

examples.sentence: The team decided to renew a contract with the player.
examples.translation_zh: 球队决定与球员续签合同。

express.def_en: To convey thoughts or feelings through words or actions.

examples.sentence: Friends often help you express your feelings clearly.
examples.translation_zh: 朋友们常常帮助你清楚地表达自己的感受。

examples.sentence: The officials express concern about the recent weather changes.
examples.translation_zh: 官员们对最近的天气变化表示关切。

examples.sentence: Teachers usually express a preference for group projects.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们通常更喜欢小组项目。

reader.def_en: A person who reads books or articles regularly.

examples.sentence: Many avid readers enjoy discussing their favorite books.
examples.translation_zh: 许多热心读者喜欢讨论他们最喜欢的书籍。

examples.sentence: The article is written for target readers interested in science.
examples.translation_zh: 这篇文章是为对科学感兴趣的目标读者写的。

examples.sentence: Teachers encourage young readers to explore different genres.
examples.translation_zh: 教师鼓励年轻读者探索不同的体裁。

crowd.def_en: A large number of people gathered together.

examples.sentence: A crowd of people gathered at the bus stop today.
examples.translation_zh: 今天，很多人聚集在公交车站。

examples.sentence: New technology can crowd out older methods in the workplace.
examples.translation_zh: 新技术可能会在工作场所取代旧的方法。

examples.sentence: Police managed crowd control during the festival last night.
examples.translation_zh: 昨晚，警方成功地控制了节日的现场人潮。

willing.def_en: Ready to act or agree; not reluctant.

examples.sentence: Many people are willing to help those in need.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人乐意帮助有需要的人。

examples.sentence: Teachers need willing participants for their new project.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们需要乐意参与他们新项目的学生。

examples.sentence: Our team welcomes willing volunteers for the event.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的团队欢迎乐意参加活动的志愿者。

apartment.def_en: A self-contained housing unit that occupies part of a building.

examples.sentence: Many people decide to rent an apartment in the city.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人决定在城市里租公寓。

examples.sentence: Some families plan to buy an apartment this year.
examples.translation_zh: 一些家庭计划今年购买公寓。

examples.sentence: We will move into an apartment next month.
examples.translation_zh: 我们下个月将搬进公寓。

previous.def_en: Existing or occurring before something else.

examples.sentence: My previous experience helped me get this job.
examples.translation_zh: 我之前的经验帮助我得到了这份工作。

examples.sentence: We discussed the results of previous meetings yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 我们昨天讨论了之前会议的结果。

examples.sentence: Previous studies show that exercise improves mental health.
examples.translation_zh: 之前的研究表明锻炼改善心理健康。

strength.def_en: The quality or state of being strong or powerful.

examples.sentence: He trains hard to improve his physical strength.
examples.translation_zh: 他努力训练以提高他的身体力量。

examples.sentence: Many leaders demonstrate strength of character in tough situations.
examples.translation_zh: 许多领导者在困难情况下展现出坚定的品格。

examples.sentence: She found her inner strength during challenging times.
examples.translation_zh: 在困难时期，她找到了内心的力量。

band.def_en: A group of musicians performing together or a strip material.

examples.sentence: Many fans love to watch their favorite rock band live.
examples.translation_zh: 许多粉丝喜欢现场观看他们最喜欢的摇滚乐队。

examples.sentence: I need a rubber band to hold these papers together.
examples.translation_zh: 我需要一根橡皮筋把这些纸固定在一起。

examples.sentence: A band of light appeared on the horizon at sunset.
examples.translation_zh: 日落时，地平线上出现了一道光带。

target.def_en: An aim or desired result to achieve.

examples.sentence: Many companies focus on their marketing targets each year.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司每年都专注于他们的市场目标。

examples.sentence: The movie had a young target audience in mind.
examples.translation_zh: 这部电影的目标观众是年轻人。

examples.sentence: Students celebrate their target achievements at the school event.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在学校活动中庆祝他们的目标成就。

prison.def_en: A place where criminals are imprisoned; a correctional facility.

examples.sentence: Many people fear they will go to prison.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人担心自己会入狱。

examples.sentence: The judge gave him a long prison sentence for theft.
examples.translation_zh: 法官因盗窃判处他长时间监禁。

examples.sentence: Life in prison can be very challenging for inmates.
examples.translation_zh: 在监狱里的生活对囚犯来说非常艰难。

obviously.def_en: In a way that is easily seen or understood.

examples.sentence: This theory is obviously true based on the evidence.
examples.translation_zh: 根据证据，这一理论显然是正确的。

examples.sentence: The new policy is obviously important for our economy.
examples.translation_zh: 这一新政策显然对我们的经济很重要。

examples.sentence: She is obviously happy at the party tonight.
examples.translation_zh: 她今晚在派对上显然很开心。

guard.def_en: To protect or keep watch over something.

examples.sentence: Many buildings have a security guard at the entrance.
examples.translation_zh: 许多建筑物在入口处都有保安。

examples.sentence: We must guard against spreading the flu this winter.
examples.translation_zh: 我们必须防止这个冬天流感的传播。

examples.sentence: In relationships, it is important to guard your heart.
examples.translation_zh: 在关系中，保护你的心是很重要的。

reporter.def_en: A person who reports news for media outlets.

examples.sentence: She is a news reporter for the local newspaper.
examples.translation_zh: 她是当地报纸的新闻记者。

examples.sentence: The sports reporter covered the big game yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 体育记者昨天报道了这场重要的比赛。

examples.sentence: Field reporters often interview people in various locations.
examples.translation_zh: 现场记者经常在不同地点采访人们。

demand.def_en: A strong request for something or someone.

examples.sentence: Consumer demand is rising for electric cars this year.
examples.translation_zh: 今年，电动汽车的消费者需求正在上升。

examples.sentence: There is a high demand for education in developing countries.
examples.translation_zh: 发展中国家对教育的需求很高。

examples.sentence: Employees often demand more benefits from their employers.
examples.translation_zh: 员工通常要求雇主提供更多福利。

deliver.def_en: To bring or hand over goods or messages.

examples.sentence: He will deliver a package to my house tomorrow.
examples.translation_zh: 他明天会把一个包裹送到我家。

examples.sentence: She will deliver a speech at the conference next week.
examples.translation_zh: 她下周将在会议上发表演讲。

examples.sentence: Teachers aim to deliver results for their students each year.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们每年都希望为学生取得好成绩。

tool.def_en: An object used to perform a task or function.

examples.sentence: Carpenters use hand tools to build furniture every day.
examples.translation_zh: 木匠每天使用手工具来制作家具。

examples.sentence: Researchers use software tools to analyze data effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员使用软件工具有效地分析数据。

examples.sentence: Teachers should use educational tools to engage their students.
examples.translation_zh: 教师应该使用教育工具来吸引学生的注意。

vehicle.def_en: A machine used for transporting people or goods.

examples.sentence: Many people use public vehicles to commute each day.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人每天都使用公共交通工具上下班。

examples.sentence: Employees are encouraged to use private vehicles for business travel.
examples.translation_zh: 员工被鼓励使用私人交通工具进行商务旅行。

examples.sentence: Electric vehicles are becoming more popular due to climate concerns.
examples.translation_zh: 由于气候问题，电动车越来越受欢迎。

facility.def_en: A place or equipment designed for a specific purpose.

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy using the new sports facility nearby.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人喜欢使用附近的新体育设施。

examples.sentence: The school has a modern educational facility for students.
examples.translation_zh: 这所学校为学生提供现代化的教育设施。

examples.sentence: Patients can receive treatment at this medical facility.
examples.translation_zh: 患者可以在这家医疗设施接受治疗。

observe.def_en: To watch something carefully in order to learn about it.

examples.sentence: Scientists observe changes in the weather every season.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家每个季节都会观察天气变化。

examples.sentence: Visitors can observe wildlife in the national park.
examples.translation_zh: 游客可以在国家公园观察野生动物。

examples.sentence: Employees must observe rules to maintain a safe workplace.
examples.translation_zh: 员工必须遵守规则以保持安全的工作环境。

wild.def_en: Living or growing in the natural environment.

examples.sentence: Many wild animals live in the forest and fields.
examples.translation_zh: 许多野生动物生活在森林和田野中。

examples.sentence: People often have wild parties during the summer holidays.
examples.translation_zh: 人们在暑假期间经常举行狂野的派对。

examples.sentence: Children have a wild imagination about adventures in stories.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们对故事中的冒险有狂野的想象力。

understanding.def_en: The ability to grasp meaning or comprehend something.

examples.sentence: We should work towards mutual understanding among different cultures.
examples.translation_zh: 我们应该努力实现不同文化之间的相互理解。

examples.sentence: Students need a clear understanding of the subject matter.
examples.translation_zh: 学生需要对学科内容有清晰的理解。

examples.sentence: She has a deep understanding of the project requirements.
examples.translation_zh: 她对项目需求有深入的理解。

emerge.def_en: To come into view or become noticeable.

examples.sentence: Children often emerge from the shadows at night.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们常常在夜晚从阴影中出现。

examples.sentence: He will emerge as a leader in the company soon.
examples.translation_zh: 他很快将在公司中崭露头角。

examples.sentence: New information will emerge in the news tomorrow.
examples.translation_zh: 明天将有新消息在新闻中出现。

average.def_en: A value that represents the central or typical amount.

examples.sentence: Students usually aim for an average score on exams.
examples.translation_zh: 学生通常以达到考试的平均分为目标。

examples.sentence: My friend is slightly taller than the average height.
examples.translation_zh: 我的朋友比平均身高稍微高一些。

examples.sentence: The average temperature in summer can be very high.
examples.translation_zh: 夏天的平均气温可以非常高。

earn.def_en: To receive money for work or services.

examples.sentence: Many people earn money by working hard every day.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人每天都努力工作挣得钱。

examples.sentence: He earns a salary that allows him to live comfortably.
examples.translation_zh: 他的薪水使他能够过上舒适的生活。

examples.sentence: Students earn respect by showing commitment to their studies.
examples.translation_zh: 学生通过对学习的投入来赢得尊重。

leadership.def_en: The ability to guide or direct a group or organization.

examples.sentence: Strong leadership helps teams achieve their goals more effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 强有力的领导帮助团队更有效地实现目标。

examples.sentence: Effective leadership is important for a successful school environment.
examples.translation_zh: 有效的领导对于成功的学校环境很重要。

examples.sentence: Many people develop their leadership skills through volunteering activities.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人通过志愿活动发展他们的领导技能。

basis.def_en: The underlying support or foundation for an idea or argument.

examples.sentence: I exercise on a regular basis to stay healthy.
examples.translation_zh: 我定期锻炼以保持健康。

examples.sentence: Students need a solid basis for future learning.
examples.translation_zh: 学生需要扎实的基础以便未来学习。

examples.sentence: The basis of research is to discover new knowledge.
examples.translation_zh: 研究的基础是发现新知识。

advantage.def_en: A condition or circumstance that puts one in a favorable position.

examples.sentence: Companies need a competitive advantage to succeed in the market.
examples.translation_zh: 公司需要竞争优势才能在市场上成功。

examples.sentence: You should take advantage of the sales before they end.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该在打折结束之前抓住这个机会。

examples.sentence: This technology gives researchers an advantage over previous methods.
examples.translation_zh: 这项技术给研究人员带来了比以往方法更大的优势。

operate.def_en: To control or manage a machine or system.

examples.sentence: Workers operate the machine carefully during the day.
examples.translation_zh: 工人在白天小心地操作机器。

examples.sentence: Doctors operate on patients to improve their health.
examples.translation_zh: 医生对病人进行手术以改善他们的健康。

examples.sentence: Many companies operate in different countries around the world.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司在世界各地的不同国家运营。

sample.def_en: A small part or quantity intended to show what the whole is like.

examples.sentence: The sample size for the study was 100 participants.
examples.translation_zh: 该研究的样本大小为100名参与者。

examples.sentence: You need to analyze the sample data before the meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 你需要在会议之前分析样本数据。

examples.sentence: Teachers often give students sample questions for practice.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们经常给学生样本问题以供练习。

tiny.def_en: Very small in size or amount.

examples.sentence: Many people want to live in a tiny house.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人想住在微小的房子里。

examples.sentence: A tiny animal can have a big impact on the ecosystem.
examples.translation_zh: 微小的动物可以对生态系统产生重大影响。

examples.sentence: He focused on the tiny details of the project.
examples.translation_zh: 他专注于项目的微小细节。

pound.def_en: A unit of weight equal to 16 ounces.

examples.sentence: I bought a pound of meat for dinner tonight.
examples.translation_zh: 我今晚买了一磅肉做晚餐。

examples.sentence: The pound sign is used for British currency.
examples.translation_zh: 镑符号用于表示英国货币。

examples.sentence: He had to pound the pavement to find a new job.
examples.translation_zh: 他不得不在街上四处寻找新工作。

contribute.def_en: To give something, especially money or help, for a purpose.

examples.sentence: Many people contribute to society by volunteering their time.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人通过志愿服务贡献给社会。

examples.sentence: Companies often contribute money to support local charities.
examples.translation_zh: 公司通常会捐款支持当地慈善机构。

examples.sentence: Students contribute ideas during class discussions to enhance learning.
examples.translation_zh: 学生在课堂讨论中贡献想法以增强学习。

protection.def_en: The act of keeping someone or something safe from harm.

examples.sentence: Governments must ensure environmental protection for future generations.
examples.translation_zh: 政府必须确保未来几代人的环境保护。

examples.sentence: Companies need strong data protection to safeguard customer information.
examples.translation_zh: 公司需要强有力的数据保护来保护客户信息。

examples.sentence: Some people wear helmets for personal protection while riding bikes.
examples.translation_zh: 有些人在骑自行车时佩戴头盔以进行个人保护。

settle.def_en: To establish a residence or resolve a situation.

examples.sentence: Many people prefer to settle down in small towns.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人更喜欢在小镇安定下来。

examples.sentence: They need to settle an argument about project deadlines.
examples.translation_zh: 他们需要解决关于项目截止日期的争论。

examples.sentence: Students often take time to settle in during the first week.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们通常在第一周花时间适应环境。

collect.def_en: To gather together; to accumulate items or information.

examples.sentence: Researchers collect data to analyze climate change effects.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员收集数据以分析气候变化的影响。

examples.sentence: Many children collect stamps as a fun hobby.
examples.translation_zh: 许多孩子把收集邮票当作一种有趣的爱好。

examples.sentence: Organizations collect donations to help those in need.
examples.translation_zh: 组织收集捐款以帮助有需要的人。

feed.def_en: To give food or nourishment to someone or something.

examples.sentence: Farmers feed their animals every morning and evening.
examples.translation_zh: 农民每天早晚喂养他们的动物。

examples.sentence: Parents usually feed the children healthy meals after school.
examples.translation_zh: 父母通常在放学后给孩子们提供健康的饮食。

examples.sentence: The journalist must feed information to her editor promptly.
examples.translation_zh: 这位记者必须及时向她的编辑提供信息。

identity.def_en: The characteristics determining who or what someone is.

examples.sentence: People often express their cultural identity through traditions.
examples.translation_zh: 人们常常通过传统来表达他们的文化身份。

examples.sentence: She is exploring her personal identity after moving to a new city.
examples.translation_zh: 她在搬到新城市后探索自己的个人身份。

examples.sentence: The article discusses the challenges of national identity today.
examples.translation_zh: 这篇文章讨论了今天国家身份面临的挑战。

highly.def_en: To a great degree or extent; very.

examples.sentence: Friends always say this restaurant is highly recommended.
examples.translation_zh: 朋友们总是说这家餐厅非常推荐。

examples.sentence: The new methods are highly effective in increasing productivity.
examples.translation_zh: 这些新方法在提高生产力方面非常有效。

examples.sentence: It is highly unlikely that the event will be canceled.
examples.translation_zh: 活动取消的可能性非常小。

mostly.def_en: Mainly; for the most part or primarily.

examples.sentence: Today is mostly sunny with a few clouds.
examples.translation_zh: 今天大部分时间都是晴天，偶尔有几朵云。

examples.sentence: We mostly agree on the project's goals and objectives.
examples.translation_zh: 我们大多数人都同意这个项目的目标和宗旨。

examples.sentence: The species is mostly found in tropical regions.
examples.translation_zh: 这种物种主要分布在热带地区。

title.def_en: A name of a book, song, or other work.

examples.sentence: She wrote a fascinating book title about travel.
examples.translation_zh: 她写了一本关于旅行的有趣书名。

examples.sentence: My job title is Marketing Manager at the company.
examples.translation_zh: 我的职位是公司的市场经理。

examples.sentence: Have you seen the new movie title released last week?
examples.translation_zh: 你看过上周上映的新电影标题吗？

count.def_en: To determine the total number of items or units.

examples.sentence: People will count the votes after the election.
examples.translation_zh: 选举后，人们会计算选票。

examples.sentence: I can always count on my best friend for help.
examples.translation_zh: 我总是可以依赖我最好的朋友提供帮助。

examples.sentence: Sometimes we need to count our blessings in life.
examples.translation_zh: 有时我们需要珍惜生活中的美好。

faith.def_en: Complete trust or confidence in someone or something.

examples.sentence: Many people have faith in their leaders today.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人今天对他们的领导者充满信任。

examples.sentence: She attends a faith-based school that teaches values.
examples.translation_zh: 她上的是一所教授价值观的宗教学校。

examples.sentence: The faith community often supports local charities together.
examples.translation_zh: 信仰团体通常一起支持当地慈善机构。

unless.def_en: Except on the condition that; if not.

examples.sentence: You won't know the answer unless you ask.
examples.translation_zh: 除非你问，否则你不会知道答案。

examples.sentence: We will go hiking unless it rains tomorrow.
examples.translation_zh: 我们明天去远足，除非下雨。

examples.sentence: Assume the rules apply unless stated otherwise in the document.
examples.translation_zh: 假设这些规则适用，除非文件中另有说明。

marry.def_en: To join in marriage with someone.

examples.sentence: They will get married next summer in July.
examples.translation_zh: 他们将在明年七月结婚。

examples.sentence: She wants to marry someone special in her life.
examples.translation_zh: 她想和生活中特别的人结婚。

examples.sentence: The married couple celebrated their anniversary with a party.
examples.translation_zh: 这对已婚夫妇用聚会庆祝他们的周年纪念。

living.def_en: The condition of being alive and active.

examples.sentence: Many families struggle to pay their living expenses each month.
examples.translation_zh: 许多家庭每月都难以支付生活费用。

examples.sentence: The report highlighted the poor living conditions in the city.
examples.translation_zh: 报告强调了城市中恶劣的生活条件。

examples.sentence: Scientists study living things to understand ecosystems better.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家研究生物以更好地理解生态系统。

technique.def_en: A way of doing something skillfully or efficiently.

examples.sentence: Many teachers share their effective teaching techniques online.
examples.translation_zh: 许多教师在网上分享他们有效的教学技巧。

examples.sentence: Different cooking techniques can make meals taste better.
examples.translation_zh: 不同的烹饪技巧可以让食物更美味。

examples.sentence: Scientists are always improving their research techniques for accuracy.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家们总是在不断改进他们的研究技巧以提高精确性。

path.def_en: A way or track laid down for walking.

examples.sentence: Many people choose a clear path to success.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人选择一条通往成功的明确道路。

examples.sentence: I enjoy walking along the beautiful walking paths.
examples.translation_zh: 我喜欢沿着美丽的小路散步。

examples.sentence: Education is a path of learning for everyone.
examples.translation_zh: 教育是每个人学习的道路。

lift.def_en: A device for raising or lowering people or goods.

examples.sentence: He will lift the box onto the shelf.
examples.translation_zh: 他会把箱子搬上架子。

examples.sentence: She tries to lift weights three times a week.
examples.translation_zh: 她每周尝试举重三次。

examples.sentence: Teachers aim to lift spirits among their students.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们旨在提升学生们的士气。

principle.def_en: A basic truth or proposition that serves as the foundation.

examples.sentence: Teachers explain the basic principles of math to students.
examples.translation_zh: 老师向学生解释数学的基本原则。

examples.sentence: Companies should follow ethical principles in their business practices.
examples.translation_zh: 公司在商业实践中应遵循伦理原则。

examples.sentence: Researchers apply scientific principles to solve complex problems.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员应用科学原则来解决复杂问题。

border.def_en: A line separating two areas, especially countries.

examples.sentence: Authorities increased border control to manage the flow of people.
examples.translation_zh: 当局加强了边界管控，以管理人口流动。

examples.sentence: A border dispute between two nations can cause tension.
examples.translation_zh: 两个国家之间的边界争端可能引起紧张局势。

examples.sentence: Travelers must show documents at the border crossing point.
examples.translation_zh: 旅行者必须在边界通行点出示文件。

competition.def_en: An event where people or groups compete against each other.

examples.sentence: Many athletes train hard for sports competitions every year.
examples.translation_zh: 许多运动员每年都为体育竞赛而努力训练。

examples.sentence: There is fierce competition for jobs in the city now.
examples.translation_zh: 现在城市里的职位竞争非常激烈。

examples.sentence: Schools often hold academic competitions to encourage students.
examples.translation_zh: 学校经常举办学术竞赛以鼓励学生。

folk.def_en: Relating to the traditional culture of a community.

examples.sentence: Folk traditions are important to many communities today.
examples.translation_zh: 民间传统对许多社区来说很重要。

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy listening to folk music on weekends.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人喜欢在周末听民间音乐。

examples.sentence: In class, we read folk tales from different cultures.
examples.translation_zh: 在课堂上，我们阅读了来自不同文化的民间故事。

gather.def_en: To come together or collect in one place.

examples.sentence: We need to gather information before making decisions.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要在做决定之前收集信息。

examples.sentence: Researchers will gather data for the new project soon.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员将很快收集新项目的数据。

examples.sentence: Children gather around to listen to the story.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们围坐在一起听故事。

limit.def_en: A point beyond which something does not extend or pass.

examples.sentence: Companies often limit the amount of overtime allowed.
examples.translation_zh: 公司通常限制加班的时间。

examples.sentence: Teachers should set a limit on homework assignments.
examples.translation_zh: 老师应该限制家庭作业的数量。

examples.sentence: The city has reached the limit of its borrowing capacity.
examples.translation_zh: 这个城市已经达到了借款能力的上限。

equipment.def_en: Tools or machines used for a specific purpose.

examples.sentence: Children need proper sports equipment for their health.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们需要合适的运动设备来保持健康。

examples.sentence: Hospitals require advanced medical equipment to treat patients.
examples.translation_zh: 医院需要先进的医疗设备来治疗病人。

examples.sentence: The lab has new electronic equipment for experiments.
examples.translation_zh: 实验室有新的电子设备用于实验。

associate.def_en: To connect someone or something with another.

examples.sentence: Many employees associate with their colleagues after work.
examples.translation_zh: 许多员工在下班后与同事们交往。

examples.sentence: Students must associate ideas from different sources in essays.
examples.translation_zh: 学生在论文中必须将不同来源的观点关联起来。

examples.sentence: I often associate certain products with good memories.
examples.translation_zh: 我经常将某些产品与美好的回忆联系在一起。

critic.def_en: A person who evaluates or analyzes creative works or performances.

examples.sentence: Many film critics loved the new movie this year.
examples.translation_zh: 许多电影评论者喜欢今年的新电影。

examples.sentence: She is often a harsh critic of my cooking skills.
examples.translation_zh: 她常常对我的烹饪技巧很苛刻。

examples.sentence: An academic critic reviewed the research paper thoroughly.
examples.translation_zh: 一位学术评论者认真审查了这篇研究论文。

insist.def_en: To demand something firmly and refuse to accept alternatives.

examples.sentence: She insists on going to the party tonight.
examples.translation_zh: 她坚持今晚要去参加派对。

examples.sentence: They insist that we finish the project by Friday.
examples.translation_zh: 他们坚持我们必须在星期五之前完成项目。

examples.sentence: He insists on his students studying every day.
examples.translation_zh: 他坚持让学生们每天学习。

aspect.def_en: A particular part or feature of something.

examples.sentence: Every team member has an important aspect to contribute.
examples.translation_zh: 每个团队成员都有重要的贡献方面。

examples.sentence: Many students study the cultural aspect of different countries.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生研究不同国家的文化方面。

examples.sentence: The scientific aspect of this project is quite fascinating.
examples.translation_zh: 这个项目的科学方面非常吸引人。

examples.sentence: Many teams experience failure to meet deadlines regularly.
examples.translation_zh: 许多团队经常遇到未能按时完成的情况。

examples.sentence: The researchers reported a failure in the experiment's results.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员报告实验结果失败。

examples.sentence: His failure to comply with the rules surprised everyone.
examples.translation_zh: 他未能遵守规则让大家都感到惊讶。

examples.sentence: Managers prepared the annual report for the board meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 经理们为董事会会议准备了年度报告。

examples.sentence: They celebrated the annual festival with music and dance.
examples.translation_zh: 他们用音乐和舞蹈庆祝年度节日。

examples.sentence: Our school holds an annual meeting for parents each spring.
examples.translation_zh: 我们学校每年春天召开一次家长年度会议。

comment.def_en: A remark or discussion about something.

examples.sentence: Many people commented on the recent political events.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人对最近的政治事件进行了评论。

examples.sentence: She made a comment about the weather today.
examples.translation_zh: 她对今天的天气做了一个评论。

examples.sentence: Teachers often give positive comments on students' work.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们经常对学生的作业给予积极的评论。

procedure.def_en: A series of steps to accomplish a task.

examples.sentence: Many patients undergo a medical procedure before surgery.
examples.translation_zh: 许多患者在手术前接受医疗程序。

examples.sentence: Students must follow the application procedure to enroll in college.
examples.translation_zh: 学生必须按照申请程序注册入学。

examples.sentence: We have a standard procedure for handling customer complaints.
examples.translation_zh: 我们有标准程序来处理客户投诉。

affair.def_en: A matter or situation requiring attention or action.

examples.sentence: Many people are concerned about the political affair.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人对这件政治事务感到关心。

examples.sentence: She has a personal affair that needs to be resolved soon.
examples.translation_zh: 她有一件个人事务需要尽快解决。

examples.sentence: They are discussing a business affair at the meeting today.
examples.translation_zh: 他们今天在会议上讨论一件商业事务。

regular.def_en: Occurring at fixed intervals; usual or normal.

examples.sentence: I try to do regular exercise every week.
examples.translation_zh: 我每周都尽量做规律的锻炼。

examples.sentence: We take breaks at regular intervals during work.
examples.translation_zh: 我们在工作期间定期休息。

examples.sentence: The website provides regular updates on local events.
examples.translation_zh: 这个网站定期更新当地活动的信息。

responsible.def_en: Having the duty to take care of something or someone.

examples.sentence: Workers are responsible for maintaining a safe environment.
examples.translation_zh: 工人负责保持安全的环境。

examples.sentence: Companies should be socially responsible to their communities.
examples.translation_zh: 公司应该对社区承担社会责任。

examples.sentence: He acts like a responsible adult in difficult situations.
examples.translation_zh: 他在困难情况下表现得像一个负责任的成年人。

soft.def_en: Not hard or firm; easily shaped or bent.

examples.sentence: Many people like to drink soft drinks during summer.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人喜欢在夏天喝软饮料。

examples.sentence: She prefers to listen to soft music when studying.
examples.translation_zh: 她喜欢在学习时听柔和的音乐。

examples.sentence: The soft light made the room feel very cozy.
examples.translation_zh: 柔和的光线让房间感觉非常舒适。

baseball.def_en: A game played with a bat and ball between two teams.

examples.sentence: Children love to play baseball in the park.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们喜欢在公园里打棒球。

examples.sentence: Last weekend, we watched a baseball game at the stadium.
examples.translation_zh: 上个周末，我们在体育场观看了一场棒球比赛。

examples.sentence: The local baseball team won the championship this year.
examples.translation_zh: 当地的棒球队今年赢得了冠军。

ignore.def_en: To pay no attention to something or someone.

examples.sentence: Many people ignore the warnings about the dangers of smoking.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人忽视关于吸烟危险的警告。

examples.sentence: Employees sometimes ignore the rules when they feel stressed.
examples.translation_zh: 员工在感到压力时有时会忽视规则。

examples.sentence: Some news articles ignore the facts to fit their narrative.
examples.translation_zh: 一些新闻文章忽视事实以符合他们的叙述。

belief.def_en: A trust or confidence in something or someone.

examples.sentence: Many people have a strong belief in their culture.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人对自己的文化有强烈的信念。

examples.sentence: Teachers often hold a belief in their students' potential.
examples.translation_zh: 教师通常对学生的潜力抱有信念。

examples.sentence: Experts express a belief that climate change is urgent.
examples.translation_zh: 专家表达了气候变化迫在眉睫的信念。

murder.def_en: The unlawful killing of another person.

examples.sentence: Police launched a murder investigation after the body was found.
examples.translation_zh: 警方在发现尸体后展开了谋杀调查。

examples.sentence: The lawyer prepared for the murder trial in court next week.
examples.translation_zh: 律师为下周的谋杀审判做准备。

examples.sentence: Many murder cases are solved through forensic evidence.
examples.translation_zh: 许多谋杀案件通过法医证据被解决。

review.def_en: To look at or examine something again.

examples.sentence: Managers give performance reviews to help employees improve.
examples.translation_zh: 经理给员工进行绩效复习，以帮助其提升。

examples.sentence: A literature review is important for any research project.
examples.translation_zh: 文献复习对任何研究项目都是重要的。

examples.sentence: The journal published a review article on recent findings.
examples.translation_zh: 该期刊发表了一篇关于近期发现的复习文章。

religion.def_en: A system of beliefs or practices regarding the sacred.
