examples.sentence: Faculty members play a crucial role in student development.
examples.translation_zh: 教职员工在学生发展中起着关键作用。

examples.sentence: The faculty of science offers various courses in biology and chemistry.
examples.translation_zh: 理学院提供多种生物和化学课程。

examples.sentence: Our organization provides faculty training to enhance teaching skills.
examples.translation_zh: 我们机构提供教职员工培训以提升教学技能。

waste.def_en: Refuse or unused material; to use resources carelessly.

examples.sentence: Many people try to reduce food waste at home.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人尝试在家减少食物浪费。

examples.sentence: It is easy to waste time on distractions like social media.
examples.translation_zh: 在社交媒体等干扰上浪费时间很容易。

examples.sentence: Companies should minimize their waste resources to stay efficient.
examples.translation_zh: 公司应该尽量减少资源浪费，以保持高效。

mass.def_en: A large amount or collection of something.

examples.sentence: Factories use mass production to create goods efficiently.
examples.translation_zh: 工厂使用大规模生产来高效地制造商品。

examples.sentence: Mass media plays a crucial role in shaping public opinion.
examples.translation_zh: 大众媒体在塑造公众舆论中起着关键作用。

examples.sentence: Scientists warn of potential mass extinction events in the future.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家警告未来可能发生大规模灭绝事件。

definitely.def_en: In a certain and clear manner, without doubt.

examples.sentence: The findings from the research are definitely true and reliable.
examples.translation_zh: 研究结果肯定是正确和可靠的。

examples.sentence: We are definitely going to the party this weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 我们这个周末肯定会去参加聚会。

examples.sentence: I definitely agree with your proposal for the project.
examples.translation_zh: 我肯定赞同你对这个项目的提议。

experiment.def_en: A test to discover something or demonstrate a principle.

examples.sentence: Researchers conducted a scientific experiment to validate their hypothesis.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员进行了科学实验以验证他们的假设。

examples.sentence: I decided to experiment with new methods to improve productivity.
examples.translation_zh: 我决定尝试新方法以提高生产力。

examples.sentence: Many organizations protest against the use of animals for experiment.
examples.translation_zh: 许多组织抗议使用动物进行实验。

liberal.def_en: Willing to respect or accept behavior or opinions different from one's own.

examples.sentence: Many universities promote a liberal education that encourages critical thinking.
examples.translation_zh: 许多大学提倡促进自由教育，鼓励批判性思维。

examples.sentence: The government has implemented new liberal policies to support minority groups.
examples.translation_zh: 政府已实施新的开明政策，以支持少数群体。

examples.sentence: Students can choose to major in liberal arts or sciences at this college.
examples.translation_zh: 学生可以选择在这所大学主修人文学科或科学。

bomb.def_en: An explosive weapon designed to cause destruction.

examples.sentence: Authorities discovered a car bomb near the city center yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 当局昨天在市中心附近发现了一枚汽车炸弹。

examples.sentence: A bomb threat was reported at the local school this morning.
examples.translation_zh: 今天早上，当地学校报告了一起炸弹威胁。

examples.sentence: The team conducted a bombing raid during the military exercise.
examples.translation_zh: 团队在军事演习期间进行了轰炸袭击。

enormous.def_en: Very large in size, quantity, or extent.

examples.sentence: Many companies need enormous amounts of data to operate effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司需要巨大的数据量才能有效运作。

examples.sentence: The pandemic had an enormous impact on global economies and daily lives.
examples.translation_zh: 疫情对全球经济和日常生活产生了巨大的影响。

examples.sentence: Students often face enormous challenges when adapting to new learning environments.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在适应新的学习环境时常常面临巨大的挑战。

examples.sentence: Her comment was merely a suggestion for improvement.
examples.translation_zh: 她的评论仅仅是一个改进建议。

examples.sentence: It is merely a matter of time before the results are announced.
examples.translation_zh: 结果公布仅仅是时间问题。

examples.sentence: This piece is merely for decoration and not functional.
examples.translation_zh: 这个作品仅仅是用来装饰，没其他功能。

tone.def_en: A quality or character of sound, especially in speech.

examples.sentence: She spoke to him in a soft tone of voice.
examples.translation_zh: 她用轻柔的语调对他说话。

examples.sentence: We need to tone down our presentation for the audience.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要为观众调整一下我们的演示。

examples.sentence: The tone of a text can greatly affect its interpretation.
examples.translation_zh: 文本的语气会大大影响其解读。

engineer.def_en: A person who designs, builds, or maintains engines or machines.

examples.sentence: Many companies hire software engineers to develop applications.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司雇用软件工程师来开发应用程序。

examples.sentence: A civil engineer plans and oversees construction projects effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 土木工程师有效地规划和监督建设项目。

examples.sentence: They engineer solutions to improve urban transportation systems.
examples.translation_zh: 他们设计方案以改善城市交通系统。

decline.def_en: A decrease in quality or quantity; to refuse.

examples.sentence: His health has seen a noticeable decline in recent months.
examples.translation_zh: 他的健康在最近几个月明显下降。

examples.sentence: She decided to decline the invitation to the party.
examples.translation_zh: 她决定拒绝参加派对的邀请。

examples.sentence: The team experienced a decline in performance this quarter.
examples.translation_zh: 该团队在本季度的表现有所下降。

massive.def_en: Very large in size, quantity, or extent.

examples.sentence: The new policy had a massive impact on the economy.
examples.translation_zh: 这项新政策对经济产生了巨大的影响。

examples.sentence: There was a massive increase in pollution levels last year.
examples.translation_zh: 去年，污染水平出现了巨大的增长。

examples.sentence: Scientists discovered a massive structure beneath the Earth's surface.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家在地球表面下发现了一个巨大的结构。

wheel.def_en: A circular object that rotates on an axle.

examples.sentence: They always turn the wheels when riding their bicycles.
examples.translation_zh: 他们骑自行车时总是转动轮子。

examples.sentence: Every car should have a spare wheel for emergencies.
examples.translation_zh: 每辆车都应该有一个备用轮子以应对紧急情况。

examples.sentence: The wheel of fortune spins to reveal different prizes.
examples.translation_zh: 幸运之轮旋转着揭示不同的奖品。

invest.def_en: To put money into something for profit or material result.

examples.sentence: Many countries invest in education to improve their future workforce.
examples.translation_zh: 许多国家投资于教育，以改善未来的劳动力。

examples.sentence: Companies often invest heavily in research to innovate new products.
examples.translation_zh: 公司通常在研究上进行了大量投资，以创新新产品。

examples.sentence: Individuals should invest wisely to secure their financial future.
examples.translation_zh: 个人应明智地投资，以保障自己的财务未来。

towards.def_en: In the direction of something or someone.

examples.sentence: Our team is working hard towards a solution to this problem.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的团队在努力朝着这个问题的解决方案前进。

examples.sentence: Many people are optimistic towards the future of technology.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人对科技的未来持乐观态度。

examples.sentence: She decided to move towards a healthier lifestyle this year.
examples.translation_zh: 她决定今年朝着更健康的生活方式迈进。

cable.def_en: A thick wire or group of wires that transmit electricity.

examples.sentence: An electrician installed a new power cable in the building.
examples.translation_zh: 一名电工在建筑物内安装了一根新的电缆。

examples.sentence: The cable network reported breaking news throughout the day.
examples.translation_zh: 该电缆网络全天播报突发新闻。

examples.sentence: Researchers are developing faster fiber optic cables for communication.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员正在开发更快速的光纤电缆用于通讯。

expose.def_en: Make something visible or known that was hidden.

examples.sentence: Friends can sometimes expose your secrets without realizing it.
examples.translation_zh: 朋友有时会在不经意间揭露你的秘密。

examples.sentence: The journalist worked hard to expose the fraud in the system.
examples.translation_zh: 这位记者努力揭露系统中的欺诈行为。

examples.sentence: Overexposure to the sun can expose you to serious health risks.
examples.translation_zh: 过度暴露在阳光下可能使你面临严重的健康风险。

rural.def_en: Relating to the countryside or areas outside cities.

examples.sentence: Many people prefer to live in rural areas for peace.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人更喜欢住在乡村地区以获得宁静。

examples.sentence: Rural communities often have strong cultural traditions and ties.
examples.translation_zh: 乡村社区通常有着强大的文化传统和联系。

examples.sentence: The government announced new plans for rural development next year.
examples.translation_zh: 政府宣布明年将推出新的乡村发展计划。

cream.def_en: A thick, smooth liquid made from milk.

examples.sentence: She topped her dessert with whipped cream for extra sweetness.
examples.translation_zh: 她在甜点上加了奶油以增加甜味。

examples.sentence: The recipe calls for cream cheese to make the filling rich.
examples.translation_zh: 这个食谱需要奶油奶酪，以使馅料浓郁。

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy sour cream on their baked potatoes.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人喜欢在烤土豆上加酸奶油。

solid.def_en: Having a firm or stable shape, not liquid or gaseous.

examples.sentence: Researchers presented solid evidence to support their claims.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员提供了有力的证据来支持他们的论点。

examples.sentence: A solid foundation is crucial for building a successful business.
examples.translation_zh: 坚实的基础对于建立一个成功的企业至关重要。

examples.sentence: The city is struggling to manage its solid waste effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 该城市正在努力有效管理其固体废物。

narrow.def_en: Having a small width; limited in extent or scope.

examples.sentence: Traffic moves slowly on the narrow road through the village.
examples.translation_zh: 村里的狭窄道路上，交通缓慢行驶。

examples.sentence: Researchers often have a narrow focus in their studies.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员在研究中通常有狭窄的关注点。

examples.sentence: The election was decided by a narrow margin of votes.
examples.translation_zh: 选举以微弱的投票差距决定。

legislation.def_en: A law or set of laws made by a government.

examples.sentence: New legislation aims to protect the environment more effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 新立法旨在更有效地保护环境。

examples.sentence: The team is reviewing proposed legislation for potential impacts on business.
examples.translation_zh: 团队正在审查拟议中的立法对商业的潜在影响。

examples.sentence: Federal legislation often sets the framework for state laws and policies.
examples.translation_zh: 联邦立法通常为州法律和政策设定框架。

celebrate.def_en: To mark a special occasion with enjoyable activities.

examples.sentence: Friends and family celebrate her birthday every year.
examples.translation_zh: 朋友和家人每年庆祝她的生日。

examples.sentence: Students celebrate their achievements at the graduation ceremony.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在毕业典礼上庆祝他们的成就。

examples.sentence: Many people celebrate the festival with traditional food and music.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人用传统美食和音乐庆祝这个节日。

succeed.def_en: To accomplish a goal or achieve a desired result.

examples.sentence: Many employees succeed in achieving their targets every year.
examples.translation_zh: 许多员工每年都能成功实现他们的目标。

examples.sentence: Students often succeed at learning new languages with practice.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们通过练习通常能成功学习新语言。

examples.sentence: The team managed to succeed against all odds in the championship.
examples.translation_zh: 该队在锦标赛中克服重重困难成功获胜。

unfortunately.def_en: Sadly or regrettably, indicating an unfortunate situation or fact.

examples.sentence: Unfortunately, I missed the meeting due to a scheduling conflict.
examples.translation_zh: 不幸的是，我因日程冲突错过了会议。

examples.sentence: The experiment failed; unfortunately, the results were disappointing.
examples.translation_zh: 实验失败了，不幸的是，结果让人失望。

examples.collocation: unfortunately, there is little time left
examples.sentence: There is little time left; unfortunately, I cannot finish my work now.
examples.translation_zh: 时间不多了，不幸的是，我现在无法完成我的工作。

achievement.def_en: A thing done successfully, typically by effort or skill.

examples.sentence: Students celebrate their academic achievements during the graduation ceremony.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在毕业典礼上庆祝他们的学术成就。

examples.sentence: His significant achievements in the project were recognized by the company.
examples.translation_zh: 他在这个项目中的重大成就得到了公司的认可。

examples.sentence: Completing the marathon was her greatest personal achievement.
examples.translation_zh: 完成马拉松是她最大的个人成就。

useful.def_en: Providing help or serving a practical purpose.

examples.sentence: Teachers often provide useful information to help students learn.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们经常提供有用的信息来帮助学生学习。

examples.sentence: I found several useful tips for cooking on the internet.
examples.translation_zh: 我在网上找到了一些有用的烹饪小技巧。

examples.sentence: Engineers use many useful tools to design new products.
examples.translation_zh: 工程师使用许多有用的工具来设计新产品。

accuse.def_en: To say someone did something wrong or illegal.

examples.sentence: Police accuse the suspect of theft during the investigation.
examples.translation_zh: 警方控告嫌疑人盗窃，正在调查中。

examples.sentence: She accused him of lying about his whereabouts last night.
examples.translation_zh: 她控告他隐瞒昨晚的行踪。

examples.sentence: They unfairly accused her of failing to meet the deadline.
examples.translation_zh: 他们不公正地指控她未能按时完成任务。

taste.def_en: A sensation of flavor perceived in the mouth.

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy a taste test at food festivals each year.
examples.translation_zh: 每年，许多人都喜欢在美食节上进行味道测试。

examples.sentence: Our taste buds can detect five basic flavors in food.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的味蕾能检测食物中的五种基本味道。

examples.sentence: She has a taste for adventure and loves exploring new places.
examples.translation_zh: 她对冒险情有独钟，喜欢探索新地方。

talent.def_en: Natural ability or skill in a particular area.

examples.sentence: She has shown great musical talents since childhood.
examples.translation_zh: 她从小就展现出很大的音乐天赋。

examples.sentence: Finding management talents is crucial for company success.
examples.translation_zh: 寻找管理人才对公司的成功至关重要。

examples.sentence: Many students discover their artistic talents in school.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生在学校发现自己的艺术天赋。

characteristic.def_en: A distinguishing quality or feature of someone or something.

examples.sentence: Chinese calligraphy has a characteristic feature of fluid brush strokes.
examples.translation_zh: 中国书法有着流畅笔画的独特特点。

examples.sentence: Children often display characteristic behavior when they are tired.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们在疲惫时常常表现出特征性的行为。

examples.sentence: Teachers help students identify their characteristic traits and strengths.
examples.translation_zh: 教师帮助学生识别他们的特征和优点。

cast.def_en: To throw something with force or to shape material.

examples.sentence: Employees can cast a vote in the company election.
examples.translation_zh: 员工可以在公司选举中投票。

examples.sentence: Tall buildings can cast a shadow over the park.
examples.translation_zh: 高楼可以在公园里投下阴影。

examples.sentence: The magician can cast a spell during his performance.
examples.translation_zh: 魔术师在表演时可以施展魔法。

escape.def_en: To break free from confinement or control.

examples.sentence: Many companies develop an escape plan for emergencies.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司为紧急情况制定逃生计划。

examples.sentence: Finding an escape route can be crucial during natural disasters.
examples.translation_zh: 在自然灾害中，寻找逃生路线可能至关重要。

examples.sentence: The escape artist amazed everyone with his daring tricks.
examples.translation_zh: 这位逃脱艺术家的惊险把戏让每个人都惊叹。

reject.def_en: to refuse to accept, consider, or submit to something.

examples.sentence: Employers often reject applications that do not meet requirements.
examples.translation_zh: 雇主通常会拒绝不符合要求的申请。

examples.sentence: Scientists may reject a theory if it lacks strong evidence.
examples.translation_zh: 如果缺乏有力证据，科学家们可能会拒绝这一理论。

examples.sentence: Many people reject the idea of traditional gender roles today.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人今天拒绝传统性别角色的观念。

closely.def_en: In a careful or attentive manner.

examples.sentence: These two species are closely related and share many characteristics.
examples.translation_zh: 这两种物种密切相关，具有许多相似特征。

examples.sentence: Researchers closely examine the effects of climate change on wildlife.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员密切观察气候变化对野生动物的影响。

examples.sentence: The project is closely monitored to ensure it stays on schedule.
examples.translation_zh: 该项目被密切监控，以确保按计划进行。

unusual.def_en: Different from what is usual or expected.

examples.sentence: His unusual behavior made everyone feel uncomfortable at the party.
examples.translation_zh: 他的不寻常行为让聚会上的每个人都感到不安。

examples.sentence: Researchers reported unusual findings during the study on climate change.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员在气候变化研究中报告了不寻常的发现。

examples.sentence: The unusual circumstances surrounding her disappearance raised many questions.
examples.translation_zh: 她失踪的异常情况引发了许多问题。

convince.def_en: To persuade someone to do or believe something.

examples.sentence: I often try to convince my friends to try new foods.
examples.translation_zh: 我常常试图说服我的朋友尝试新食物。

examples.sentence: The manager needs to convince the committee of his proposal's benefits.
examples.translation_zh: 经理需要说服委员会接受他提案的好处。

examples.sentence: Researchers aim to convince the audience of their findings' significance.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员旨在说服观众他们发现的重要性。

sentence.def_en: A group of words expressing a complete thought.

examples.sentence: Students often write complex sentences in their essays.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们常常在作文中写复杂句子。

examples.sentence: Understanding sentence structure is important for effective writing.
examples.translation_zh: 理解句子结构对有效写作很重要。

examples.sentence: The sentence length of his messages is usually quite short.
examples.translation_zh: 他信息的句子长度通常相当短。

physician.def_en: A qualified medical practitioner or doctor.

examples.sentence: He consulted a medical physician for his persistent headaches.
examples.translation_zh: 他因持续头痛咨询了一位内科医生。

examples.sentence: Many physicians work closely with physician assistants in hospitals.
examples.translation_zh: 许多医生与医院里的医师助理密切合作。

examples.sentence: She received a physician referral for her new specialist appointment.
examples.translation_zh: 她获得了新专科医生的转诊。

height.def_en: The measurement of something from base to top.

examples.sentence: Students in this class vary in average height and abilities.
examples.translation_zh: 这个班级的学生在平均高度和能力上各不相同。

examples.sentence: New laws set a height limit for buildings in the area.
examples.translation_zh: 新法律规定该地区建筑的高度限制。

examples.sentence: Regular exercise can lead to a height increase in children.
examples.translation_zh: 规律的锻炼可以促进儿童的身高增长。

plenty.def_en: A large quantity or number of something.

examples.sentence: You have plenty of time to complete the project.
examples.translation_zh: 你有很多时间来完成这个项目。

examples.sentence: Students have plenty of options to choose from for their courses.
examples.translation_zh: 学生有很多课程可以选择。

examples.sentence: There are plenty of opportunities for growth in this company.
examples.translation_zh: 在这家公司有很多成长的机会。

assess.def_en: To evaluate or estimate the nature, ability, or value.

examples.sentence: Experts will assess the impact of the new regulations on local businesses.
examples.translation_zh: 专家将评估新规对当地企业的影响。

examples.sentence: Teachers regularly assess student performance to adjust their teaching methods.
examples.translation_zh: 教师定期评估学生表现，以调整他们的教学方法。

examples.sentence: Managers must assess risks before launching any new project.
examples.translation_zh: 管理者在启动任何新项目之前必须评估风险。

virtually.def_en: Nearly; for all practical purposes, close to a certain extent.

examples.sentence: Virtually all of the country's citizens support the new law.
examples.translation_zh: 几乎所有国民都支持这项新法律。

examples.sentence: It is virtually impossible to predict the weather accurately.
examples.translation_zh: 准确预测天气几乎是不可能的。

examples.sentence: These two products are virtually indistinguishable from each other.
examples.translation_zh: 这两种产品几乎无法区分。

addition.def_en: The process of adding something to increase its total.

examples.sentence: Students often struggle in addition to balancing their studies.
examples.translation_zh: 学生在平衡学习的同时常常感到吃力。

examples.sentence: The manager approved the addition of new staff to the project.
examples.translation_zh: 经理批准了向项目添加新员工。

examples.sentence: You should make an addition to your shopping list soon.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该尽快在购物清单上添加物品。

sharp.def_en: Having a thin edge or point; acute or keen in perception.

examples.sentence: The country experienced a sharp increase in inflation last year.
examples.translation_zh: 去年，该国的通货膨胀急剧上升。

examples.sentence: Students must keep a sharp focus during the lecture to understand effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 学生在讲座中必须保持清晰的注意力，以便有效理解。

examples.sentence: There is a sharp contrast between urban and rural lifestyles in many regions.
examples.translation_zh: 许多地区的城市与乡村生活方式之间有明显的对比。

creative.def_en: Having the ability to produce original ideas or things.

examples.sentence: Many companies encourage employees to share their creative ideas.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司鼓励员工分享他们的创造性想法。

examples.sentence: Scientists are finding creative solutions to environmental problems.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家正在寻找创造性的解决方案来应对环境问题。

examples.sentence: Students often work on creative projects during art class.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在美术课上经常进行创造性的项目。

lower.def_en: To make something less in amount or degree.

examples.sentence: Many stores offer discounts to lower prices for customers.
examples.translation_zh: 许多商店提供折扣以降低顾客的价格。

examples.sentence: It is important to lower the temperature during this chemical reaction.
examples.translation_zh: 在这个化学反应过程中，降低温度是很重要的。

examples.sentence: Schools should avoid policies that lower academic standards or expectations.
examples.translation_zh: 学校应该避免降低学术标准或期望的政策。

explanation.def_en: A statement clarifying something; the act of making something clear.

examples.sentence: Teachers often provide a clear explanation of the topic.
examples.translation_zh: 教师们经常对该主题提供清晰的解释。

examples.sentence: She gave a detailed explanation of the project requirements.
examples.translation_zh: 她对项目要求进行了详细的解释。

examples.sentence: He offered a brief explanation for his late arrival.
examples.translation_zh: 他对自己迟到提供了简要的解释。

gay.def_en: Relating to sexual orientation towards the same sex; happy.

examples.sentence: Many people celebrate gay pride in the summer months.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在夏季庆祝同性恋自豪节。

examples.sentence: Activists are fighting for gay rights around the world.
examples.translation_zh: 活动家们在全球为同性恋权利而斗争。

examples.sentence: The gay community often organizes events to promote inclusion.
examples.translation_zh: 同性恋社区经常组织活动以促进包容。

approve.def_en: To agree to or accept something formally.

examples.sentence: Managers usually approve a proposal after reviewing it carefully.
examples.translation_zh: 经理们通常在仔细审查后批准提案。

examples.sentence: The committee will approve funding for the new research project soon.
examples.translation_zh: 委员会将很快批准新研究项目的资金。

examples.sentence: She hopes her parents will approve the plan for her trip.
examples.translation_zh: 她希望父母能批准她的旅行计划。

campus.def_en: The grounds and buildings of a university or college.

examples.sentence: Many students live in dorms on the college campus.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生住在大学校园内的宿舍里。

examples.sentence: You can find various cafes on campus for lunch.
examples.translation_zh: 校园内有许多咖啡馆可以吃午餐。

examples.sentence: The university organizes several campus activities each semester.
examples.translation_zh: 大学每学期组织多项校园活动。

acquire.def_en: To gain possession of something through effort or experience.

examples.sentence: Students need to acquire knowledge for their future careers.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们需要获取知识，为他们的未来职业做准备。

examples.sentence: Professionals should acquire skills to advance in their jobs.
examples.translation_zh: 专业人士应该获取技能，以便在工作中晋升。

examples.sentence: Individuals often acquire assets to secure their financial future.
examples.translation_zh: 个人通常获取资产，以确保他们的财务未来。

proper.def_en: Correct or appropriate in the circumstances.

examples.sentence: Students need a proper education to succeed in life.
examples.translation_zh: 学生需要适当的教育才能在生活中取得成功。

examples.sentence: Everyone should demonstrate proper behavior in public places.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人在公共场所都应该表现出适当的行为。

examples.sentence: Following the proper procedure is essential for safety.
examples.translation_zh: 遵循适当的程序对安全至关重要。

guilty.def_en: Having committed a crime or offense; feeling remorse.

examples.sentence: The jury reached a guilty verdict after the trial concluded.
examples.translation_zh: 陪审团在审判结束后做出了有罪的裁决。

examples.sentence: She couldn't hide her guilty conscience after lying to her friend.
examples.translation_zh: 在对朋友撒谎后，她无法掩饰自己的内疚。

examples.sentence: Watching reality TV is her guilty pleasure on weekends.
examples.translation_zh: 看真人秀是她周末的内疚乐趣。

plus.def_en: Used to indicate addition or a positive quality.

examples.sentence: Teachers often give plus points for excellent homework submissions.
examples.translation_zh: 老师通常会给优秀的作业增加加分。

examples.sentence: Many stores now offer plus size clothing for all body types.
examples.translation_zh: 许多商店现在提供适合各种体型的加大号服装。

examples.sentence: Employees receive plus benefits along with their salaries and bonuses.
examples.translation_zh: 员工的工资和奖金外，还有额外的福利。

immigrant.def_en: A person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.

examples.sentence: Many illegal immigrants face dangerous conditions while traveling.
examples.translation_zh: 许多非法移民在旅行时面临危险的环境。

examples.sentence: The immigrant community contributes significantly to local culture and economy.
examples.translation_zh: 移民社区对当地文化和经济贡献重大。

examples.sentence: Activists are fighting for the rights of immigrant families.
examples.translation_zh: 活动人士正在为移民家庭的权利而斗争。

technical.def_en: Relating to a specific subject, art, or craft.

examples.sentence: Employers often look for candidates with strong technical skills.
examples.translation_zh: 雇主通常寻找具有扎实技术技能的候选人。

examples.sentence: Customers can contact technical support for help with their devices.
examples.translation_zh: 客户可以联系技术支持来获得设备帮助。

examples.sentence: Researchers published technical details of the experiment in the journal.
examples.translation_zh: 研究者在期刊上发表了实验的技术细节。

examples.sentence: Identifying weak points is crucial for team improvement.
examples.translation_zh: 识别虚弱环节对团队改进至关重要。

examples.sentence: The researchers presented weak evidence to support their claims.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员提供的证据不足以支持他们的主张。

examples.sentence: A weak signal can cause communication disruptions in devices.
examples.translation_zh: 微弱信号可能导致设备通信中断。

illegal.def_en: Not allowed by law or rules.

examples.sentence: Authorities are cracking down on illegal activities in the city.
examples.translation_zh: 当局正在打击该市的非法活动。

examples.sentence: Many illegal immigrants seek better job opportunities abroad.
examples.translation_zh: 许多非法移民寻求更好的海外就业机会。

examples.sentence: Using illegal drugs can seriously harm your health and well-being.
examples.translation_zh: 使用非法毒品会严重危害你的健康和福祉。

compete.def_en: To strive against others to gain something or win.

examples.sentence: Companies often compete with each other for market share.
examples.translation_zh: 公司们经常为市场份额而竞争。

examples.sentence: Animals must compete for resources in their habitat to survive.
examples.translation_zh: 动物们必须在栖息地中竞争资源以求生存。

examples.sentence: Athletes will compete in a tournament next weekend to showcase their skills.
examples.translation_zh: 运动员们将在下周末的比赛中展示他们的技能。

alternative.def_en: One of two or more available possibilities.

examples.sentence: Employers often provide alternative options for health insurance.
examples.translation_zh: 雇主通常提供健康保险的替代选项。

examples.sentence: Researchers are seeking alternative solutions to reduce pollution.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员正在寻找减少污染的替代方案。

examples.sentence: Students can choose alternative methods for completing assignments.
examples.translation_zh: 学生可以选择替代方法来完成作业。

interaction.def_en: The act of communicating or engaging with others.

examples.sentence: People often enjoy social interactions at local cafes and restaurants.
examples.translation_zh: 人们通常喜欢在当地的咖啡馆和餐厅进行社交互动。

examples.sentence: Researchers study human-animal interaction to understand behavior patterns.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员研究人类与动物的互动，以了解行为模式。

examples.sentence: Teachers encourage classroom interactions to promote student engagement and learning.
examples.translation_zh: 教师鼓励课堂互动，以促进学生的参与和学习。

column.def_en: A vertical division of a page or text.

examples.sentence: Companies often analyze a column of data to make decisions.
examples.translation_zh: 公司通常分析一列数据以作出决策。

examples.sentence: He writes a weekly column in a popular newspaper.
examples.translation_zh: 他在一家受欢迎的报纸上写每周专栏。

examples.sentence: The building has several supporting columns to ensure stability.
examples.translation_zh: 这栋建筑有几根支撑柱以确保稳定性。

personality.def_en: The characteristic patterns of thoughts, feelings, and behaviors.

examples.sentence: Strong personalities often lead teams effectively and decisively.
examples.translation_zh: 强势的个性通常能有效果断地领导团队。

examples.sentence: Having a unique personality makes someone stand out in a crowd.
examples.translation_zh: 拥有独特的个性让某人在众人中脱颖而出。

examples.sentence: People with friendly personalities are usually well-liked by others.
examples.translation_zh: 性格友好的人通常受到他人的喜爱。

signal.def_en: A sound, gesture, or sign to convey information or instructions.

examples.sentence: Environmental scientists signal a change in climate patterns.
examples.translation_zh: 环境科学家发出了气候模式变化的信号。

examples.sentence: When in trouble, people usually signal for help loudly.
examples.translation_zh: 遇到困难时，人们通常大声发出求助信号。

examples.sentence: Engineers monitor the signal strength to ensure connectivity.
examples.translation_zh: 工程师监测信号强度以确保连接性。

king.def_en: A male ruler of a country or territory.

examples.sentence: Many believe the king of England should be more involved.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人认为国王应该更积极参与政治。

examples.sentence: They bought a king size bed for their new apartment.
examples.translation_zh: 他们为新公寓买了一张特大床。

examples.sentence: The king's crown was made of precious jewels and metals.
examples.translation_zh: 国王的皇冠是用珍贵的宝石和金属制作的。

passenger.def_en: A person who travels in a vehicle but is not the driver.

examples.sentence: Many passengers prefer taking a train for long journeys.
examples.translation_zh: 许多乘客更喜欢坐火车进行长途旅行。

examples.sentence: The airline updates the passenger list before each flight.
examples.translation_zh: 航空公司在每次航班前更新乘客名单。

examples.sentence: Improving passenger experience is essential for bus companies.
examples.translation_zh: 改善乘客体验对公交公司至关重要。

forever.def_en: For a very long time, without end or change.

examples.sentence: This event has forever changed how we view climate change.
examples.translation_zh: 这一事件永远改变了我们对气候变化的看法。

examples.sentence: I promise to love you forever, no matter what happens.
examples.translation_zh: 我保证永远爱你，无论发生什么。

examples.sentence: We are forever grateful for your support and dedication to our team.
examples.translation_zh: 我们对您对我们团队的支持和奉献永远感激不已。

lab.def_en: A place for scientific experiments and research.

examples.sentence: Many universities have research labs for advanced studies.
examples.translation_zh: 许多大学都有用于高级研究的实验室。

examples.sentence: Students learn about cells in the biology lab this week.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们本周在生物实验室学习细胞。

examples.sentence: I often use the computer lab to complete my assignments.
examples.translation_zh: 我经常使用计算机实验室来完成作业。

regard.def_en: To have a particular opinion or feeling about something.

examples.sentence: In this regard, the team has made significant progress this month.
examples.translation_zh: 在这方面，团队这个月取得了显著的进展。

examples.sentence: Many educators regard creativity as an essential skill for students.
examples.translation_zh: 许多教育工作者认为创造力是学生的一项重要技能。

examples.sentence: The report discusses several issues with regard to climate change.
examples.translation_zh: 这份报告讨论了与气候变化有关的几个问题。

display.def_en: To show or make visible to others.

examples.sentence: Researchers often display results in their final reports.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员通常在最终报告中展示结果。

examples.sentence: We need to display information clearly on the website.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要在网站上清晰地展示信息。

examples.sentence: The gallery will display art from local artists this weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 画廊本周末将展示当地艺术家的艺术作品。

criticism.def_en: The expression of disapproval or dissatisfaction.

examples.sentence: She appreciates constructive criticism to improve her performance.
examples.translation_zh: 她欣赏建设性的批评，以提升自己的表现。

examples.sentence: The article faced harsh criticism for its controversial viewpoints.
examples.translation_zh: 这篇文章因其争议性的观点而遭到严厉的批评。

examples.sentence: Peer criticism can help students learn and grow together.
examples.translation_zh: 同伴间的批评可以帮助学生共同学习和成长。

depression.def_en: A state of low mood and aversion to activity.

examples.sentence: Many studies report increasing depression rates among teenagers.
examples.translation_zh: 许多研究报告青少年抑郁率上升。

examples.sentence: She was diagnosed with clinical depression after several months of symptoms.
examples.translation_zh: 她在出现症状几个月后被诊断为临床抑郁。

examples.sentence: Major depression affects millions of people globally each year.
examples.translation_zh: 重度抑郁每年影响数百万人。

wrap.def_en: To cover or enclose something in paper or material.

examples.sentence: You should wrap up the gifts before the party starts.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该在聚会开始前把礼物包起来。

examples.sentence: We need to wrap the project with a comprehensive report.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要用一份全面的报告来总结这个项目。

examples.sentence: He likes to wrap a scarf around his neck during winter.
examples.translation_zh: 冬天时，他喜欢在脖子上围一条围巾。

prayer.def_en: A solemn request for help or expression of thanks to a deity.

examples.sentence: Many people offer a prayer before their meals.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在吃饭前祷告。

examples.sentence: He took a moment for silent prayer at the memorial.
examples.translation_zh: 他在纪念碑前静默祷告了一会儿。

examples.sentence: Students organized a prayer meeting to discuss their concerns.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们组织了一次祷告会，以讨论他们的担忧。

spiritual.def_en: Relating to the soul or spirit; not physical.

examples.sentence: Many people hold strong spiritual beliefs throughout their lives.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在一生中持有强烈的精神信仰。

examples.sentence: Finding peace can be a long spiritual journey for many individuals.
examples.translation_zh: 对许多人来说，寻找内心的平静可能是一段漫长的精神旅程。

examples.sentence: Students often discuss their spiritual growth in philosophy classes.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们在哲学课上常常讨论他们的精神成长。

journalist.def_en: A person who reports news for media outlets.

examples.sentence: Investigative journalists often uncover hidden truths in society.
examples.translation_zh: 调查记者经常揭露社会中的隐秘真相。

examples.sentence: Many sports journalists cover live events and report on competitions.
examples.translation_zh: 许多体育记者报道现场赛事和比赛情况。

examples.sentence: Freelance journalists write articles for various publications and websites.
examples.translation_zh: 自由记者为不同的出版物和网站撰写文章。

musical.def_en: Relating to or resembling music; pleasing to the ear.

examples.sentence: The cast delivered a stunning musical performance last night.
examples.translation_zh: 主演们昨晚呈现了精彩的音乐表演。

examples.sentence: Students benefit greatly from a well-rounded musical education.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们从全面的音乐教育中受益良多。

examples.sentence: Many children enjoy playing various musical instruments at school.
examples.translation_zh: 许多孩子在学校喜欢玩各种乐器。

suspect.def_en: A person believed to be involved in a crime.

examples.sentence: Police arrested the main suspect in the robbery case.
examples.translation_zh: 警方逮捕了这起抢劫案的主要嫌疑犯。

examples.sentence: Teachers often notice suspect behavior among students in class.
examples.translation_zh: 老师们经常注意到课堂上学生的可疑行为。

examples.sentence: We should examine the suspect motives behind their decision.
examples.translation_zh: 我们应该审视他们决定背后的可疑动机。

scholar.def_en: A person who studies or has expertise in a particular subject.

examples.sentence: Many universities have a scholar in residence each semester.
examples.translation_zh: 许多大学每学期都有一位驻校学者。

examples.sentence: The conference featured a distinguished scholar from another country.
examples.translation_zh: 会议上有一位来自其他国家的杰出学者。

examples.sentence: Students can apply for various scholar awards each year.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们每年可以申请各种学者奖项。

metre.def_en: A unit of length equal to 100 centimeters.

examples.sentence: Mount Everest is over eight thousand metres above sea level.
examples.translation_zh: 珠穆朗玛峰的海拔超过八千米。

examples.sentence: The room measures twenty square metres in total area.
examples.translation_zh: 这个房间的总面积为二十平方米。

examples.sentence: Students used a metre stick to measure the table's length.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们用米尺测量桌子的长度。

climate.def_en: The long-term pattern of temperature and weather conditions.

examples.sentence: Scientists are studying climate change to understand its impacts.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家正在研究气候变化，以了解其影响。

examples.sentence: The current business climate encourages innovation and investment.
examples.translation_zh: 当前的商业气候鼓励创新和投资。

examples.sentence: Researchers monitor climate conditions to predict future patterns.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员监测气候条件，以预测未来模式。

cheese.def_en: A dairy product made from curdled or cultured milk.

examples.sentence: I often eat a cheese sandwich for lunch.
examples.translation_zh: 我经常午餐吃奶酪三明治。

examples.sentence: Many recipes call for cream cheese to add flavor.
examples.translation_zh: 许多食谱需要奶油奶酪来增加风味。

examples.sentence: We served a cheese platter at the business meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 我们在商务会议上提供了奶酪拼盘。

observation.def_en: The act of noticing or perceiving something carefully.

examples.sentence: Scientists rely on careful observation to conduct their experiments.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家依赖细致的观察进行实验。

examples.sentence: Field observation helps researchers gather data in real environments.
examples.translation_zh: 实地观察帮助研究人员在真实环境中收集数据。

examples.sentence: Participant observation allows sociologists to better understand social interactions.
examples.translation_zh: 参与观察使社会学家更好地理解社会互动。

payment.def_en: A sum of money paid for goods or services.

examples.sentence: Many companies offer installment payments for expensive products.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司为昂贵的产品提供分期付款。

examples.sentence: The bank announced penalties for late payments on loans.
examples.translation_zh: 银行宣布对贷款的逾期付款处以罚款。

examples.sentence: I prefer online payments for their convenience and speed.
examples.translation_zh: 我更喜欢在线支付，因为方便且快捷。

permit.def_en: To allow or authorize someone to do something.

examples.sentence: Schools permit students to retake tests for better grades.
examples.translation_zh: 学校允许学生重考以获得更好的成绩。

examples.sentence: The manager will permit access to the building after hours.
examples.translation_zh: 经理将在下班后允许进入该建筑。

examples.sentence: They permit visitors in the area only during the summer months.
examples.translation_zh: 他们仅在夏季允许游客进入该区域。

definition.def_en: A statement that explains the meaning of a word or phrase.

examples.sentence: Teachers often provide a clear definition of complex terms.
examples.translation_zh: 教师经常对复杂的术语提供清晰的定义。

examples.sentence: Researchers need an operational definition for their experiments.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员需要为他们的实验制定操作性定义。

examples.sentence: Lawyers rely on the legal definition of terms in cases.
examples.translation_zh: 律师依赖案件中术语的法律定义。

priority.def_en: Something that is regarded as more important than others.

examples.sentence: Managers often need to set priorities for their teams.
examples.translation_zh: 管理者常常需要为他们的团队设定优先事项。

examples.sentence: Taking care of your health should be a high priority.
examples.translation_zh: 照顾好自己的健康应该是一个优先事项。

examples.sentence: Students should create a list of priorities for their assignments.
examples.translation_zh: 学生应该为他们的作业创建一个优先事项清单。

graduate.def_en: A person who has completed a degree program.

examples.sentence: Many students will graduate from university this year.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生今年将从大学毕业。

examples.sentence: He applied for a graduate program in engineering at the school.
examples.translation_zh: 他申请了该校的工程研究生项目。

examples.sentence: She hopes to graduate with honors in her major.
examples.translation_zh: 她希望在自己的专业中以优异的成绩毕业。

childhood.def_en: The period of life when a person is a child.

examples.sentence: Parents often want their children to have a happy childhood.
examples.translation_zh: 父母通常希望他们的孩子有一个快乐的童年。

examples.sentence: Many people cherish their childhood memories of playing outdoors.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人珍惜他们在户外玩耍的童年回忆。

examples.sentence: I still keep in touch with my childhood friends from school.
examples.translation_zh: 我仍然和我在学校的童年朋友保持联系。

emotion.def_en: A strong feeling such as joy or sadness.

examples.sentence: People often express emotions when they are happy or sad.
examples.translation_zh: 人们常常在快乐或悲伤时表达情感。

examples.sentence: Overwhelming emotions can affect a person's mental health significantly.
examples.translation_zh: 强烈的情感会显著影响一个人的心理健康。

examples.sentence: An emotional response can vary greatly from person to person.
examples.translation_zh: 情感反应因人而异。

scream.def_en: A loud, sharp cry expressing emotion or pain.

examples.sentence: In the movie, the characters scream for help during the storm.
examples.translation_zh: 在电影中，角色们在暴风雨中尖叫求救。

examples.sentence: Witnesses reported that she screamed in fear when the fire broke out.
examples.translation_zh: 目击者报告说，当火灾发生时，她尖叫着害怕。

examples.sentence: They couldn't stop laughing and screamed with laughter at the joke.
examples.translation_zh: 他们无法停止大笑，对这个笑话尖叫着。

request.def_en: An act of asking for something formally.

examples.sentence: Colleagues often make a request for time off during busy periods.
examples.translation_zh: 同事们在繁忙时期经常请求请假。

examples.sentence: Students should submit a request for information about the course.
examples.translation_zh: 学生应该提交信息请求，了解课程内容。

examples.sentence: You need to submit a request to access the library resources.
examples.translation_zh: 你需要提交请求，才能访问图书馆资源。

cigarette.def_en: A small roll of cut tobacco wrapped in paper for smoking.

examples.sentence: Many people smoke a cigarette during their break at work.
examples.translation_zh: 很多人在工作休息期间抽香烟。

examples.sentence: He decided to light a cigarette after finishing lunch outside.
examples.translation_zh: 他在户外吃完午餐后决定点燃一支香烟。

examples.sentence: You should discard a cigarette responsibly to avoid littering.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该负责任地丢弃香烟，以避免乱扔垃圾。

dramatic.def_en: Something that is exciting, striking, or impressive.

examples.sentence: Many countries experienced dramatic change in their political systems.
examples.translation_zh: 许多国家的政治体制经历了戏剧化的变化。

examples.sentence: The play used lighting to create a dramatic effect during the climax.
examples.translation_zh: 这部戏剧利用灯光在高潮时营造了戏剧化的效果。

examples.sentence: Researchers reported a dramatic increase in pollution levels last year.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员报告去年污染水平有了戏剧化的上升。

universe.def_en: All of space and everything in it, including stars and planets.

examples.sentence: Scientists study the universe expansion to understand cosmic evolution.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家研究宇宙的扩张，以理解宇宙的演变。

examples.sentence: There is a universe of possibilities waiting for you to explore.
examples.translation_zh: 有一个宇宙般的可能性在等待你去探索。

examples.sentence: Many movies depict stories about parallel universes and their inhabitants.
examples.translation_zh: 许多电影描绘平行宇宙及其居民的故事。

gap.def_en: A space or opening between two things.

examples.sentence: Many companies are working to close the pay gap.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司正在努力缩小薪酬差距。

examples.sentence: The generation gap sometimes leads to misunderstandings in families.
examples.translation_zh: 代沟有时会导致家庭中的误解。

examples.sentence: Teachers must address the knowledge gap among students effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 教师必须有效解决学生之间的知识差距。

excellent.def_en: Extremely good; of a very high quality.

examples.sentence: Our team delivered an excellent performance during the project presentation.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的团队在项目展示中表现优秀。

examples.sentence: Researchers reported excellent results from the new drug trial.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员报告了新药物试验的优秀结果。

examples.sentence: Students have an excellent opportunity to study abroad next year.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们明年有一个优秀的出国学习机会。

lucky.def_en: Having good fortune; favored by chance.

examples.sentence: People believe that seven is a lucky number.
examples.translation_zh: 人们相信七是一个幸运的数字。

examples.sentence: She carries a lucky charm wherever she goes.
examples.translation_zh: 她无论去哪里都带着一个幸运符。

examples.sentence: He got a lucky break when he found that job.
examples.translation_zh: 他在找到那份工作时运气很好。

drag.def_en: To pull something with effort or force.

examples.sentence: You can drag and drop files into the folder easily.
examples.translation_zh: 你可以轻松地将文件拖放到文件夹中。

examples.sentence: Negative thoughts can drag someone down if not managed.
examples.translation_zh: 如果不加以管理，消极的想法会让人感到沮丧。

examples.sentence: The negotiations seem to drag on without any real progress.
examples.translation_zh: 谈判似乎没有任何实质性进展，拖得很久。

selection.def_en: The act of choosing something from a group.

examples.sentence: Employers often use a selection process to find the best candidates.
examples.translation_zh: 雇主通常使用选择流程来寻找最佳候选人。

examples.sentence: The school explained the selection criteria for the new students.
examples.translation_zh: 学校解释了新生的选择标准。

examples.sentence: A selection committee will review all submitted artworks next week.
examples.translation_zh: 选择委员会将于下周审查所有提交的艺术作品。

recover.def_en: To return to a normal state after a difficult situation.

examples.sentence: Patients usually recover from illnesses with proper treatment.
examples.translation_zh: 患者通常在适当的治疗下恢复健康。

examples.sentence: Engineers often recover data from damaged hard drives.
examples.translation_zh: 工程师们经常从损坏的硬盘中恢复数据。

examples.sentence: Children tend to recover quickly from minor injuries.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们往往能迅速从小伤中恢复。

airline.def_en: A business that provides air transport services for passengers.

examples.sentence: Many people prefer to fly with a budget airline to save money.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人选择搭乘经济航空公司以节省费用。

examples.sentence: The major airline announced new routes for next summer.
examples.translation_zh: 这家大型航空公司宣布了明夏的新航线。

examples.sentence: He works for the national airline, managing flight operations.
examples.translation_zh: 他在国家航空公司工作，负责航班运营。

roof.def_en: The external upper covering of a building or structure.

examples.sentence: Homeowners often face unexpected costs for roof repairs.
examples.translation_zh: 房主经常面临屋顶维修的意外费用。

examples.sentence: Many cities are creating roof gardens to improve air quality.
examples.translation_zh: 许多城市正在建设屋顶花园以改善空气质量。

examples.sentence: Engineers study the roof structure for better safety designs.
examples.translation_zh: 工程师研究屋顶结构以提高安全设计。

primarily.def_en: For the most part; mainly; chiefly.

examples.sentence: Schools focus primarily on developing students' critical thinking skills.
examples.translation_zh: 学校主要集中在培养学生的批判性思维能力。

examples.sentence: Funding is allocated primarily for research and development purposes.
examples.translation_zh: 资金主要用于研究和开发。

examples.sentence: Emotions are primarily expressed through body language and tone.
examples.translation_zh: 情感主要通过肢体语言和语调表达。

unable.def_en: Not able to do something; lacking the capability.

examples.sentence: I am unable to attend the meeting due to a scheduling conflict.
examples.translation_zh: 由于日程冲突，我无法参加会议。

examples.sentence: Students are often unable to find the resources they need for research.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们常常无法找到他们研究所需的资源。

examples.sentence: She was unable to complete the project on time due to unforeseen issues.
examples.translation_zh: 由于意外问题，她无法按时完成项目。

initiative.def_en: A new plan or strategy aimed at addressing a problem.

examples.sentence: Employees should take the initiative to propose new ideas.
examples.translation_zh: 员工应该主动提出新想法。

examples.sentence: The government plans to launch an initiative for environmental protection.
examples.translation_zh: 政府计划启动一项环保倡议。

examples.sentence: Schools often implement initiative programs to encourage student participation.
examples.translation_zh: 学校经常实施倡议项目以鼓励学生参与。

diet.def_en: Regimen of eating and drinking for health or weight management.

examples.sentence: Eating a balanced diet is important for maintaining good health.
examples.translation_zh: 均衡饮食对保持良好的健康很重要。

examples.sentence: Many people follow a diet plan to lose weight effectively.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人遵循饮食计划以有效减肥。

examples.sentence: Adopting a restrictive diet can lead to nutritional deficiencies.
examples.translation_zh: 采用限制性饮食可能导致营养缺乏。

brief.def_en: Short in duration or extent; concise.

examples.sentence: We need to provide a brief summary of the findings.
examples.translation_zh: 我们需要提供研究结果的简短总结。

examples.sentence: She called for a brief meeting to discuss the project.
examples.translation_zh: 她召集了一个简短的会议来讨论项目。

examples.sentence: The teacher gave a brief explanation of the concept.
examples.translation_zh: 老师对这个概念进行了简短的解释。

expense.def_en: Money spent or required for a particular purpose.

examples.sentence: Many travelers seek to minimize their travel expenses during vacations.
examples.translation_zh: 许多旅行者在度假期间寻求减少旅行费用。

examples.sentence: The company must control its operating expenses to increase profits.
examples.translation_zh: 公司必须控制运营费用以增加利润。

examples.sentence: Patients often struggle to pay their medical expenses after treatment.
examples.translation_zh: 患者在治疗后常常难以支付医疗费用。

schedule.def_en: A plan for carrying out a process or procedure.

examples.sentence: Please schedule a meeting for next week to discuss progress.
examples.translation_zh: 请为下周安排一个会议讨论进展。

examples.sentence: The airline announced schedule changes due to bad weather conditions.
examples.translation_zh: 航空公司因恶劣天气条件宣布了时间表的变化。

examples.sentence: Students can view their class schedule online before the semester starts.
examples.translation_zh: 学生可以在学期开始前在线查看他们的课程表。

arrest.def_en: To stop someone legally because of a crime.

examples.sentence: Police are ready to make an arrest in the case.
examples.translation_zh: 警方准备在此案件中逮捕嫌疑人。

examples.sentence: The officer decided to arrest him for theft after the investigation.
examples.translation_zh: 在调查后，警官决定因盗窃逮捕他。

examples.sentence: She received an arrest warrant for missing her court date.
examples.translation_zh: 她因缺席法庭而收到逮捕令。

purchase.def_en: To acquire something in exchange for money.

examples.sentence: The manager approved the purchase order for new equipment.
examples.translation_zh: 经理批准了新设备的采购订单。

examples.sentence: Buying a house is often the biggest purchase someone makes.
examples.translation_zh: 买房通常是一个人最大的购买。

examples.sentence: Understanding the purchase price is essential for budget planning.
examples.translation_zh: 理解采购价格对预算规划至关重要。

steel.def_en: A strong, hard metal made of iron and carbon.

examples.sentence: Workers prefer using stainless steel for its durability.
examples.translation_zh: 工人们更喜欢使用不锈钢，因为它耐用。

examples.sentence: They built the house with steel beams to ensure safety.
examples.translation_zh: 他们用钢梁建造房屋以确保安全。

examples.sentence: The steel industry is facing challenges due to global competition.
examples.translation_zh: 钢铁行业因全球竞争面临挑战。

regarding.def_en: In reference to a particular subject or matter.

examples.sentence: Management held a meeting regarding the report's findings.
examples.translation_zh: 管理层召开会议，讨论报告的发现。

examples.sentence: You will receive a response regarding your application soon.
examples.translation_zh: 您很快会收到关于您申请的回复。

examples.sentence: Experts shared their views regarding recent events in the region.
examples.translation_zh: 专家们分享了关于该地区最近事件的看法。

examples.sentence: Teachers often use visual aids to enhance learning experiences.
examples.translation_zh: 教师常常使用视觉辅助工具来增强学习体验。

examples.sentence: Scientists create visual representations to explain complex data.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家制作视觉呈现来解释复杂的数据。

examples.sentence: Many people appreciate visual art for its beauty and creativity.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人欣赏视觉艺术的美丽和创造力。

fairly.def_en: To a moderate extent; not very.

examples.sentence: This type of music is fairly common among teenagers.
examples.translation_zh: 这种音乐在青少年中相当常见。

examples.sentence: The exam was fairly easy compared to last year's.
examples.translation_zh: 与去年的考试相比，这次考试相当简单。

examples.sentence: We found a fairly large population of birds in the area.
examples.translation_zh: 我们在该地区发现了相当多的鸟类。

violent.def_en: Using physical force to harm someone or something.

examples.sentence: Many cities are struggling with increasing rates of violent crime.
examples.translation_zh: 许多城市正在面临暴力犯罪率上升的问题。

examples.sentence: Children exposed to violent behavior may develop aggressive tendencies.
examples.translation_zh: 接触暴力行为的儿童可能会形成攻击性倾向。

examples.sentence: The violent protests led to significant changes in government policies.
examples.translation_zh: 暴力抗议导致政府政策发生重大变化。

suppose.def_en: To assume something to be true without proof.

examples.sentence: Suppose you have a question about the homework assignment.
examples.translation_zh: 假设你对作业有疑问。

examples.sentence: I suppose it's possible to change your mind later.
examples.translation_zh: 我想你可能会改变主意。

examples.sentence: Officials suppose that happened during the storm last night.
examples.translation_zh: 官员们认为那是在昨晚的暴风雨中发生的。

perceive.def_en: Become aware or conscious of something through the senses.

examples.sentence: Researchers can perceive differences in the data collected.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员能够感知收集到的数据差异。

examples.sentence: People often perceive change as a threat to their routine.
examples.translation_zh: 人们常常将变化视为对日常生活的威胁。

examples.sentence: Managers must perceive problems early to implement solutions.
examples.translation_zh: 管理者必须及早感知问题，以实施解决方案。

silent.def_en: Not making or accompanied by any sound.

examples.sentence: She gave him the silent treatment after their argument.
examples.translation_zh: 在争吵后，她对他采取了沉默的态度。

examples.sentence: The silent majority often has strong opinions on political issues.
examples.translation_zh: 沉默的大多数通常对政治问题有强烈看法。

examples.sentence: Many families celebrate Christmas with a silent night of reflection.
examples.translation_zh: 许多家庭在安静的夜晚里反思，庆祝圣诞节。

comparison.def_en: The act of evaluating two or more items' similarities or differences.

examples.sentence: Researchers often make a comparison between different methodologies.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员经常对不同的方法论进行比较。

examples.sentence: Experts draw a comparison between this year and last year's data.
examples.translation_zh: 专家将今年的数据与去年的数据进行了比较。

examples.sentence: In comparison to last week, prices have risen significantly.
examples.translation_zh: 与上周相比，价格大幅上涨。

self.def_en: Personal identity or individual as distinct from others.

examples.sentence: Many people find self-help resources useful for personal growth.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人发现自助资源对个人成长很有帮助。

examples.sentence: Addressing self-esteem issues can significantly improve your mental health.
examples.translation_zh: 解决自尊问题可以显著改善你的心理健康。

examples.sentence: Teachers often use self-assessment tools to gauge student progress.
examples.translation_zh: 教师经常使用自评工具来评估学生的进步。

settlement.def_en: An agreement to resolve a dispute or the act of establishing a home.

examples.sentence: Many families moved into the new land settlement last year.
examples.translation_zh: 许多家庭去年迁入了新的土地定居点。

examples.sentence: The company reached a financial settlement with the employees affected.
examples.translation_zh: 公司与受到影响的员工达成了财务和解。

examples.sentence: Negotiators are working hard to achieve a lasting peace settlement.
examples.translation_zh: 谈判人员正在努力达成持久的和平协议。

description.def_en: A statement that gives details about something.

examples.sentence: Managers need a detailed description of the project requirements.
examples.translation_zh: 经理们需要项目需求的详细描述。

examples.sentence: Students should provide a brief description of their research topic.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们应该提供他们研究主题的简要描述。

examples.sentence: Artists often create a visual description of their inspiration.
examples.translation_zh: 艺术家们常常创作灵感的视觉描述。

slide.def_en: To move smoothly along a surface; a presentation visual aid.

examples.sentence: The team prepared a slide presentation for the meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 团队为会议准备了幻灯片演示。

examples.sentence: Children love to slide down the playground equipment.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们喜欢从游乐场的设施上滑下来。

examples.sentence: Students often used a slide rule before calculators became common.
examples.translation_zh: 在计算器普及之前，学生们经常使用计算尺。

layer.def_en: A single thickness or coating of material.

examples.sentence: The outer layer protects the food from contamination.
examples.translation_zh: 外层保护食物免受污染。

examples.sentence: I need to apply another layer of paint to the wall.
examples.translation_zh: 我需要在墙上涂上一层油漆。

examples.sentence: A thin layer of cream is enough for the skin.
examples.translation_zh: 一层薄薄的乳霜就足够滋润皮肤。

widely.def_en: In a broad or extensive manner; generally

examples.sentence: Many theories are widely accepted in the scientific community.
examples.translation_zh: 许多理论在科学界被广泛接受。

examples.sentence: She is widely recognized as a leading artist in the modern art scene.
examples.translation_zh: 她被广泛认可为现代艺术界的领军艺术家。

examples.sentence: This app is widely used for organizing daily tasks and reminders.
examples.translation_zh: 这个应用程序被广泛用于组织日常任务和提醒。

portion.def_en: A part of a whole or something larger.

examples.sentence: Many people waste a portion of food every day.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人每天浪费一部分食物。

examples.sentence: A significant portion of the population is affected by this issue.
examples.translation_zh: 很大一部分人口受到这个问题的影响。

examples.sentence: The team will discuss how to allocate a portion of the budget.
examples.translation_zh: 团队将讨论如何分配预算的一部分。

inform.def_en: To give someone information about something.

examples.sentence: Officials will inform the public about the new guidelines tomorrow.
examples.translation_zh: 官员们将于明天通知公众新的指导方针。

examples.sentence: Managers must inform employees of any changes in the policy.
examples.translation_zh: 经理们必须通知员工政策的任何变化。

examples.sentence: Teachers should inform students about upcoming exams and projects.
examples.translation_zh: 教师应通知学生即将到来的考试和项目。

territory.def_en: An area of land under the jurisdiction of a government.

examples.sentence: Many countries claim ownership of disputed territories in the region.
examples.translation_zh: 许多国家声称拥有该地区的争议领土。

examples.sentence: Each nation has its own national territory and cultural identity.
examples.translation_zh: 每个国家都有自己的国家领土和文化身份。

examples.sentence: Employees must respect the territory rights of their colleagues.
examples.translation_zh: 员工必须尊重同事的领土权利。

wedding.def_en: A ceremony where two people get married.

examples.sentence: Families gather to celebrate a wedding ceremony together.
examples.translation_zh: 家人聚在一起庆祝婚礼。

examples.sentence: They exchanged wedding vows in front of all their friends.
examples.translation_zh: 他们在所有朋友面前互许婚礼誓言。

examples.sentence: She hired a wedding planner to organize the big event.
examples.translation_zh: 她雇佣了一位婚礼策划师来组织这个大事件。

opponent.def_en: A person or group opposing another in a contest.

examples.sentence: Many politicians attack their political opponents during debates.
examples.translation_zh: 很多政治家在辩论中攻击他们的政治对手。

examples.sentence: In the final match, the team faced a strong opponent.
examples.translation_zh: 在决赛中，球队面对了一位强大的对手。

examples.sentence: You must train hard to defeat your opponent in the competition.
examples.translation_zh: 你必须努力训练才能在比赛中打败对手。

abandon.def_en: To leave something behind or give up control of it.

examples.sentence: Many people choose to abandon hope during difficult times.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在困难时期选择放弃希望。

examples.sentence: Crew members were instructed to abandon ship immediately after the alarm.
examples.translation_zh: 船员们被指示在警报响起后立即弃船。

examples.sentence: Due to bad weather, officials decided to abandon plans for the event.
examples.translation_zh: 由于恶劣天气，官员们决定放弃活动计划。

transform.def_en: To change in form, appearance, or structure.

examples.sentence: Many schools aim to transform education through technology.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学校旨在通过科技转变教育。

examples.sentence: These programs can transform lives in the community.
examples.translation_zh: 这些项目可以改变社区内人们的生活。

examples.sentence: Researchers need to transform data into usable information.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员需要将数据转化为可用的信息。

immediate.def_en: Happening or done without delay or intervening time.

examples.sentence: We must take immediate action to address this issue.
examples.translation_zh: 我们必须立即采取行动解决这个问题。

examples.sentence: The immediate effects of the experiment were surprising to the researchers.
examples.translation_zh: 实验的直接效果让研究人员感到惊讶。

examples.sentence: An immediate response was required from the local government after the disaster.
examples.translation_zh: 灾难发生后，地方政府需要立即作出回应。

tension.def_en: The state of being stretched tight or under strain.

examples.sentence: Many people experience muscle tension after long hours of work.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人在长时间工作后会感到肌肉紧张。

examples.sentence: Tension between the two countries has escalated recently.
examples.translation_zh: 最近，两国之间的紧张关系加剧了。

examples.sentence: There was a noticeable tension in the atmosphere during the debate.
examples.translation_zh: 辩论期间，气氛中有明显的紧张感。

leading.def_en: In a position of influence or leadership over others.

examples.sentence: Smoking is the leading cause of lung cancer worldwide.
examples.translation_zh: 吸烟是全球肺癌的主要原因。

examples.sentence: She played the leading role in the school's annual play.
examples.translation_zh: 她在学校的年度戏剧中扮演了主角。

examples.sentence: He is regarded as a leading expert in renewable energy technologies.
examples.translation_zh: 他被认为是可再生能源技术的领先专家。

enable.def_en: To make something possible or easier to do.

examples.sentence: Teachers enable students to explore their interests and talents.
examples.translation_zh: 教师使学生能够探索他们的兴趣和才能。

examples.sentence: New software enables technology to function more efficiently than ever.
examples.translation_zh: 新软件使技术比以往更高效地运作。

examples.sentence: The organization aims to enable access to healthcare for everyone.
examples.translation_zh: 该组织旨在使每个人都能获得医疗服务。

consist.def_en: To be made up of or composed of.

examples.sentence: Courses in this program consist of various subjects and activities.
examples.translation_zh: 该项目的课程包括多个科目和活动。

examples.sentence: The solution consists mainly of water and salt.
examples.translation_zh: 该溶液主要由水和盐组成。

examples.sentence: Her diet consists entirely of fruits and vegetables.
examples.translation_zh: 她的饮食完全由水果和蔬菜组成。

alcohol.def_en: A colorless volatile liquid used as a beverage and in chemical reactions.

examples.sentence: High alcohol consumption can lead to serious health problems.
examples.translation_zh: 过量饮酒可能导致严重的健康问题。

examples.sentence: Many people seek help for alcohol abuse and dependency.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人寻求帮助以应对酒精滥用和依赖。

examples.sentence: Employers often require alcohol testing for safety-sensitive positions.
examples.translation_zh: 雇主通常要求对安全敏感岗位进行酒精测试。

bend.def_en: To shape something into a curve or angle.

examples.sentence: Managers sometimes bend the rules for special cases.
examples.translation_zh: 管理人员有时会为了特殊情况而放宽规定。

examples.sentence: She bends over backwards to help her friends when needed.
examples.translation_zh: 她在需要时竭尽全力帮助朋友。

examples.sentence: During the party, he bent my ear about his travels in Europe.
examples.translation_zh: 派对上，他向我讲述他在欧洲旅行的经历。

desert.def_en: A barren area of land with little or no vegetation.

examples.sentence: The desert environment is harsh and requires adaptation.
examples.translation_zh: 沙漠环境十分恶劣，需要适应。

examples.sentence: Visitors were amazed by the desert landscape's unique beauty.
examples.translation_zh: 游客对沙漠景观的独特美丽感到惊讶。

examples.sentence: Researchers studied the desert wildlife to understand their survival strategies.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员研究了沙漠野生动物，以了解它们的生存策略。

saving.def_en: The act of keeping resources for future use.

examples.sentence: Many people are focused on saving money for retirement.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人专注于为退休节省资金。

examples.sentence: Working efficiently can help in saving time on projects.
examples.translation_zh: 高效工作可以帮助节省项目时间。

examples.sentence: Energy saving practices benefit both the planet and your bills.
examples.translation_zh: 节能做法对地球和你的账单都有好处。

error.def_en: A mistake or inaccuracy in a process or action.

examples.sentence: People often make an error when they rush their work.
examples.translation_zh: 人们在匆忙工作时经常会犯错误。

examples.sentence: Researchers need to report an error in their findings promptly.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员需要及时报告研究结果中的错误。

examples.sentence: I must correct an error on my application form before submitting.
examples.translation_zh: 我必须在提交之前更正申请表上的错误。

print.def_en: To produce text or images on paper or other surfaces.

examples.sentence: Journalists often print articles to share important information.
examples.translation_zh: 记者经常打印文章以分享重要信息。

examples.sentence: Teachers need to print materials for their students each week.
examples.translation_zh: 老师每周需要为学生打印教材。

examples.sentence: We must print copies of the report before the meeting starts.
examples.translation_zh: 在会议开始前，我们必须打印报告的副本。

preserve.def_en: To keep something in its original state or condition.

examples.sentence: Conservationists work hard to preserve wildlife in natural habitats.
examples.translation_zh: 环境保护人士努力保护自然栖息地中的野生动物。

examples.sentence: Many people use jars to preserve food for the winter.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人用罐子保存食物以备冬季使用。

examples.sentence: It is important to preserve cultural heritage for future generations.
examples.translation_zh: 保护文化遗产对未来的世代非常重要。

formal.def_en: Adhering to established conventions or rules; official.

examples.sentence: Education plays a critical role in providing formal education to students.
examples.translation_zh: 教育在为学生提供正式教育方面发挥着重要作用。

examples.sentence: Our team will hold a formal meeting next week to discuss progress.
examples.translation_zh: 我们团队下周将召开正式会议讨论进展。

examples.sentence: Guests are required to wear formal attire at the wedding ceremony.
examples.translation_zh: 宾客在婚礼仪式上需要穿着正式的服装。

existence.def_en: The state of being or having reality.

examples.sentence: Scientists explore the existence of life on other planets.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家们探索其他星球上的生命存在。

examples.sentence: Researchers confirmed the existence of evidence supporting the theory.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员确认了支持该理论的证据存在。

examples.sentence: The report discusses the existence of rights for all citizens.
examples.translation_zh: 报告讨论了所有公民权利的存在。

arrange.def_en: To put things in a specific order or plan.

examples.sentence: I will arrange a meeting with the project manager tomorrow.
examples.translation_zh: 我明天会安排与项目经理的会议。

examples.sentence: They arranged transport for all the participants in the event.
examples.translation_zh: 他们为活动中的所有参与者安排了交通。

examples.sentence: She enjoys arranging flowers to decorate her home beautifully.
examples.translation_zh: 她喜欢安排花卉来美化她的家。

atmosphere.def_en: The mood or feeling created by a place or situation.

examples.sentence: Teachers can create a positive atmosphere in the classroom.
examples.translation_zh: 教师们可以在教室里创造积极的氛围。

examples.sentence: Everyone enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere at the party.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人都享受派对的轻松氛围。

examples.sentence: A friendly business atmosphere encourages teamwork and creativity.
examples.translation_zh: 友好的商业氛围会促进团队合作和创造力。

reply.def_en: To give an answer or respond to someone or something.

examples.sentence: She always replies to emails promptly and professionally.
examples.translation_zh: 她总是及时而专业地回复电子邮件。

examples.sentence: Children often reply to questions with great enthusiasm.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们常常充满热情地回答问题。

examples.sentence: Please remember to reply all in the group email discussion.
examples.translation_zh: 请记得在小组邮件讨论中回复所有人。

joint.def_en: A point where two or more things are connected.

examples.sentence: Many companies are forming joint ventures to expand their markets.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公司正在成立合资企业以拓展市场。

examples.sentence: Students made a joint effort to clean up the classroom after the event.
examples.translation_zh: 活动结束后，学生们共同努力清理教室。

examples.sentence: The two universities announced a joint research project on climate change.
examples.translation_zh: 这两所大学宣布了一项关于气候变化的联合研究项目。

lock.def_en: A device for securing something, typically with a key.

examples.sentence: Please remember to lock the door when you leave.
examples.translation_zh: 请记得离开时锁上门。

examples.sentence: They couldn't access the office because they were locked out.
examples.translation_zh: 他们无法进入办公室，因为被锁在外面了。

examples.sentence: The treasure was stored away under lock and key.
examples.translation_zh: 宝藏被锁在安全处。

opposite.def_en: Having a position or direction that is completely different.

examples.sentence: You and I live at opposite ends of the city.
examples.translation_zh: 你和我住在城市的两端。

examples.sentence: They argue from opposite sides of the issue.
examples.translation_zh: 他们在这个问题的对立面争论。

examples.sentence: We were walking in the opposite direction from the restaurant.
examples.translation_zh: 我们正朝着与餐厅相反的方向走。

deserve.def_en: To be worthy of something; to have a right to something.

examples.sentence: Everyone deserves respect in the workplace and beyond.
examples.translation_zh: 每个人在工作场所及其他地方都应得到尊重。

examples.sentence: After working hard all week, they deserve a break this weekend.
examples.translation_zh: 经过一周的努力工作，他们这个周末应该休息一下。

examples.sentence: Many citizens feel they deserve better services from the government.
examples.translation_zh: 许多公民觉得他们应该得到更好的政府服务。

consistent.def_en: Always acting or behaving in the same way.

examples.sentence: Researchers need consistent results to confirm their findings.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员需要一致的结果来确认他们的发现。

examples.sentence: The company has implemented consistent policies across all departments.
examples.translation_zh: 公司在所有部门实施了一致的政策。

examples.sentence: Students must show consistent effort to improve their grades.
examples.translation_zh: 学生必须表现出一致的努力来提高他们的成绩。

discovery.def_en: The act of finding or learning something new.

examples.sentence: Scientists often celebrate significant scientific discoveries in their fields.
examples.translation_zh: 科学家们常常庆祝其领域内的重要科学发现。

examples.sentence: A new discovery regarding ancient civilizations was reported last week.
examples.translation_zh: 上周报道了一项关于古代文明的新发现。

examples.sentence: Every day can bring opportunities to make a discovery about yourself.
examples.translation_zh: 每天都可能带来对自我的新发现。

resistance.def_en: The ability to withstand or oppose something harmful.

examples.sentence: Employees often show resistance to change in company policies.
examples.translation_zh: 员工经常对公司政策的变动表现出抵抗。

examples.sentence: Many athletes incorporate resistance training into their workout routines.
examples.translation_zh: 许多运动员将力量训练纳入他们的锻炼计划。

examples.sentence: A resistance movement emerged to fight against the occupation.
examples.translation_zh: 一个抵抗运动出现，旨在对抗占领。

exposure.def_en: The state of being exposed to something harmful or harmful conditions.

examples.sentence: Excessive sun exposure can lead to skin cancer over time.
examples.translation_zh: 过量的阳光暴露会导致皮肤癌。

examples.sentence: Employees should understand their exposure to risks at the workplace.
examples.translation_zh: 员工应了解在工作场所面临的风险。

examples.sentence: Students benefit from early exposure to information technology skills.
examples.translation_zh: 学生从早期接触信息技术技能中受益。

stream.def_en: A flow of water or other liquid.

examples.sentence: Many people enjoy watching live streams of their favorite games.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人喜欢观看他们最喜欢的游戏的直播。

examples.sentence: The data streams from the sensors are analyzed in real time.
examples.translation_zh: 传感器的数据流实时进行分析。

examples.sentence: She wrote a stream of consciousness narrative for her writing class.
examples.translation_zh: 她为写作课写了一个意识流叙述。

sale.def_en: An exchange of goods or services for money.

examples.sentence: Many shoppers look forward to the end of season sale.
examples.translation_zh: 许多消费者期待季末促销。

examples.sentence: The company announced a public sale of its old equipment.
examples.translation_zh: 公司宣布将公开出售旧设备。

examples.sentence: Visitors flocked to the store for the clearance sale.
examples.translation_zh: 游客涌向商店参加清仓销售。

pot.def_en: A round container used for cooking or storage.

examples.sentence: Many families use a cooking pot for dinner preparation.
examples.translation_zh: 许多家庭用锅来准备晚餐。

examples.sentence: She placed a beautiful flower pot on the windowsill.
examples.translation_zh: 她在窗台上放了一个美丽的花盆。

examples.sentence: The pressure pot helps in cooking food faster.
examples.translation_zh: 高压锅有助于更快地烹饪食物。

grand.def_en: Impressive or magnificent in appearance or style.

examples.sentence: Everyone was excited for the grand opening of the new store.
examples.translation_zh: 大家对新商店的盛大开业感到兴奋。

examples.sentence: She has grand plans to expand the business next year.
examples.translation_zh: 她有宏伟的计划，打算明年扩展业务。

examples.sentence: The festival was celebrated on a grand scale, attracting many visitors.
examples.translation_zh: 这个节日以盛大的规模庆祝，吸引了许多游客。

tale.def_en: A narrative designed to interest, amuse, or instruct.

examples.sentence: Children love to hear fairy tales before bedtime.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们喜欢在睡前听童话故事。

examples.sentence: He shared a tale of adventure from his recent trip.
examples.translation_zh: 他分享了他最近旅行中的一个冒险故事。

examples.sentence: The tale told in class captivated all the students.
examples.translation_zh: 课堂上讲述的故事吸引了所有学生。

pose.def_en: A position of the body or to present an idea.

examples.sentence: Students often pose a question during the lecture.
examples.translation_zh: 学生在讲座期间经常提出问题。

examples.sentence: Smoking can pose a risk to your health over time.
examples.translation_zh: 吸烟随着时间的推移可能对你的健康构成风险。

examples.sentence: They decided to pose for a photo at the park.
examples.translation_zh: 他们决定在公园里摆姿势拍照。

resolve.def_en: To find a solution or make a decision about something.

examples.sentence: People often need to resolve conflicts with their friends.
examples.translation_zh: 人们经常需要与朋友解决冲突。

examples.sentence: The team will resolve issues during their next meeting.
examples.translation_zh: 团队将在下次会议上解决问题。

examples.sentence: Students must resolve differences for effective group projects.
examples.translation_zh: 学生必须解决分歧，以便有效完成小组项目。

phase.def_en: A distinct period or stage in a process or development.

examples.sentence: Researchers are studying the early phases of the project.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员正在研究该项目的早期阶段。

examples.sentence: The team is currently in the development phase of the software.
examples.translation_zh: 团队目前处于软件的开发阶段。

examples.sentence: Students will enter the next phase of their education next year.
examples.translation_zh: 学生们明年将进入他们教育的下一个阶段。

racial.def_en: Relating to a person's race or ethnicity.

examples.sentence: Many activists fight against racial discrimination in society.
examples.translation_zh: 许多活动家在社会中与种族歧视作斗争。

examples.sentence: Our goal is to achieve racial equality in education.
examples.translation_zh: 我们的目标是在教育中实现种族平等。

examples.sentence: Racial tensions can lead to conflicts in neighborhoods.
examples.translation_zh: 种族紧张关系可能导致社区中的冲突。

joke.def_en: A humorous anecdote or statement intended to provoke laughter.

examples.sentence: People often tell a joke to lighten the mood in conversations.
examples.translation_zh: 人们经常讲笑话来活跃谈话气氛。

examples.sentence: He likes to make a joke during meetings to keep everyone engaged.
examples.translation_zh: 他喜欢在会议中开个笑话来让大家保持参与感。

examples.sentence: An inside joke often brings friends closer together through shared experiences.
examples.translation_zh: 内部笑话通常通过共同经历使朋友更加亲密。

coat.def_en: An outer garment worn for warmth or fashion.

examples.sentence: She wears a warm winter coat during cold days.
examples.translation_zh: 她在寒冷的日子里穿着温暖的冬季外套。

examples.sentence: The chef cleaned the foul coat before preparing the meal.
examples.translation_zh: 厨师在准备餐点之前清洗了污秽的外套。

examples.sentence: They applied a new coat of paint to the old fence.
examples.translation_zh: 他们给旧围栏涂上了一层新油漆。

manufacturer.def_en: A person or company that makes goods for sale.

examples.sentence: Multiple companies compete to be the leading manufacturer in electronics.
examples.translation_zh: 多家公司竞争成为电子产品的领先制造商。

examples.sentence: The automobile manufacturer announced a new electric vehicle model yesterday.
examples.translation_zh: 这家汽车制造商昨天宣布了一款新的电动车型。

examples.sentence: A local textile manufacturer supplies high-quality fabrics to retailers.
examples.translation_zh: 一家当地的纺织制造商为零售商提供高质量的面料。

quote.def_en: To repeat or copy words from a source.

examples.sentence: Researchers often quote from experts to support their arguments.
examples.translation_zh: 研究人员经常引用专家的话来支持他们的论点。

examples.sentence: Before buying, please quote a price for the services.
examples.translation_zh: 在购买之前，请给出服务的报价。

examples.sentence: A famous quote can inspire many people in their lives.
examples.translation_zh: 一句名言可以激励很多人在生活中。

philosophy.def_en: The study of fundamental nature of knowledge and existence.

examples.sentence: Many people study political philosophy to understand government systems.
examples.translation_zh: 许多人研究政治哲学，以理解政府体系。

examples.sentence: Teachers often discuss the philosophy of education in their training.
examples.translation_zh: 教师们常常在培训中讨论教育哲学。

examples.sentence: Developing a personal philosophy helps guide life decisions.
examples.translation_zh: 发展个人哲学有助于指导生活决策。

urge.def_en: A strong desire or impulse to do something.

examples.sentence: She felt an urge to help the child in need.
examples.translation_zh: 她感到想要帮助有需要的孩子。

examples.sentence: There is a growing urge for change in the company culture.
examples.translation_zh: 公司文化中越来越强烈地渴望变革。

examples.sentence: The crowd urged on their favorite team during the match.
examples.translation_zh: 观众在比赛中为他们最喜欢的球队加油。

occasion.def_en: A particular time or instance of an event occurring.

examples.sentence: People celebrate special occasions with friends and family.
examples.translation_zh: 人们与朋友和家人庆祝特殊场合。

examples.sentence: On one occasion, I forgot my keys at home.
examples.translation_zh: 有一次，我把钥匙忘在了家里。

examples.sentence: I prepare a presentation for every occasion in the office.
examples.translation_zh: 我为办公室的每个场合准备演示文稿。

foundation.def_en: The basis or groundwork of something important.

examples.sentence: Students need a solid foundation for their future studies.
examples.translation_zh: 学生需要坚实的基础来支持他们未来的学习。

examples.sentence: A good education provides a foundation for success in life.
examples.translation_zh: 良好的教育为成功打下基础。

examples.sentence: Honesty is the foundation of trust in any relationship.
examples.translation_zh: 诚实是任何关系中信任的基础。

breathe.def_en: To take air into the lungs and expel it.

examples.sentence: You should breathe deeply to relax your mind and body.
examples.translation_zh: 你应该深呼吸，以放松身心。

examples.sentence: Children love to play outside and breathe fresh air.
examples.translation_zh: 孩子们喜欢在外面玩耍，呼吸新鲜空气。

examples.sentence: Artists often breathe life into their work with vivid colors.
examples.translation_zh: 艺术家们常用鲜艳的颜色为作品注入生命。

elect.def_en: To choose or make a decision about something.

examples.sentence: Countries will elect a president in the upcoming elections.
examples.translation_zh: 各国将在即将到来的选举中选出总统。

examples.sentence: Students can elect a representative for the student council each year.
examples.translation_zh: 学生每年可以选举一名代表参加学生会。

examples.sentence: Many students elect to study abroad for better opportunities.
examples.translation_zh: 许多学生选择出国留学以获得更好的机会。

dust.def_en: Fine particles of matter, typically found on surfaces.

examples.sentence: Dust particles can harm both air quality and human health.
